name: Folitrax 7.5mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET

FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET contains Methotrexate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimetabolites. FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET is used to manage active rheumatoid arthritis in adults, which is a form of severe arthritis occurring due to unknown reasons (idiopathic) and old age and is non-responsive to conventional painkillers (such as Non-Steroidal Anti Inflammatory Drugs Ex. Aceclofenac).

FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET is also used to manage its polyarthritic forms (characterized by the involvement of five or more joints), which are severe, active, and idiopathic in nature and affect young people (Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis, JIA).

FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET is also used to manage psoriasis and relapsed (reoccurred) and refractory (unaffected by other conventional managements) Non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma, which is a type of cancer of the lymphatic system.

Psoriasis is a skin condition characterized by itchy scales that is not responsive to conventional managements such as phototherapy and retinoids.

Before taking FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET, it is recommended to inform the doctor about your medical and family history, including the list of medicines (prescription, non-prescription medicines, and herbal medicines) that are being taken.

Also, FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended to be taken by pregnant and nursing women, women planning pregnancy, those who drink huge amounts of alcohol, or patients suffering from liver and kidney impairment.

FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended in children for the management of psoriasis and rheumatoid arthritis. However, FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET can be used with caution in children to manage polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis, which is characterized by the involvement of five or more joints that are of severe, active, juvenile, and idiopathic character. Consult the doctor before taking FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET.

In addition, caution must be exercised by patients suffering from lung disorders, blood disorders, and gastric disorders before taking FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET.

Care must be taken to avoid taking products containing caffeine, such as black tea, coffee, and cold drinks, while taking FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET.

The common side effects seen after taking FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and altered levels of blood cells. Consult a doctor if any of the above side effects worsen after taking FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET Works

FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET contains methotrexate that works by interfering with the growth of those cells in the body that reproduce quickly. As a result, the growth of those cells gets retarded, thus serving as an anti-tumour agent. Also, it decreases the undesired reactions of the body’s own immune-defense mechanism, thereby working as an effective immunosuppressant. Additionally, it also exhibits anti-inflammatory effects, thereby reducing pain, swelling, and redness. As a result, it manages the symptoms associated with diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis.
usageDetails:
How to use FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET

Take FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

warnings.details: FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are pregnant and/or are planning to become pregnant since it can be harmful to the foetus (growing baby) and lead to various malformations. Consult your doctor before taking FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET.
FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended if you are a nursing mother. Consult your doctor before taking FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET.
FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended if you feel tired or dizzy after taking the medicine. Consult your doctor before taking FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET.
It is recommended to avoid the consumption of alcohol while taking FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET, as it may increase the risk of liver damage. Consult your doctor before taking FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET.
FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended if you have or have had a kidney disorder and/or are receiving any dialysis> management. Consult your doctor before taking FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET.
FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended if you have a liver disorder. Consult your doctor before taking FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET.
FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended if you are allergic to methotrexate and/or any other constituent of FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET.
FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET is recommended to be taken with caution if you have issues with lung function and are diagnosed with pleural effusion. Consult your doctor before taking FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET.

FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended in children for the management of psoriasis and rheumatoid arthritis. However, FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET can be used with caution in children to manage polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis. Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depending on your child’s age, body weight, and health condition. Consult your doctor for advice before taking FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET.

FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET is recommended to be administered with caution and in a lower dosage to elders due to diminished function of the liver and kidneys and reduced folate levels in the blood in old age. Also, it is recommended to closely monitor the elderly, taking FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET for the identification of possible side effects. Consult the doctor before taking FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET.

Others

FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have bone marrow disorders
Have blood disorders
Have an impaired immune system
Have a severe and/or existing infection (Ex. tuberculosis, HIV)
Have ulcers in the gastro-intestinal tract
Have inflammation and ulcers of the mouth
Are receiving vaccinations containing live vaccines

Before taking FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have diabetes
Are overweight
Suffer from diarrhea
Ulcers in the colon (ulcerative colitis)
Are receiving radiotherapy for various conditions, such as X-rays and UV-rays
Have folate deficiency
Have lactose and/or galactose intolerance
Have mental illness

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. amoxicillin, ciprofloxacin)
Medicines used to increase urine excretion (Ex. frusemide)
Medicines used to manage increased sugar levels (Ex. metformin)
Medicines used to manage fits (Ex. phenytoin)
Medicines used to manage increased cholesterol levels (Ex. cholestyramine)
Medicines used to manage gout (Ex. probenecid)
Medicines to manage reduced folic acid levels (Ex. folic acid preparations)
Medicines used to manage severe heartburn or ulcers (Ex. omeprazole)
Other medicines used to manage rheumatoid arthritis (Ex. leflunomide)
Medicines that can be harmful to the liver (Ex. sulfasalazine)
Medicines used in the management of cancer (Ex. doxorubicin, cisplatin, and mercaptopurine)
Medicines used to manage pain (Ex. ibuprofen, naproxen, diclofenac)
Other medicines used to manage rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis (Ex. leflunomide, phenylbutazone, or amidopyrine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. theophylline)
Medicines used in organ transplantation (Ex. cyclosporin, azathioprine)
Medicines used to induce sleep (Ex. phenobarbitone)
Medicines used to induce calmness and relieve anxiety (Ex. diazepam)
Medicines used for oral contraception (Ex. estrogen)
Medicines used to manage skin conditions (Ex. retinoids)
Medicines used to manage malaria (Ex. pyrimethamine)
Medicines that contain live vaccines (Ex. MMR vaccine)
Medicines used for general anesthesia and pain relief (Ex. nitrous oxide)
Medicines used to manage heart problems (Ex. amiodarone)
Medicines used to manage heart failure (Ex. digoxin)
Medicines used for the management of various inflammatory conditions like skin diseases and allergic reactions (Ex. hydrocortisone)

B. Drug-Food interactions:

It is recommended to avoid the consumption of drinks containing caffeine, such as black tea, coffee, and soft drinks, along with FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET, to manage dehydration.

Overdosage:

If you or someone else accidentally takes too much FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET, it is recommended to consult your doctor immediately. Symptoms of overdosage with FOLITRAX 7.5MG TABLET are an easy tendency to bruise or bleed, nausea, vomiting, and unusual weakness, along with the development of mouth sores and ulcers.

name: MERTABTO Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About MERTABTO TABLET

MERTABTO TABLET contains Mercaptopurine which belongs to the group of medicines called Cytotoxics. MERTABTO TABLET is used in adults and children to manage leukaemia, which is a type of blood cancer that occurs due to rapid growth of abnormal blood cells.

MERTABTO TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to 6-mercaptopurine, and/or azathioprine. It is also not recommended for use in patients scheduled for vaccination.

Before taking MERTABTO TABLET, inform your doctor if you have recently been vaccinated (especially with yellow fever vaccine), and/or suffer from inherited mutation of NUDT15 gene (essential for body's breakdown of mercaptopurine), shingles, chicken pox/hepatitis B infection (virus-induced liver disease), kidney problems, and liver problems (such as hepatitis B).

MERTABTO TABLET is generally not recommended for use during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy since the medicine may cause harm to the foetus. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

MERTABTO TABLET should be used with caution in children (aged below 6 years/low body mass) since it may cause low blood sugar (associated with symptoms such as nausea, dizziness, confusion). It is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking MERTABTO TABLET are nausea/vomiting, anaemia (associated with symptoms such as tiredness, weakness, breathlessness), loss of appetite, and/or stomatitis (inflammation of mouth). Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

How MERTABTO TABLET Works

MERTABTO TABLET works by causing destruction to DNA and RNA of cancer cells which results in inhibition of growth and spread of cancerous (blood) cells in the body thus managing leukaemia in affected individuals.

warnings.details: MERTABTO TABLET is generally not recommended for use during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy since the medicine may cause harm to the foetus. Women of childbearing potential should use effective contraceptive methods to avoid getting pregnant while in management with MERTABTO TABLET which should be continued for next 3 months after stopping management with MERTABTO TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
MERTABTO TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
MERTABTO TABLET is unlikely to affect your ability to drive/operate machines. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.
MERTABTO TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking MERTABTO TABLET.

MERTABTO TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems such as hepatitis B (serious liver infection caused by Hepatitis B Virus). Consult your doctor before taking MERTABTO TABLET who may advice you for a weekly liver function test to assess your liver function.
Do not take MERTABTO TABLET if you are allergic to 6-mercaptopurine, azathioprine, and/or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

MERTABTO TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are scheduled for vaccination

Before taking MERTABTO TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have recently been vaccinated (especially with yellow fever vaccine)
Have a condition that cause body to produce low TPMT (thiopurine methyltransferase) enzyme (responsible to metabolize thiopurines class of drugs)
Are a man and planning for a baby (since this medicine may affect your sperm count)
Suffer from an inherited mutation of NUDT15 gene (essential for body's breakdown of mercaptopurine) associated with higher risk of infections and hair loss
Have/had shingles, chicken pox or hepatitis B infection (virus-induced liver disease)
Suffer from Lesch-Nyhan Syndrome (genetic disorder caused by a deficiency of hypoxanthine-guanine phosphoribosyltransferase enzyme) associated with symptoms such as impaired kidney function, acute gouty arthritis (joint paint), and/or self-mutilating behaviours (such as lip/finger biting)
Avoid exposure to sunlight
Suffer from certain type of arthritis

Use in Paediatrics:

MERTABTO TABLET should be used with caution in children (aged below 6 years/low body mass) since it may cause low blood sugar (associated with symptoms such as nausea, dizziness, confusion). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

Use in Geriatrics:

MERTABTO TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About CAPEGARD 500MG TABLET

CAPEGARD 500MG TABLET contains capecitabine, which belongs to the group of medicines called antineoplastic agents. It is used in the management of abnormal growth of cells present in the colon, rectal, gastric, and breast regions. It may be used either alone or in combination with other medicines.

CAPEGARD 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe liver or kidney disease. CAPEGARD 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease, kidney disease, heart problems, brain disease or nerve damage, diabetes, or a history of eye problems. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

CAPEGARD 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

CAPEGARD 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use by children and adolescents. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

The most common side effects of taking CAPEGARD 500MG TABLET are abdominal pain, rash, dry or itchy skin, tiredness, and loss of appetite. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: It inhibits the abnormal growth of cells present in the colon, rectal, gastric, and breast regions.

Uses Of CAPEGARD 500MG TABLET
It inhibits the abnormal growth of cells present in the colon, rectal, gastric, and breast regions.
mechanismOfAction:
How CAPEGARD 500MG TABLET Works

CAPEGARD 500MG TABLET is an antimetabolite that works by stopping the abnormal growth of cells. Thus, it helps manage the conditions associated with it.
usageDetails:
How to use CAPEGARD 500MG TABLET

Take CAPEGARD 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Take the medicine within 30 minutes after the end of a meal.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of CAPEGARD 500MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body surface area, and disease condition. Do not stop taking CAPEGARD 500MG TABLET unless your doctor has told you to.

Others

Previously had severe reactions to fluoropyrimidine therapy (a group of anticancer medicines such as fluorouracil)
Have severely low levels of white cells or platelets in the blood (leukopenia, neutropenia, or thrombocytopenia)
Have complete DPD deficiency (do not have any activity of the enzyme dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (DPD)
Are being managed now or have been managed in the last 4 weeks for herpes zoster (chickenpox or shingles) with brivudine

Before taking CAPEGARD 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have a partial deficiency in the activity of the enzyme dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (DPD)
Have a family member who has a partial or complete deficiency of the enzyme dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (DPD)
Have a brain disease (Ex. cancer that has spread to the brain) or nerve damage (neuropathy)
Have a calcium imbalance or other electrolyte imbalances
Have diabetes
Cannot keep food or water in your body because of severe nausea and vomiting
Have a history of eye problems
Have diarrhea
Are dehydrated
Have a severe skin reaction
Have intolerance to lactose or other sugars

Introduction About CYTODROX 500MG CAPSULE

CYTODROX 500MG CAPSULE contains Hydroxyurea, which belongs to a group of medicines called Antimetabolites. It is used to manage resistant chronic myeloid leukaemia and locally advanced squamous cell cancer of the head and neck (excluding the lip) and cervical cancer.

CYTODROX 500MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with a history of any blood problems or severe anaemia. CYTODROX 500MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with liver, lung or kidney disease and myelosuppression (leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, anaemia).

CYTODROX 500MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use during pregnancy. CYTODROX 500MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women. CYTODROX 500MG CAPSULE is also not recommended for use in children as its safety and effectiveness are not established. CYTODROX 500MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in the elderly aged 65 years or above.

The most common side effects of taking CYTODROX 500MG CAPSULE are loss of appetite, weakness, loss of energy, sickness, diarrhoea, constipation, abdominal pain, hair loss, blood disorders (decrease in white blood cells, red blood cells and platelets), low back pain, black tarry stools or blood in the stools, unusual bleeding or bruising, muscle weakness, sores on the lips or mouth etc. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage locally advanced squamous cell carcinomas of the head and neck, (excluding lip)
usesDetails:

Manage resistant chronic myeloid leukaemia

mechanismOfAction:
How CYTODROX 500MG CAPSULE Works

CYTODROX 500MG CAPSULE gets converted to free radical nitroxide (NO), which enters the cells, inactivates the ribonucleotide reductase enzyme and causes immediate inhibition of DNA synthesis, leading to cell death.

Take CYTODROX 500MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About POMALID 2MG CAPSULE

POMALID 2MG CAPSULE contains Pomalidomide which belongs to the group of medicines called Immunomodulating agents. It is used in adults to manage multiple myeloma (cancer of plasma cells). It is generally used in combination with other anti-cancer agents (such as dexamethasone and/or bortezomib) to achieve better results.

Before taking POMALID 2MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have high blood pressure, high blood cholesterol levels, blood clots or hepatitis B infection or have a habit of smoking as a precaution.

POMALID 2MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in women who are pregnant, think that they might be pregnant or planning to become pregnant. It should be used in breastfeeding women only if considered necessary by the physician.

Both men and women undergoing therapy with POMALID 2MG CAPSULE must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy prior to, during and until 4 weeks after stopping the therapy. Patients taking POMALID 2MG CAPSULE must not donate their blood during management and for 7 days after the end of management

The most common side effects of taking POMALID 2MG CAPSULE are increased infections, low RBC and platelet count, nausea, vomiting, swelling of body parts, numbness or tingling of body parts, skin rashes, oral sores, taste changes and weight loss. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Manage multiple myeloma (cancer of plasma cells) in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of POMALID 2MG CAPSULE
Manage multiple myeloma (cancer of plasma cells) in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How POMALID 2MG CAPSULE Works

POMALID 2MG CAPSULE stimulates the immune system to stop the growth of abnormal plasma cells (a type of white blood cells) in the blood. This helps in destroying the cancer cells in the blood and manages it from developing further. It also reduces blood supply to the cancer cells, which helps in managing further spread of cancer cells in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use POMALID 2MG CAPSULE

Take POMALID 2MG CAPSULE as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking POMALID 2MG CAPSULE unless your doctor tells you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About LENANGIO 10MG CAPSULE

LENANGIO 10MG CAPSULE contains Lenalidomide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Immunomodulatory agents. It is used in the management of multiple myeloma, myelodysplastic syndromes, mantle cell lymphoma and follicular lymphoma. Cancer is a disease in which abnormal cells divide uncontrollably in the body and destroy body tissue.

Multiple myeloma is a type of cancer that affects a type of white blood cell (plasma cell) that collects in the bone marrow and divides uncontrollably, leading to kidney and bone damage. Myelodysplastic syndromes are a group of disorders that occur due to the abnormal functioning of blood cells.

Mantle cell lymphoma is a cancer of the lymph tissue where the B-cells or B lymphocytes (white blood cells) grow in an uncontrolled manner and build up in the lymph tissue, blood or bone marrow. Follicular lymphoma is slow-growing cancer that affects B lymphocytes that help fight infection.

Before taking LENANGIO 10MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have ever had blood clots, hepatitis B infection, varicella-zoster, HIV, kidney problems or a heart attack. LENANGIO 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use among pregnant or breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking LENANGIO 10MG CAPSULE are rashes, itching, muscle cramps, muscle weakness, muscle pain, muscle aches, bone pain, joint pain, back pain, pain in the extremities, weakness, tiredness, constipation, diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain and heartburn. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LENANGIO 10MG CAPSULE

It is used to manage:

Multiple myeloma
Myelodysplastic syndromes
Mantle cell lymphoma
Follicular lymphoma
mechanismOfAction:
How LENANGIO 10MG CAPSULE Works

LENANGIO 10MG CAPSULE works by enhancing the immune system that indirectly attacks the cancer cells. It stops the growth of new blood vessels within the tumour. It also limits the production of chemical messengers (cytokine and growth factor) which are responsible for the growth of cancer cells.

Take LENANGIO 10MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

mechanismOfAction:
How FOLITRAX 10MG TABLET Works

FOLITRAX 10MG TABLET contains methotrexate that works by interfering with the growth of those cells in the body that reproduce quickly. As a result, the growth of those cells gets retarded, thus serving as an anti-tumour agent. Also, it decreases the undesired reactions of the body’s own immune-defense mechanism, thereby working as an effective immunosuppressant. Additionally, it also exhibits anti-inflammatory effects, thereby reducing pain, swelling, and redness. As a result, it manages the symptoms associated with diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis.
usageDetails:
How to use FOLITRAX 10MG TABLET

Take FOLITRAX 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Also, it is recommended to closely monitor the elderly, taking FOLITRAX 10MG TABLET for the identification of possible side effects. Consult the doctor before taking FOLITRAX 10MG TABLET.

Others

Have bone marrow disorders
Have blood disorders
Have an impaired immune system
Have a severe and/or existing infection (Ex. tuberculosis, HIV)
Have ulcers in the gastro-intestinal tract

Are receiving vaccinations containing live vaccines

Are overweight
Suffer from diarrhea
Ulcers in the colon (ulcerative colitis)
Are receiving radiotherapy for various conditions, such as X-rays and UV-rays
Have folate deficiency
Have lactose and/or galactose intolerance
Have mental illness

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking FOLITRAX 10MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. amoxicillin, ciprofloxacin)
Medicines used to increase urine excretion (Ex. frusemide)
Medicines used to manage increased sugar levels (Ex. metformin)
Medicines used to manage fits (Ex. phenytoin)
Medicines used to manage increased cholesterol levels (Ex. cholestyramine)
Medicines used to manage gout (Ex. probenecid)
Medicines to manage reduced folic acid levels (Ex. folic acid preparations)
Medicines used to manage severe heartburn or ulcers (Ex. omeprazole)
Other medicines used to manage rheumatoid arthritis (Ex. leflunomide)
Medicines that can be harmful to the liver (Ex. sulfasalazine)
Medicines used in the management of cancer (Ex. doxorubicin, cisplatin, and mercaptopurine)
Medicines used to manage pain (Ex. ibuprofen, naproxen, diclofenac)
Other medicines used to manage rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis (Ex. leflunomide, phenylbutazone, or amidopyrine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. theophylline)
Medicines used in organ transplantation (Ex. cyclosporin, azathioprine)
Medicines used to induce sleep (Ex. phenobarbitone)
Medicines used to induce calmness and relieve anxiety (Ex. diazepam)
Medicines used for oral contraception (Ex. estrogen)
Medicines used to manage skin conditions (Ex. retinoids)
Medicines used to manage malaria (Ex. pyrimethamine)
Medicines that contain live vaccines (Ex. MMR vaccine)
Medicines used for general anesthesia and pain relief (Ex. nitrous oxide)
Medicines used to manage heart problems (Ex. amiodarone)
Medicines used to manage heart failure (Ex. digoxin)
Medicines used for the management of various inflammatory conditions like skin diseases and allergic reactions (Ex. hydrocortisone)

B. Drug-Food interactions:

It is recommended to avoid the consumption of drinks containing caffeine, such as black tea, coffee, and soft drinks, along with FOLITRAX 10MG TABLET, to manage dehydration.

If you or someone else accidentally takes too much FOLITRAX 10MG TABLET, it is recommended to consult your doctor immediately. Symptoms of overdosage with FOLITRAX 10MG TABLET are an easy tendency to bruise or bleed, nausea, vomiting, and unusual weakness, along with the development of mouth sores and ulcers.

introduction:
Introduction About TEMOSIDE 100MG CAPSULE

TEMOSIDE 100MG CAPSULE contains Temozolomide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antineoplastic agents. It is used for specific forms of brain tumours in adults with newly diagnosed glioblastoma multiforme, which is used first together with radiotherapy as a concomitant phase of therapy and then used alone as a monotherapy. It is also used in children (above 3 years) and adults to manage malignant gliomas, such as glioblastoma multiforme or anaplastic astrocytoma, if they return or get worse after standard management.

Glioblastoma multiforme is an aggressive type of cancer that affects the brain or spinal cord and is generally characterized by symptoms such as headache, nausea, drowsiness, blurred vision, personality changes, and seizures.

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to take liver function tests to assess the hepatotoxicity and function of your liver. Before taking TEMOSIDE 100MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had a hepatitis B infection (serious liver infection).

TEMOSIDE 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have certain kinds of blood cells that are severely reduced, such as white blood cells and platelet count. TEMOSIDE 100MG CAPSULE should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary and not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. It is not recommended for use in children below 3 years of age and should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from 3 to 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking TEMOSIDE 100MG CAPSULE. The most common side effects of taking TEMOSIDE 100MG CAPSULE are loss of appetite, difficulty while speaking, headache, vomiting, nausea, diarrhea, and constipation. Consult and inform your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.

introduction:
Introduction About ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET

ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET contains Methotrexate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimetabolites. ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET is used to manage active rheumatoid arthritis in adults, which is a form of severe arthritis occurring due to unknown reasons (idiopathic) and old age and is non-responsive to conventional painkillers (such as Non-Steroidal Anti Inflammatory Drugs Ex. Aceclofenac).

ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET is also used to manage its polyarthritic forms (characterized by the involvement of five or more joints), which are severe, active, and idiopathic in nature and affect young people (Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis, JIA).

ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET is also used to manage psoriasis and relapsed (reoccurred) and refractory (unaffected by other conventional managements) Non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma, which is a type of cancer of the lymphatic system.

Psoriasis is a skin condition characterized by itchy scales that is not responsive to conventional managements such as phototherapy and retinoids.

Before taking ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET, it is recommended to inform the doctor about your medical and family history, including the list of medicines (prescription, non-prescription medicines, and herbal medicines) that are being taken.

Also, ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET is not recommended to be taken by pregnant and nursing women, women planning pregnancy, those who drink huge amounts of alcohol, or patients suffering from liver and kidney impairment.

ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET is not recommended in children for the management of psoriasis and rheumatoid arthritis. However, ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET can be used with caution in children to manage polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis, which is characterized by the involvement of five or more joints that are of severe, active, juvenile, and idiopathic character. Consult the doctor before taking ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET.

In addition, caution must be exercised by patients suffering from lung disorders, blood disorders, and gastric disorders before taking ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET.

Care must be taken to avoid taking products containing caffeine, such as black tea, coffee, and cold drinks, while taking ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET.

The common side effects seen after taking ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and altered levels of blood cells. Consult a doctor if any of the above side effects worsen after taking ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET Works

ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET contains methotrexate that works by interfering with the growth of those cells in the body that reproduce quickly. As a result, the growth of those cells gets retarded, thus serving as an anti-tumour agent. Also, it decreases the undesired reactions of the body’s own immune-defense mechanism, thereby working as an effective immunosuppressant. Additionally, it also exhibits anti-inflammatory effects, thereby reducing pain, swelling, and redness. As a result, it manages the symptoms associated with diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis.

ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET is not recommended if you feel tired or dizzy after taking the medicine. Consult your doctor before taking ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET.

ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET is recommended to be taken with caution if you have issues with lung function and are diagnosed with pleural effusion. Consult your doctor before taking ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET.

ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET is not recommended in children for the management of psoriasis and rheumatoid arthritis. However, ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET can be used with caution in children to manage polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis. Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depending on your child’s age, body weight, and health condition. Consult your doctor for advice before taking ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET.

ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET is recommended to be administered with caution and in a lower dosage to elders due to diminished function of the liver and kidneys and reduced folate levels in the blood in old age. Also, it is recommended to closely monitor the elderly, taking ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET for the identification of possible side effects. Consult the doctor before taking ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET.

Others

ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have bone marrow disorders
Have blood disorders
Have an impaired immune system
Have a severe and/or existing infection (Ex. tuberculosis, HIV)
Have ulcers in the gastro-intestinal tract
Have inflammation and ulcers of the mouth
Are receiving vaccinations containing live vaccines

Before taking ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have diabetes
Are overweight
Suffer from diarrhea
Ulcers in the colon (ulcerative colitis)
Are receiving radiotherapy for various conditions, such as X-rays and UV-rays
Have folate deficiency
Have lactose and/or galactose intolerance
Have mental illness

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. amoxicillin, ciprofloxacin)
Medicines used to increase urine excretion (Ex. frusemide)
Medicines used to manage increased sugar levels (Ex. metformin)
Medicines used to manage fits (Ex. phenytoin)
Medicines used to manage increased cholesterol levels (Ex. cholestyramine)
Medicines used to manage gout (Ex. probenecid)
Medicines to manage reduced folic acid levels (Ex. folic acid preparations)
Medicines used to manage severe heartburn or ulcers (Ex. omeprazole)
Other medicines used to manage rheumatoid arthritis (Ex. leflunomide)
Medicines that can be harmful to the liver (Ex. sulfasalazine)
Medicines used in the management of cancer (Ex. doxorubicin, cisplatin, and mercaptopurine)
Medicines used to manage pain (Ex. ibuprofen, naproxen, diclofenac)
Other medicines used to manage rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis (Ex. leflunomide, phenylbutazone, or amidopyrine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. theophylline)
Medicines used in organ transplantation (Ex. cyclosporin, azathioprine)
Medicines used to induce sleep (Ex. phenobarbitone)
Medicines used to induce calmness and relieve anxiety (Ex. diazepam)
Medicines used for oral contraception (Ex. estrogen)
Medicines used to manage skin conditions (Ex. retinoids)
Medicines used to manage malaria (Ex. pyrimethamine)
Medicines that contain live vaccines (Ex. MMR vaccine)
Medicines used for general anesthesia and pain relief (Ex. nitrous oxide)
Medicines used to manage heart problems (Ex. amiodarone)
Medicines used to manage heart failure (Ex. digoxin)
Medicines used for the management of various inflammatory conditions like skin diseases and allergic reactions (Ex. hydrocortisone)

B. Drug-Food interactions:

It is recommended to avoid the consumption of drinks containing caffeine, such as black tea, coffee, and soft drinks, along with ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET, to manage dehydration.

Overdosage:

If you or someone else accidentally takes too much ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET, it is recommended to consult your doctor immediately. Symptoms of overdosage with ONCOTREX 5MG TABLET are an easy tendency to bruise or bleed, nausea, vomiting, and unusual weakness, along with the development of mouth sores and ulcers.

introduction:
Introduction About LENANGIO 5MG CAPSULE

LENANGIO 5MG CAPSULE contains Lenalidomide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Immunomodulatory agents. It is used in the management of multiple myeloma, myelodysplastic syndromes, mantle cell lymphoma and follicular lymphoma. Cancer is a disease in which abnormal cells divide uncontrollably in the body and destroy body tissue.

Multiple myeloma is a type of cancer that affects a type of white blood cell (plasma cell) that collects in the bone marrow and divides uncontrollably, leading to kidney and bone damage. Myelodysplastic syndromes are a group of disorders that occur due to the abnormal functioning of blood cells.

Mantle cell lymphoma is a cancer of the lymph tissue where the B-cells or B lymphocytes (white blood cells) grow in an uncontrolled manner and build up in the lymph tissue, blood or bone marrow. Follicular lymphoma is slow-growing cancer that affects B lymphocytes that help fight infection.

Before taking LENANGIO 5MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have ever had blood clots, hepatitis B infection, varicella-zoster, HIV, kidney problems or a heart attack. LENANGIO 5MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use among pregnant or breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking LENANGIO 5MG CAPSULE are rashes, itching, muscle cramps, muscle weakness, muscle pain, muscle aches, bone pain, joint pain, back pain, pain in the extremities, weakness, tiredness, constipation, diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain and heartburn. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LENANGIO 5MG CAPSULE

It is used to manage:

Multiple myeloma
Myelodysplastic syndromes
Mantle cell lymphoma
Follicular lymphoma
mechanismOfAction:
How LENANGIO 5MG CAPSULE Works

LENANGIO 5MG CAPSULE works by enhancing the immune system that indirectly attacks the cancer cells. It stops the growth of new blood vessels within the tumour. It also limits the production of chemical messengers (cytokine and growth factor) which are responsible for the growth of cancer cells.
usageDetails:
How to use LENANGIO 5MG CAPSULE

Take LENANGIO 5MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ENZYL 80MG CAPSULE

ENZYL 80MG CAPSULE contains Enzalutamide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Androgen receptor inhibitors. It is used to manage adult men with prostate cancer who no longer respond to hormone therapy or surgical management or if the cancer, despite responding to management, has spread to other parts of the body.

Prostate cancer occurs in the prostate gland (a gland in males that produces the seminal fluid to transport sperm). Symptoms include problems while urinating (difficulty, decreased force, or blood in the urine), blood in the semen, bone pain, erectile dysfunction, and weight loss.

Enzalutamide acts by blocking the activity of hormones called androgens (such as testosterone). By blocking androgens, it stops the growth of prostate cancer cells and can further induce cancer cell death and tumour regression.

Before taking ENZYL 80MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, or heart conditions like arrhythmia (heart rhythm problem). ENZYL 80MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ENZYL 80MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking ENZYL 80MG CAPSULE are tiredness, broken bones, hot flushes, high blood pressure, headaches, feeling anxious, dry skin, itching, difficulty remembering, and breast enlargement in men. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About INVISTA 70MG TABLET

INVISTA 70MG TABLET contains Dasatinib which belongs to the group of medicines called Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors. It is used to manage cancers of blood and bone marrow (such as chronic myeloid leukaemia (CML) and philadelphia chromosome positive (Ph+) acute lymphoblastic leukaemia) in adults, adolescents and in children (aged 1 year or above).

It is primarily used in patients when management with conventional therapies is not suitable or fails to provide adequate response.   

Leukaemia is the cancer of white blood cells. It is caused due to abnormal growth and multiplication of blood cells within the bone marrow. It is characterized by severe tiredness, breathlessness, increased bleeding tendency, tiredness, anemia, night sweats, fever, chills, frequent infections and weight loss.

During management with INVISTA 70MG TABLET your doctor will closely monitor your health condition through several blood tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking INVISTA 70MG TABLET as it may increase the risk of side effects.

Before taking INVISTA 70MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have or at risk of developing hepatitis C infection as a precaution.

Avoid concomitant use of antacids or any stomach medicines along with INVISTA 70MG TABLET. Leave a time gap of at least 2 hours between the medicines. INVISTA 70MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women.

Men and women taking INVISTA 70MG TABLET must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with INVISTA 70MG TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking INVISTA 70MG TABLET are increased bleeding tendency, increased infections, feeling tired or weak, nausea, vomiting, hair loss, mouth ulcers, changes in taste, inflammation of the food pipe or stomach, muscle pain or spasm, skin rashes, headache, dizziness and weight loss. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Cancers of blood and bone marrow (such as chronic myeloid leukaemia and philadelphia chromosome positive (Ph+) acute lymphoblastic leukaemia)

mechanismOfAction:
How INVISTA 70MG TABLET Works

INVISTA 70MG TABLET is an anti-cancer medicine. It works by blocking the actions of certain proteins (such as BCR-ABL, Src kinase, etc.) in the body that triggers cancer formation. As a result, it reduces abnormal growth and multiplication of cancer cells in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use INVISTA 70MG TABLET

Take INVISTA 70MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without meals. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Try to take INVISTA 70MG TABLET at the same time each day. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking INVISTA 70MG TABLET unless advised by your doctor.

name: AZAFAB 100mg Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About AZAFAB 100MG INJECTION

AZAFAB 100MG INJECTION is used in adults in the management of all sub-types of myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS, a group of cancers associated with blood and bone marrow), and certain types of blood cancer known as chronic myelomonocytic leukemia (CMML) and acute myeloid leukemia (AML).

It contains a medicine called Azacitidine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer agents. It works by blocking certain enzymes that affect DNA in cancer cells, which helps stop their growth and encourages them to die.

CMML is a type of blood cancer where the bone marrow releases an excess amount of monocytes (a type of blood cell) into the blood stream, whereas in AML, the bone marrow releases an excess amount of immature white blood cells. Both are characterized by recurrent infections, fever, tiredness, and increased bleeding or bruising.

AZAFAB 100MG INJECTION is typically used in adults who cannot undergo stem cell transplantation. Before receiving this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney, or heart problems.

AZAFAB 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. Both men and women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with this medicine. Men may seek advice on sperm preservation, if necessary, prior to therapy with this medicine.

The most common side effects of receiving AZAFAB 100MG INJECTION are increased bleeding, increased infections, tiredness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, loss of appetite, stomach pain, weakness, pain and redness at the site of injection, sore nose and throat, cold sores, headache, dizziness, trouble sleeping, weight loss, ulcers of the mouth or tongue, and hair loss. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

Acute myeloid leukemia (AML; blood cancer of the WBC)

mechanismOfAction:
How AZAFAB 100MG INJECTION Works

AZAFAB 100MG INJECTION is an anticancer medication. It works by blocking the actions of certain enzymes (DNA/RNA methyltransferase) within the cancer cells that are required for the cells to grow and multiply. It also reduces the production of new genetic material (RNA and DNA) within the cells. As a result, it manages abnormal cell division within the body, slows down the growth of cancer cells, and helps the bone marrow produce normal blood cells.

name: ORGONIST Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ORGONIST TABLET

ORGONIST Tablet is a prescription medicine used in adults for the management of advanced prostate cancer. It contains a medicine called Relugolix which is a gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) receptor antagonist. It works by suppressing your body from producing excess testosterone (a male hormone) which result in prostate cancer growth and development.

Take ORGONIST Tablet as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. Do not stop taking ORGONIST Tablet without consulting your doctor. Before taking ORGONIST Tablet inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have osteoporosis or heart rhythm disorders as a precaution.

There is no proper information regarding the use of ORGONIST Tablet in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice. ORGONIST Tablet may impair fertility in men. Therefore, talk to your doctor regarding semen storage. Men who have pregnant partners or partners with childbearing potential must use an effective contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy during therapy with ORGONIST Tablet and until 2 weeks after the last dose.

The most common side effects of taking ORGONIST Tablet are hot flushes, tiredness, constipation, diarrhea, weight gain, decreased sex drive, erectile dysfunction, increased blood sugar and fat levels, muscle and joint pain and low blood haemoglobin levels. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Management of advanced prostate cancer in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of ORGONIST TABLET
Management of advanced prostate cancer in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How ORGONIST TABLET Works

ORGONIST Tablet contains a medicine called Relugolix which reduces the growth and division of prostate cancer cells. It works by blocking a step in the cell division process that signals the testes to produce testosterone. Since prostate cancer is caused due to abnormal and excess release of testosterone, this action of Relugolix prevents prostate cancer cells from growing and dividing.
usageDetails:
How to use ORGONIST TABLET

Take ORGONIST Tablet as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. ORGONIST Tablet can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you based on your age, body weight, and health condition. Do not stop taking ORGONIST Tablet without consulting your doctor.

More Information

Prostate cancer is a type of cancer that develops in the prostate gland, which is part of the male reproductive system. The prostate is a small, walnut-sized gland located below the bladder and in front of the rectum, responsible for producing seminal fluid that nourishes and transports sperm.

Prostate cancer often grows slowly and may initially be confined to the prostate gland, where it may not cause serious harm. However, some types can be aggressive and spread quickly to other parts of the body, including the bones and lymph nodes. Symptoms can include difficulty urinating, blood in the urine, pelvic discomfort, and erectile dysfunction, although early stages may not present noticeable symptoms. Regular screening and early detection through methods like PSA (prostate-specific antigen) tests and digital rectal exams are crucial for effective management.

introduction:
Introduction About EZAPRO 160 TABLET

EZAPRO 160 TABLET contains Enzalutamide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Androgen receptor inhibitors. It is used to manage adult men with prostate cancer who no longer respond to hormone therapy or surgical management or if the cancer, despite responding to management, has spread to other parts of the body.

Prostate cancer occurs in the prostate gland (a gland in males that produces the seminal fluid to transport sperm). Symptoms include problems while urinating (difficulty, decreased force, or blood in the urine), blood in the semen, bone pain, erectile dysfunction, and weight loss.

Enzalutamide acts by blocking the activity of hormones called androgens (such as testosterone). By blocking androgens, it stops the growth of prostate cancer cells and can further induce cancer cell death and tumour regression.

Before taking EZAPRO 160 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, or heart conditions like arrhythmia (heart rhythm problem). EZAPRO 160 TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. EZAPRO 160 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking EZAPRO 160 TABLET are tiredness, broken bones, hot flushes, high blood pressure, headaches, feeling anxious, dry skin, itching, difficulty remembering, and breast enlargement in men. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About MEDITREX 2.5 TABLET

MEDITREX 2.5 TABLET contains Methotrexate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimetabolites. MEDITREX 2.5 TABLET is used to manage active rheumatoid arthritis in adults, which is a form of severe arthritis occurring due to unknown reasons (idiopathic) and old age and is non-responsive to conventional painkillers (such as Non-Steroidal Anti Inflammatory Drugs Ex. Aceclofenac).

MEDITREX 2.5 TABLET is also used to manage its polyarthritic forms (characterized by the involvement of five or more joints), which are severe, active, and idiopathic in nature and affect young people (Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis, JIA).

MEDITREX 2.5 TABLET is also used to manage psoriasis and relapsed (reoccurred) and refractory (unaffected by other conventional managements) Non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma, which is a type of cancer of the lymphatic system.

Psoriasis is a skin condition characterized by itchy scales that is not responsive to conventional managements such as phototherapy and retinoids.

Before taking MEDITREX 2.5 TABLET, it is recommended to inform the doctor about your medical and family history, including the list of medicines (prescription, non-prescription medicines, and herbal medicines) that are being taken.

Also, MEDITREX 2.5 TABLET is not recommended to be taken by pregnant and nursing women, women planning pregnancy, those who drink huge amounts of alcohol, or patients suffering from liver and kidney impairment.

MEDITREX 2.5 TABLET is not recommended in children for the management of psoriasis and rheumatoid arthritis. However, MEDITREX 2.5 TABLET can be used with caution in children to manage polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis, which is characterized by the involvement of five or more joints that are of severe, active, juvenile, and idiopathic character. Consult the doctor before taking MEDITREX 2.5 TABLET.

In addition, caution must be exercised by patients suffering from lung disorders, blood disorders, and gastric disorders before taking MEDITREX 2.5 TABLET.

Care must be taken to avoid taking products containing caffeine, such as black tea, coffee, and cold drinks, while taking MEDITREX 2.5 TABLET.

The common side effects seen after taking MEDITREX 2.5 TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and altered levels of blood cells. Consult a doctor if any of the above side effects worsen after taking MEDITREX 2.5 TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How MEDITREX 2.5 TABLET Works

MEDITREX 2.5 TABLET contains methotrexate that works by interfering with the growth of those cells in the body that reproduce quickly. As a result, the growth of those cells gets retarded, thus serving as an anti-tumour agent. Also, it decreases the undesired reactions of the body’s own immune-defense mechanism, thereby working as an effective immunosuppressant. Additionally, it also exhibits anti-inflammatory effects, thereby reducing pain, swelling, and redness. As a result, it manages the symptoms associated with diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis.

Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. amoxicillin, ciprofloxacin)
Medicines used to increase urine excretion (Ex. frusemide)

introduction:
Introduction About FOLITRAX 25MG INJECTION

FOLITRAX 25MG INJECTION contains Methotrexate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimetabolites. FOLITRAX 25MG INJECTION is used to manage active rheumatoid arthritis in adults. It is also used to manage polyarthritic forms (characterized by the involvement of five or more joints), which are severe, active, and idiopathic in nature and affect young people (Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis, or JIA). FOLITRAX 25MG INJECTION is also used to manage psoriasis.

In addition, FOLITRAX 25MG INJECTION is also used to manage Crohn’s disease and various cancers such as acute lymphocytic lymphoma, Non-Hodgkin’s Lymphoma, breast cancer, cervical cancer, bladder cancer, etc.

Rheumatoid arthritis is an autoimmune and inflammatory disease, which means that your immune system attacks healthy cells in your body by mistake, causing inflammation (painful swelling) in the affected parts of the body. Psoriasis is a skin condition characterized by itchy scales that is not responsive to conventional managements such as phototherapy and retinoids. Crohn’s disease is an inflammatory disease affecting the intestine.

Before getting FOLITRAX 25MG INJECTION administered, it is recommended to inform the doctor about your medical and family history, including the list of medicines (prescription, non-prescription medicines, and herbal medicines) that are being taken, before receiving FOLITRAX 25MG INJECTION.

Also, FOLITRAX 25MG INJECTION is not recommended for children less than the age of 3, pregnant and nursing women, women planning pregnancy, those who drink huge amounts of alcohol, and patients suffering from liver and kidney impairment.

Caution must be exercised by patients suffering from lung disorders, blood disorders, and gastric disorders before receiving FOLITRAX 25MG INJECTION. Care must be taken to avoid taking products containing caffeine, such as black tea, coffee, and cold drinks, while receiving FOLITRAX 25MG INJECTION.

The common side effects that can be experienced after receiving FOLITRAX 25MG INJECTION are headache, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and altered levels of blood cells. Consult a doctor if any of the above side effects worsen after receiving FOLITRAX 25MG INJECTION.

mechanismOfAction:
How FOLITRAX 25MG INJECTION Works

FOLITRAX 25MG INJECTION contains Methotrexate, a disease-modifying antirheumatic drug (DMARDs) which interferes with the growth of those cells in the body that reproduce quickly. As a result, the growth of those cells gets retarded, thus serving as an anti-tumour agent. Also, FOLITRAX 25MG INJECTION decreases the undesired reactions of the body’s own immune-defense mechanism, thereby working as an effective immunosuppressant. In addition, it also exhibits anti-inflammatory effects, thereby reducing pain, swelling, and redness. As a result, FOLITRAX 25MG INJECTION manages the symptoms associated with diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis.

FOLITRAX 25MG INJECTION will be administered to you into a muscle (intramuscularly) only by a doctor or a nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: Temoside 20mg Capsule 5'S
introduction:
Introduction About TEMOSIDE 20MG CAPSULE

TEMOSIDE 20MG CAPSULE contains Temozolomide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antineoplastic agents. It is used for specific forms of brain tumours in adults with newly diagnosed glioblastoma multiforme, which is used first together with radiotherapy as a concomitant phase of therapy and then used alone as a monotherapy. It is also used in children (above 3 years) and adults to manage malignant gliomas, such as glioblastoma multiforme or anaplastic astrocytoma, if they return or get worse after standard management.

Glioblastoma multiforme is an aggressive type of cancer that affects the brain or spinal cord and is generally characterized by symptoms such as headache, nausea, drowsiness, blurred vision, personality changes, and seizures.

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to take liver function tests to assess the hepatotoxicity and function of your liver. Before taking TEMOSIDE 20MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had a hepatitis B infection (serious liver infection).

TEMOSIDE 20MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have certain kinds of blood cells that are severely reduced, such as white blood cells and platelet count. TEMOSIDE 20MG CAPSULE should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary and not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. It is not recommended for use in children below 3 years of age and should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from 3 to 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking TEMOSIDE 20MG CAPSULE. The most common side effects of taking TEMOSIDE 20MG CAPSULE are loss of appetite, difficulty while speaking, headache, vomiting, nausea, diarrhea, and constipation. Consult and inform your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.
uses: Specific forms of brain tumours in newly diagnosed glioblastoma multiforme (in adults)
Malignant glioma, such as glioblastoma multiforme or anaplastic astrocytoma (in adults and children)

mechanismOfAction:
How TEMOSIDE 20MG CAPSULE Works

TEMOSIDE 20MG CAPSULE works by damaging the genetic material (DNA and RNA) of the cancer cells inside the brain cells and works against the cell growth and multiplication.

introduction:
Introduction About COMBINIB 250MG TABLET

COMBINIB 250MG TABLET contains Lapatinib which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer agents. It is used to manage metastatic breast cancer (cancer that has been spread to other parts of the body from breast). It is mostly used in combination with other anticancer or hormonal medicines (such as capecitabine, trastuzumab or anastrozole) to achieve better results.

COMBINIB 250MG TABLET can be taken either one hour before or one hour after food. During management with COMBINIB 250MG TABLET, your doctor will periodically monitor your heart, liver, kidney and lung functions as a precaution.

Before taking COMBINIB 250MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diarrhea before taking this medicine.

Do not take COMBINIB 250MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking COMBINIB 250MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, weakness, indigestion, constipation, sore mouth, trouble sleeping, back pain, joint pain, headache, hot flushes, hair loss, nail disorder and abnormal heartbeat. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of COMBINIB 250MG TABLET
Manage metastatic breast cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How COMBINIB 250MG TABLET Works

COMBINIB 250MG TABLET is an anticancer agent. It works by blocking the actions of certain cellular proteins (tyrosine kinase) that triggers cancer cell formation. It also blocks various downstream cell signalling pathways that triggers cancer growth within the body. As a result, it reduces cancer formation and manages its further growth within the body.
usageDetails:
How to use COMBINIB 250MG TABLET

Take COMBINIB 250MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. COMBINIB 250MG TABLET can be taken either one hour before or one hour after food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take COMBINIB 250MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About FOLITRAX 5MG TABLET

FOLITRAX 5MG TABLET contains Methotrexate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimetabolites. FOLITRAX 5MG TABLET is used to manage active rheumatoid arthritis in adults, which is a form of severe arthritis occurring due to unknown reasons (idiopathic) and old age and is non-responsive to conventional painkillers (such as Non-Steroidal Anti Inflammatory Drugs Ex. Aceclofenac).

FOLITRAX 5MG TABLET is also used to manage its polyarthritic forms (characterized by the involvement of five or more joints), which are severe, active, and idiopathic in nature and affect young people (Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis, JIA).

FOLITRAX 5MG TABLET is also used to manage psoriasis and relapsed (reoccurred) and refractory (unaffected by other conventional managements) Non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma, which is a type of cancer of the lymphatic system.

Psoriasis is a skin condition characterized by itchy scales that is not responsive to conventional managements such as phototherapy and retinoids.

Before taking FOLITRAX 5MG TABLET, it is recommended to inform the doctor about your medical and family history, including the list of medicines (prescription, non-prescription medicines, and herbal medicines) that are being taken.

Also, FOLITRAX 5MG TABLET is not recommended to be taken by pregnant and nursing women, women planning pregnancy, those who drink huge amounts of alcohol, or patients suffering from liver and kidney impairment.

FOLITRAX 5MG TABLET is not recommended in children for the management of psoriasis and rheumatoid arthritis. However, FOLITRAX 5MG TABLET can be used with caution in children to manage polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis, which is characterized by the involvement of five or more joints that are of severe, active, juvenile, and idiopathic character. Consult the doctor before taking FOLITRAX 5MG TABLET.

In addition, caution must be exercised by patients suffering from lung disorders, blood disorders, and gastric disorders before taking FOLITRAX 5MG TABLET.

Care must be taken to avoid taking products containing caffeine, such as black tea, coffee, and cold drinks, while taking FOLITRAX 5MG TABLET.

The common side effects seen after taking FOLITRAX 5MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and altered levels of blood cells. Consult a doctor if any of the above side effects worsen after taking FOLITRAX 5MG TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How FOLITRAX 5MG TABLET Works

FOLITRAX 5MG TABLET contains methotrexate that works by interfering with the growth of those cells in the body that reproduce quickly. As a result, the growth of those cells gets retarded, thus serving as an anti-tumour agent. Also, it decreases the undesired reactions of the body’s own immune-defense mechanism, thereby working as an effective immunosuppressant. Additionally, it also exhibits anti-inflammatory effects, thereby reducing pain, swelling, and redness. As a result, it manages the symptoms associated with diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis.

Take FOLITRAX 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking FOLITRAX 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. amoxicillin, ciprofloxacin)
Medicines used to increase urine excretion (Ex. frusemide)
Medicines used to manage increased sugar levels (Ex. metformin)
Medicines used to manage fits (Ex. phenytoin)
Medicines used to manage increased cholesterol levels (Ex. cholestyramine)
Medicines used to manage gout (Ex. probenecid)
Medicines to manage reduced folic acid levels (Ex. folic acid preparations)
Medicines used to manage severe heartburn or ulcers (Ex. omeprazole)
Other medicines used to manage rheumatoid arthritis (Ex. leflunomide)
Medicines that can be harmful to the liver (Ex. sulfasalazine)
Medicines used in the management of cancer (Ex. doxorubicin, cisplatin, and mercaptopurine)
Medicines used to manage pain (Ex. ibuprofen, naproxen, diclofenac)
Other medicines used to manage rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis (Ex. leflunomide, phenylbutazone, or amidopyrine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. theophylline)
Medicines used in organ transplantation (Ex. cyclosporin, azathioprine)
Medicines used to induce sleep (Ex. phenobarbitone)
Medicines used to induce calmness and relieve anxiety (Ex. diazepam)
Medicines used for oral contraception (Ex. estrogen)
Medicines used to manage skin conditions (Ex. retinoids)
Medicines used to manage malaria (Ex. pyrimethamine)
Medicines that contain live vaccines (Ex. MMR vaccine)
Medicines used for general anesthesia and pain relief (Ex. nitrous oxide)
Medicines used to manage heart problems (Ex. amiodarone)
Medicines used to manage heart failure (Ex. digoxin)
Medicines used for the management of various inflammatory conditions like skin diseases and allergic reactions (Ex. hydrocortisone)

B. Drug-Food interactions:

It is recommended to avoid the consumption of drinks containing caffeine, such as black tea, coffee, and soft drinks, along with FOLITRAX 5MG TABLET, to manage dehydration.

Overdosage:

If you or someone else accidentally takes too much FOLITRAX 5MG TABLET, it is recommended to consult your doctor immediately. Symptoms of overdosage with FOLITRAX 5MG TABLET are an easy tendency to bruise or bleed, nausea, vomiting, and unusual weakness, along with the development of mouth sores and ulcers.

introduction:
Introduction About MEXATE 2.5MG TABLET

MEXATE 2.5MG TABLET contains Methotrexate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimetabolites. MEXATE 2.5MG TABLET is used to manage active rheumatoid arthritis in adults, which is a form of severe arthritis occurring due to unknown reasons (idiopathic) and old age and is non-responsive to conventional painkillers (such as Non-Steroidal Anti Inflammatory Drugs Ex. Aceclofenac).

MEXATE 2.5MG TABLET is also used to manage its polyarthritic forms (characterized by the involvement of five or more joints), which are severe, active, and idiopathic in nature and affect young people (Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis, JIA).

MEXATE 2.5MG TABLET is also used to manage psoriasis and relapsed (reoccurred) and refractory (unaffected by other conventional managements) Non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma, which is a type of cancer of the lymphatic system.

Psoriasis is a skin condition characterized by itchy scales that is not responsive to conventional managements such as phototherapy and retinoids.

Before taking MEXATE 2.5MG TABLET, it is recommended to inform the doctor about your medical and family history, including the list of medicines (prescription, non-prescription medicines, and herbal medicines) that are being taken.

Also, MEXATE 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended to be taken by pregnant and nursing women, women planning pregnancy, those who drink huge amounts of alcohol, or patients suffering from liver and kidney impairment.

MEXATE 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended in children for the management of psoriasis and rheumatoid arthritis. However, MEXATE 2.5MG TABLET can be used with caution in children to manage polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis, which is characterized by the involvement of five or more joints that are of severe, active, juvenile, and idiopathic character. Consult the doctor before taking MEXATE 2.5MG TABLET.

In addition, caution must be exercised by patients suffering from lung disorders, blood disorders, and gastric disorders before taking MEXATE 2.5MG TABLET.

Care must be taken to avoid taking products containing caffeine, such as black tea, coffee, and cold drinks, while taking MEXATE 2.5MG TABLET.

The common side effects seen after taking MEXATE 2.5MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and altered levels of blood cells. Consult a doctor if any of the above side effects worsen after taking MEXATE 2.5MG TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How MEXATE 2.5MG TABLET Works

MEXATE 2.5MG TABLET contains methotrexate that works by interfering with the growth of those cells in the body that reproduce quickly. As a result, the growth of those cells gets retarded, thus serving as an anti-tumour agent. Also, it decreases the undesired reactions of the body’s own immune-defense mechanism, thereby working as an effective immunosuppressant. Additionally, it also exhibits anti-inflammatory effects, thereby reducing pain, swelling, and redness. As a result, it manages the symptoms associated with diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis.

How to use MEXATE 2.5MG TABLET

Take MEXATE 2.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About MEXATE 7.5MG TABLET

MEXATE 7.5MG TABLET contains Methotrexate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimetabolites. MEXATE 7.5MG TABLET is used to manage active rheumatoid arthritis in adults, which is a form of severe arthritis occurring due to unknown reasons (idiopathic) and old age and is non-responsive to conventional painkillers (such as Non-Steroidal Anti Inflammatory Drugs Ex. Aceclofenac).

MEXATE 7.5MG TABLET is also used to manage its polyarthritic forms (characterized by the involvement of five or more joints), which are severe, active, and idiopathic in nature and affect young people (Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis, JIA).

MEXATE 7.5MG TABLET is also used to manage psoriasis and relapsed (reoccurred) and refractory (unaffected by other conventional managements) Non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma, which is a type of cancer of the lymphatic system.

Psoriasis is a skin condition characterized by itchy scales that is not responsive to conventional managements such as phototherapy and retinoids.

Before taking MEXATE 7.5MG TABLET, it is recommended to inform the doctor about your medical and family history, including the list of medicines (prescription, non-prescription medicines, and herbal medicines) that are being taken.

Also, MEXATE 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended to be taken by pregnant and nursing women, women planning pregnancy, those who drink huge amounts of alcohol, or patients suffering from liver and kidney impairment.

MEXATE 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended in children for the management of psoriasis and rheumatoid arthritis. However, MEXATE 7.5MG TABLET can be used with caution in children to manage polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis, which is characterized by the involvement of five or more joints that are of severe, active, juvenile, and idiopathic character. Consult the doctor before taking MEXATE 7.5MG TABLET.

In addition, caution must be exercised by patients suffering from lung disorders, blood disorders, and gastric disorders before taking MEXATE 7.5MG TABLET.

Care must be taken to avoid taking products containing caffeine, such as black tea, coffee, and cold drinks, while taking MEXATE 7.5MG TABLET.

The common side effects seen after taking MEXATE 7.5MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and altered levels of blood cells. Consult a doctor if any of the above side effects worsen after taking MEXATE 7.5MG TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How MEXATE 7.5MG TABLET Works

MEXATE 7.5MG TABLET contains methotrexate that works by interfering with the growth of those cells in the body that reproduce quickly. As a result, the growth of those cells gets retarded, thus serving as an anti-tumour agent. Also, it decreases the undesired reactions of the body’s own immune-defense mechanism, thereby working as an effective immunosuppressant. Additionally, it also exhibits anti-inflammatory effects, thereby reducing pain, swelling, and redness. As a result, it manages the symptoms associated with diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis.
usageDetails:
How to use MEXATE 7.5MG TABLET

Take MEXATE 7.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About IRINOTEL 100MG INJECTION

IRINOTEL 100MG INJECTION contains Irinotecan which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer agents. It is used to manage advanced or metastatic colorectal cancer (cancers of colon and rectum). It can also be used to manage colorectal cancer among patients whose disease has recurred or progressed following initial chemotherapy with 5-Fluorouracil.

IRINOTEL 100MG INJECTION is mostly used in combination with other anticancer medicines to achieve better results. Before receiving IRINOTEL 100MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have hypertension or any other heart problems.

You must also inform your doctor if you have high blood cholesterol levels, elevated bilirubin levels in the blood or any inflammation in the gut as a precaution. IRINOTEL 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women as it may harm the growing baby.

Both men and women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with this medicine. Men may seek advice on sperm preservation, if necessary, prior to the therapy with this medicine.

IRINOTEL 100MG INJECTION may cause severe nausea, vomiting and diarrhea. To manage this, your doctor will prescribe a suitable anti-emetic and antidiarrheal medicines along with this medicine. However, inform your doctor immediately if these side effects worsen.

Other most common side effects of receiving IRINOTEL 100MG INJECTION are stomach pain mouth ulcers, hair loss, tiredness, weakness, increased infections, increased bleeding tendency and difficulty in passing stools. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Manage advanced or metastatic cancers of colon or rectum
usesDetails:
Uses Of IRINOTEL 100MG INJECTION
Manage advanced or metastatic cancers of colon or rectum
mechanismOfAction:
How IRINOTEL 100MG INJECTION Works

IRINOTEL 100MG INJECTION is an anticancer medication. It works by blocking the actions of certain enzymes (DNA-Topoisomerase-1) within the cells which is required for the cells to grow and multiply. As a result, it manages abnormal cell division and slows down the growth and spread of cancer cells within the body.
usageDetails:
How to use IRINOTEL 100MG INJECTION

IRINOTEL 100MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (as an intravenous infusion).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

IRINOTEL 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.

Others

IRINOTEL 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have any inflammation in the bowel for a prolonged period
Have any obstructions or block in the gut
Have elevated bilirubin levels in the blood
Have severe bone marrow failure
Are in a poor general condition
Are taking an herbal medicine called St. John’s Wort for mental illnesses
Recently got vaccinated with a live attenuated vaccine (Ex. vaccine for chicken pox, shingles, measles, mumps, rubella, tuberculosis, rotavirus, influenza)

Inform your doctor, before receiving IRINOTEL 100MG INJECTION, if you:

Have Gilbert’s syndrome (an inherited condition that causes elevated bilirubin levels and jaundice)
Have a habit of smoking
Have high blood cholesterol levels
Are scheduled for any surgeries (including minor dental surgeries)

Medicines used to suppress your body’s immune system and to manage transplant rejection (such as cyclosporine and tacrolimus)

Medicines used for relaxing muscles during surgeries (Ex. suxamethonium)
Laxatives (used to soften stools) such as lactulose
