introduction:
Introduction About DERMOTREX 10MG TABLET

DERMOTREX 10MG TABLET contains Methotrexate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimetabolites. DERMOTREX 10MG TABLET is used to manage active rheumatoid arthritis in adults, which is a form of severe arthritis occurring due to unknown reasons (idiopathic) and old age and is non-responsive to conventional painkillers (such as Non-Steroidal Anti Inflammatory Drugs Ex. Aceclofenac).

DERMOTREX 10MG TABLET is also used to manage its polyarthritic forms (characterized by the involvement of five or more joints), which are severe, active, and idiopathic in nature and affect young people (Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis, JIA).

DERMOTREX 10MG TABLET is also used to manage psoriasis and relapsed (reoccurred) and refractory (unaffected by other conventional managements) Non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma, which is a type of cancer of the lymphatic system.

Psoriasis is a skin condition characterized by itchy scales that is not responsive to conventional managements such as phototherapy and retinoids.

Before taking DERMOTREX 10MG TABLET, it is recommended to inform the doctor about your medical and family history, including the list of medicines (prescription, non-prescription medicines, and herbal medicines) that are being taken.

Also, DERMOTREX 10MG TABLET is not recommended to be taken by pregnant and nursing women, women planning pregnancy, those who drink huge amounts of alcohol, or patients suffering from liver and kidney impairment.

DERMOTREX 10MG TABLET is not recommended in children for the management of psoriasis and rheumatoid arthritis. However, DERMOTREX 10MG TABLET can be used with caution in children to manage polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis, which is characterized by the involvement of five or more joints that are of severe, active, juvenile, and idiopathic character. Consult the doctor before taking DERMOTREX 10MG TABLET.

In addition, caution must be exercised by patients suffering from lung disorders, blood disorders, and gastric disorders before taking DERMOTREX 10MG TABLET.

Care must be taken to avoid taking products containing caffeine, such as black tea, coffee, and cold drinks, while taking DERMOTREX 10MG TABLET.

The common side effects seen after taking DERMOTREX 10MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and altered levels of blood cells. Consult a doctor if any of the above side effects worsen after taking DERMOTREX 10MG TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How DERMOTREX 10MG TABLET Works

DERMOTREX 10MG TABLET contains methotrexate that works by interfering with the growth of those cells in the body that reproduce quickly. As a result, the growth of those cells gets retarded, thus serving as an anti-tumour agent. Also, it decreases the undesired reactions of the body’s own immune-defense mechanism, thereby working as an effective immunosuppressant. Additionally, it also exhibits anti-inflammatory effects, thereby reducing pain, swelling, and redness. As a result, it manages the symptoms associated with diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis.

Take DERMOTREX 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

mechanismOfAction:
How MEXATE 10 TABLET Works

MEXATE 10 TABLET contains methotrexate that works by interfering with the growth of those cells in the body that reproduce quickly. As a result, the growth of those cells gets retarded, thus serving as an anti-tumour agent. Also, it decreases the undesired reactions of the body’s own immune-defense mechanism, thereby working as an effective immunosuppressant. Additionally, it also exhibits anti-inflammatory effects, thereby reducing pain, swelling, and redness. As a result, it manages the symptoms associated with diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis.

Take MEXATE 10 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ABRETONE 250MG TABLET

ABRETONE 250MG TABLET contains Abiraterone, which belongs to a group of medicines called Androgen biosynthesis inhibitors. ABRETONE 250MG TABLET is used with prednisone or prednisolone in adult men to manage prostate cancer that has spread to other parts of the body.

ABRETONE 250MG TABLET is also used to manage early stages of prostate cancer when used with androgen deprivation therapy (management that lowers testosterone hormone) and prednisone/prednisolone (medication) in affected individuals. ABRETONE 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to abiraterone. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from severe liver disease.

Before taking ABRETONE 250MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have high blood pressure, any other blood vessel problems (such as blood pressure, stroke), swelling in the feet, ankles, or legs, diabetes, lung problems (such as shortness of breath), heart problems (such as heart failure, irregular or rapid heart rate), kidney, and/or liver problems.

ABRETONE 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women since it is intended to be used only in male patients.While taking ABRETONE 250MG TABLET, male patients must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid exposure of this medicine to their female partners.

ABRETONE 250MG TABLET is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 75 years or older) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking ABRETONE 250MG TABLET are swelling in the legs or feet, high blood pressure, urinary tract infection, diarrhea, indigestion, chest pain, an irregular heartbeat, and/or a rash. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How ABRETONE 250MG TABLET Works

ABRETONE 250MG TABLET is an androgen biosynthesis inhibitor that works by inhibiting the production of the 17α-hydroxylase (CYP17) enzyme needed to produce testosterone (male sex hormone), which enables the growth of cancer cells in the prostate gland. Since ABRETONE 250MG TABLET suppresses the production of testosterone, the cancer cells in the prostate gland won't be able to grow, thus managing its effects on the gland in affected individuals.

How to use ABRETONE 250MG TABLET

Take ABRETONE 250MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Avoid taking medicine with food. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About MEXT 15MG TABLET

MEXT 15MG TABLET contains Methotrexate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimetabolites. MEXT 15MG TABLET is used to manage active rheumatoid arthritis in adults, which is a form of severe arthritis occurring due to unknown reasons (idiopathic) and old age and is non-responsive to conventional painkillers (such as Non-Steroidal Anti Inflammatory Drugs Ex. Aceclofenac).

MEXT 15MG TABLET is also used to manage its polyarthritic forms (characterized by the involvement of five or more joints), which are severe, active, and idiopathic in nature and affect young people (Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis, JIA).

MEXT 15MG TABLET is also used to manage psoriasis and relapsed (reoccurred) and refractory (unaffected by other conventional managements) Non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma, which is a type of cancer of the lymphatic system.

Psoriasis is a skin condition characterized by itchy scales that is not responsive to conventional managements such as phototherapy and retinoids.

Before taking MEXT 15MG TABLET, it is recommended to inform the doctor about your medical and family history, including the list of medicines (prescription, non-prescription medicines, and herbal medicines) that are being taken.

Also, MEXT 15MG TABLET is not recommended to be taken by pregnant and nursing women, women planning pregnancy, those who drink huge amounts of alcohol, or patients suffering from liver and kidney impairment.

MEXT 15MG TABLET is not recommended in children for the management of psoriasis and rheumatoid arthritis. However, MEXT 15MG TABLET can be used with caution in children to manage polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis, which is characterized by the involvement of five or more joints that are of severe, active, juvenile, and idiopathic character. Consult the doctor before taking MEXT 15MG TABLET.

In addition, caution must be exercised by patients suffering from lung disorders, blood disorders, and gastric disorders before taking MEXT 15MG TABLET.

Care must be taken to avoid taking products containing caffeine, such as black tea, coffee, and cold drinks, while taking MEXT 15MG TABLET.

The common side effects seen after taking MEXT 15MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and altered levels of blood cells. Consult a doctor if any of the above side effects worsen after taking MEXT 15MG TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How MEXT 15MG TABLET Works

MEXT 15MG TABLET contains methotrexate that works by interfering with the growth of those cells in the body that reproduce quickly. As a result, the growth of those cells gets retarded, thus serving as an anti-tumour agent. Also, it decreases the undesired reactions of the body’s own immune-defense mechanism, thereby working as an effective immunosuppressant. Additionally, it also exhibits anti-inflammatory effects, thereby reducing pain, swelling, and redness. Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking MEXT 15MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. amoxicillin, ciprofloxacin)
Medicines used to increase urine excretion (Ex. frusemide)
Medicines used to manage increased sugar levels (Ex. metformin)
Medicines used to manage fits (Ex. phenytoin)
Medicines used to manage increased cholesterol levels (Ex. cholestyramine)
Medicines used to manage gout (Ex. probenecid)
Medicines to manage reduced folic acid levels (Ex. folic acid preparations)
Medicines used to manage severe heartburn or ulcers (Ex. omeprazole)
Other medicines used to manage rheumatoid arthritis (Ex. leflunomide)
Medicines that can be harmful to the liver (Ex. sulfasalazine)
Medicines used in the management of cancer (Ex. doxorubicin, cisplatin, and mercaptopurine)
Medicines used to manage pain (Ex. ibuprofen, naproxen, diclofenac)
Other medicines used to manage rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis (Ex. leflunomide, phenylbutazone, or amidopyrine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. theophylline)
Medicines used in organ transplantation (Ex. cyclosporin, azathioprine)
Medicines used to induce sleep (Ex. phenobarbitone)
Medicines used to induce calmness and relieve anxiety (Ex. diazepam)
Medicines used for oral contraception (Ex. estrogen)
Medicines used to manage skin conditions (Ex. retinoids)
Medicines used to manage malaria (Ex. pyrimethamine)
Medicines that contain live vaccines (Ex. MMR vaccine)
Medicines used for general anesthesia and pain relief (Ex. nitrous oxide)
Medicines used to manage heart problems (Ex. amiodarone)
Medicines used to manage heart failure (Ex. digoxin)
Medicines used for the management of various inflammatory conditions like skin diseases and allergic reactions (Ex. hydrocortisone)

B. Drug-Food interactions:

It is recommended to avoid the consumption of drinks containing caffeine, such as black tea, coffee, and soft drinks, along with MEXT 15MG TABLET, to manage dehydration.

Overdosage:

If you or someone else accidentally takes too much MEXT 15MG TABLET, it is recommended to consult your doctor immediately. Symptoms of overdosage with MEXT 15MG TABLET are an easy tendency to bruise or bleed, nausea, vomiting, and unusual weakness, along with the development of mouth sores and ulcers.

introduction:
Introduction About DERMOTREX 5MG TABLET

DERMOTREX 5MG TABLET contains Methotrexate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimetabolites. DERMOTREX 5MG TABLET is used to manage active rheumatoid arthritis in adults, which is a form of severe arthritis occurring due to unknown reasons (idiopathic) and old age and is non-responsive to conventional painkillers (such as Non-Steroidal Anti Inflammatory Drugs Ex. Aceclofenac).

DERMOTREX 5MG TABLET is also used to manage its polyarthritic forms (characterized by the involvement of five or more joints), which are severe, active, and idiopathic in nature and affect young people (Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis, JIA).

DERMOTREX 5MG TABLET is also used to manage psoriasis and relapsed (reoccurred) and refractory (unaffected by other conventional managements) Non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma, which is a type of cancer of the lymphatic system.

Psoriasis is a skin condition characterized by itchy scales that is not responsive to conventional managements such as phototherapy and retinoids.

Before taking DERMOTREX 5MG TABLET, it is recommended to inform the doctor about your medical and family history, including the list of medicines (prescription, non-prescription medicines, and herbal medicines) that are being taken.

Also, DERMOTREX 5MG TABLET is not recommended to be taken by pregnant and nursing women, women planning pregnancy, those who drink huge amounts of alcohol, or patients suffering from liver and kidney impairment.

DERMOTREX 5MG TABLET is not recommended in children for the management of psoriasis and rheumatoid arthritis. However, DERMOTREX 5MG TABLET can be used with caution in children to manage polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis, which is characterized by the involvement of five or more joints that are of severe, active, juvenile, and idiopathic character. Consult the doctor before taking DERMOTREX 5MG TABLET.

In addition, caution must be exercised by patients suffering from lung disorders, blood disorders, and gastric disorders before taking DERMOTREX 5MG TABLET.

Care must be taken to avoid taking products containing caffeine, such as black tea, coffee, and cold drinks, while taking DERMOTREX 5MG TABLET.

The common side effects seen after taking DERMOTREX 5MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and altered levels of blood cells. Consult a doctor if any of the above side effects worsen after taking DERMOTREX 5MG TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How DERMOTREX 5MG TABLET Works

DERMOTREX 5MG TABLET contains methotrexate that works by interfering with the growth of those cells in the body that reproduce quickly. As a result, the growth of those cells gets retarded, thus serving as an anti-tumour agent. Also, it decreases the undesired reactions of the body’s own immune-defense mechanism, thereby working as an effective immunosuppressant. Additionally, it also exhibits anti-inflammatory effects, thereby reducing pain, swelling, and redness. As a result, it manages the symptoms associated with diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis.

introduction:
Introduction About MEXATE 5 TABLET

MEXATE 5 TABLET contains Methotrexate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimetabolites. MEXATE 5 TABLET is used to manage active rheumatoid arthritis in adults, which is a form of severe arthritis occurring due to unknown reasons (idiopathic) and old age and is non-responsive to conventional painkillers (such as Non-Steroidal Anti Inflammatory Drugs Ex. Aceclofenac).

MEXATE 5 TABLET is also used to manage its polyarthritic forms (characterized by the involvement of five or more joints), which are severe, active, and idiopathic in nature and affect young people (Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis, JIA).

MEXATE 5 TABLET is also used to manage psoriasis and relapsed (reoccurred) and refractory (unaffected by other conventional managements) Non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma, which is a type of cancer of the lymphatic system.

Psoriasis is a skin condition characterized by itchy scales that is not responsive to conventional managements such as phototherapy and retinoids.

Before taking MEXATE 5 TABLET, it is recommended to inform the doctor about your medical and family history, including the list of medicines (prescription, non-prescription medicines, and herbal medicines) that are being taken.

Also, MEXATE 5 TABLET is not recommended to be taken by pregnant and nursing women, women planning pregnancy, those who drink huge amounts of alcohol, or patients suffering from liver and kidney impairment.

MEXATE 5 TABLET is not recommended in children for the management of psoriasis and rheumatoid arthritis. However, MEXATE 5 TABLET can be used with caution in children to manage polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis, which is characterized by the involvement of five or more joints that are of severe, active, juvenile, and idiopathic character. Consult the doctor before taking MEXATE 5 TABLET.

In addition, caution must be exercised by patients suffering from lung disorders, blood disorders, and gastric disorders before taking MEXATE 5 TABLET.

Care must be taken to avoid taking products containing caffeine, such as black tea, coffee, and cold drinks, while taking MEXATE 5 TABLET.

The common side effects seen after taking MEXATE 5 TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and altered levels of blood cells. Consult a doctor if any of the above side effects worsen after taking MEXATE 5 TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How MEXATE 5 TABLET Works

MEXATE 5 TABLET contains methotrexate that works by interfering with the growth of those cells in the body that reproduce quickly. As a result, the growth of those cells gets retarded, thus serving as an anti-tumour agent. Also, it decreases the undesired reactions of the body’s own immune-defense mechanism, thereby working as an effective immunosuppressant. Additionally, it also exhibits anti-inflammatory effects, thereby reducing pain, swelling, and redness. As a result, it manages the symptoms associated with diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis.

How to use MEXATE 5 TABLET

Take MEXATE 5 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About PEMNAT 500MG INJECTION

PEMNAT 500MG INJECTION contains Pemetrexed which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer agents. It is used to manage advanced stages of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). It can be used as a management option to control cancer progression in patients who have failed to respond adequately to conventional therapies.

PEMNAT 500MG INJECTION is also used to manage malignant cancer of pleural membrane (a protective layer surrounding the lungs), called as pleural mesothelioma. It is mostly used in combination with other anti-cancer medicines (such as cisplatin, carboplatin) to achieve better results.

Before receiving PEMNAT 500MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems or a previous history of the same. You must also inform your doctor if you have fluid accumulation in the lungs or recently received or planning to receive any radiation therapy or vaccination in the upcoming days as a precaution.

PEMNAT 500MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years. Men and women receiving PEMNAT 500MG INJECTION must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with PEMNAT 500MG INJECTION and for until 6 months after stopping the therapy.

The most common side effects of receiving PEMNAT 500MG INJECTION are increased infections, sore throat, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, dizziness, tiredness, weight loss, changes in taste, skin rash, hair loss and mouth ulcers. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

As a result, it reduces abnormal growth and multiplication of cancer cells in the body.

introduction:
Introduction About TEMCAD 100MG CAPSULE

TEMCAD 100MG CAPSULE contains Temozolomide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antineoplastic agents. It is used for specific forms of brain tumours in adults with newly diagnosed glioblastoma multiforme, which is used first together with radiotherapy as a concomitant phase of therapy and then used alone as a monotherapy. It is also used in children (above 3 years) and adults to manage malignant gliomas, such as glioblastoma multiforme or anaplastic astrocytoma, if they return or get worse after standard management.

Glioblastoma multiforme is an aggressive type of cancer that affects the brain or spinal cord and is generally characterized by symptoms such as headache, nausea, drowsiness, blurred vision, personality changes, and seizures.

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to take liver function tests to assess the hepatotoxicity and function of your liver. Before taking TEMCAD 100MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had a hepatitis B infection (serious liver infection).

TEMCAD 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have certain kinds of blood cells that are severely reduced, such as white blood cells and platelet count. TEMCAD 100MG CAPSULE should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary and not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. It is not recommended for use in children below 3 years of age and should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from 3 to 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking TEMCAD 100MG CAPSULE. The most common side effects of taking TEMCAD 100MG CAPSULE are loss of appetite, difficulty while speaking, headache, vomiting, nausea, diarrhea, and constipation. Consult and inform your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.

TEMCAD 100MG CAPSULE works by damaging the genetic material (DNA and RNA) of the cancer cells inside the brain cells and works against the cell growth and multiplication.

introduction:
Introduction About SMARTOVA L 2.5MG TABLET

SMARTOVA L 2.5MG TABLET contains Letrozole which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Chemotherapeutic agents. It is used for breast cancer in postmenopausal women. It can be given either as an initial therapy or following therapy with other medicines such as tamoxifen. It is also used for patients with advanced breast cancer with breast tumour spreading to other parts of the body. Breast cancer can be defined as the uncontrollable growth and division of cells present in the breast. It is predominantly caused due to hormonal imbalance (increased estrogen production) or due to lifestyle factors. Symptoms include breast pain or tenderness, purple or red colored breasts, nipple discharge and lump growths.

Before taking SMARTOVA L 2.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems in your kidneys or liver. You must also inform your doctor before taking SMARTOVA L 2.5MG TABLET if you have a history of any bone problems such as osteoporosis or joint pain.

SMARTOVA L 2.5MG TABLET is only intended for use in women who have reached their menopause. It is strictly not recommended for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. The most common side effects of taking SMARTOVA L 2.5MG TABLET are hot flushes, fatigue, increased sweating, joint pain, hair loss, vaginal bleeding, and high blood cholesterol levels. Talk to your doctor if any of these above side effect bothers you.

How SMARTOVA L 2.5MG TABLET Works

SMARTOVA L 2.5MG TABLET contains Letrozole which is an aromatase inhibitor acts by blocking the actions of an enzyme called aromatase in the body which is involved in the production of estrogen. This suppresses the release of excessive estrogen in the body that triggers breast cancer. As a result, it slows down from growing and spreading to other parts of the body.

name: LEULIDE Injection(Depot) 1's
introduction:
Introduction About LEULIDE INJECTION(DEPOT)

LEULIDE INJECTION(DEPOT) contains Leuprolide which belongs to the group of medicines called Gonadotropin Releasing Hormone (GnRH) agonist. It is used to manage endometriosis, relieving pain and reducing endometriotic lesions. It is also used for preoperative hematologic improvement in women having fibroids (abnormal growth in uterus) induced anaemia for whom hormonal suppression is considered necessary for three months.

Endometriosis is a chronic disease in which a tissue like the uterus lining grows outside the uterus, resulting in pain and/or infertility. It is characterized by symptoms such as pain during periods, pelvic pain, pain associated with sexual intercourse, painful urination, fatigue, depression, bloating and nausea.

Do not receive LEULIDE INJECTION(DEPOT) if you are allergic to Leuprolide, GnRH, or GnRH agonist analogs.

Before receiving this medicine, inform your doctor if you have liver impairment, kidney impairment, or undiagnosed abnormal uterine bleeding.

Inform your doctor if you are chronic alcohol or tobacco user or have strong family history of osteoporosis or chronic use of medicines.

LEULIDE INJECTION(DEPOT) is not recommended for use in pregnant women. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women only if considered necessary. It is not recommended for use in premenarcheal children and postmenopausal women. Consult your doctor before receiving.

The common side effects associated with the use of LEULIDE INJECTION(DEPOT) are hot flashes/sweating, general pain, headache, gastrointestinal disorders, swelling due to water retention, nausea, vomiting, reduced libido, and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About POMAVIA 2MG CAPSULE

POMAVIA 2MG CAPSULE contains Pomalidomide which belongs to the group of medicines called Immunomodulating agents. It is used in adults to manage multiple myeloma (cancer of plasma cells). It is generally used in combination with other anti-cancer agents (such as dexamethasone and/or bortezomib) to achieve better results.

Before taking POMAVIA 2MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have high blood pressure, high blood cholesterol levels, blood clots or hepatitis B infection or have a habit of smoking as a precaution.

POMAVIA 2MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in women who are pregnant, think that they might be pregnant or planning to become pregnant. It should be used in breastfeeding women only if considered necessary by the physician.

Both men and women undergoing therapy with POMAVIA 2MG CAPSULE must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy prior to, during and until 4 weeks after stopping the therapy. Patients taking POMAVIA 2MG CAPSULE must not donate their blood during management and for 7 days after the end of management

The most common side effects of taking POMAVIA 2MG CAPSULE are increased infections, low RBC and platelet count, nausea, vomiting, swelling of body parts, numbness or tingling of body parts, skin rashes, oral sores, taste changes and weight loss. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Manage multiple myeloma (cancer of plasma cells) in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of POMAVIA 2MG CAPSULE
Manage multiple myeloma (cancer of plasma cells) in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How POMAVIA 2MG CAPSULE Works

POMAVIA 2MG CAPSULE stimulates the immune system to stop the growth of abnormal plasma cells (a type of white blood cells) in the blood. This helps in destroying the cancer cells in the blood and manages it from developing further. It also reduces blood supply to the cancer cells, which helps in managing further spread of cancer cells in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use POMAVIA 2MG CAPSULE

Take POMAVIA 2MG CAPSULE as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking POMAVIA 2MG CAPSULE unless your doctor tells you to stop.

Introduction About POSID 100MG INJECTION

POSID 100MG INJECTION contains Etoposide which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer agents. It is used to manage various types of cancer such as lung cancer, blood cancer, lymph cancer, ovarian cancer and testicular cancer.     

POSID 100MG INJECTION should be used under careful medical supervision. During management with POSID 100MG INJECTION, your doctor will periodically monitor your heart, liver, kidney functions as a precaution.

Before receiving POSID 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any serious infections, low albumin levels in blood or recently received any vaccine or radiotherapy or chemotherapy as a precaution.

Do not receive POSID 100MG INJECTION without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Both men and women undergoing therapy with this medicine, must use a suitable contraceptive to stop pregnancy during and until 6 months after stopping the therapy.

The most common side effects of receiving POSID 100MG INJECTION are blood disorders, loss of appetite, constipation, pigmentation on the skin, temporary hair loss, weakness, tiredness and sore lips, mouth or throat ulcers. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About CITAFINE 200MG INJECTION

CITAFINE 200MG INJECTION contains Gemcitabine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimetabolites. CITAFINE 200MG INJECTION is used in the management of non-small cell lung cancer (alone or combined with cisplatin), pancreatic cancer, breast cancer (with paclitaxel), ovarian cancer (with carboplatin) and bladder cancer (with cisplatin).

Cancer is a disease in which there is uncontrollable growth of some of the body’s cells that spread to other parts of the body. During CITAFINE 200MG INJECTION management, your doctor might ask you to take certain blood tests to check your blood cell count, kidney function or liver function.

Avoid drinking alcohol during CITAFINE 200MG INJECTION management as it can make you feel sleepy. Before receiving CITAFINE 200MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or are going to have radiotherapy, have been vaccinated recently or if you have any liver, kidney or heart diseases.

CITAFINE 200MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women, breastfeeding women, children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before receiving it.

The most common side effects of receiving CITAFINE 200MG INJECTION are vomiting, constipation, hair loss, poor appetite, headache, insomnia, cough, itching, sweating, etc. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms or side effects bother you.

introduction:
Introduction About ONCOTREX 7.5MG TABLET

ONCOTREX 7.5MG TABLET contains Methotrexate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimetabolites. ONCOTREX 7.5MG TABLET is used to manage active rheumatoid arthritis in adults, which is a form of severe arthritis occurring due to unknown reasons (idiopathic) and old age and is non-responsive to conventional painkillers (such as Non-Steroidal Anti Inflammatory Drugs Ex. Aceclofenac).

ONCOTREX 7.5MG TABLET is also used to manage its polyarthritic forms (characterized by the involvement of five or more joints), which are severe, active, and idiopathic in nature and affect young people (Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis, JIA).

ONCOTREX 7.5MG TABLET is also used to manage psoriasis and relapsed (reoccurred) and refractory (unaffected by other conventional managements) Non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma, which is a type of cancer of the lymphatic system.

Psoriasis is a skin condition characterized by itchy scales that is not responsive to conventional managements such as phototherapy and retinoids.

Before taking ONCOTREX 7.5MG TABLET, it is recommended to inform the doctor about your medical and family history, including the list of medicines (prescription, non-prescription medicines, and herbal medicines) that are being taken.

Also, ONCOTREX 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended to be taken by pregnant and nursing women, women planning pregnancy, those who drink huge amounts of alcohol, or patients suffering from liver and kidney impairment.

ONCOTREX 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended in children for the management of psoriasis and rheumatoid arthritis. However, ONCOTREX 7.5MG TABLET can be used with caution in children to manage polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis, which is characterized by the involvement of five or more joints that are of severe, active, juvenile, and idiopathic character. Consult the doctor before taking ONCOTREX 7.5MG TABLET.

In addition, caution must be exercised by patients suffering from lung disorders, blood disorders, and gastric disorders before taking ONCOTREX 7.5MG TABLET.

Care must be taken to avoid taking products containing caffeine, such as black tea, coffee, and cold drinks, while taking ONCOTREX 7.5MG TABLET.

The common side effects seen after taking ONCOTREX 7.5MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and altered levels of blood cells. Consult a doctor if any of the above side effects worsen after taking ONCOTREX 7.5MG TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How ONCOTREX 7.5MG TABLET Works

ONCOTREX 7.5MG TABLET contains methotrexate that works by interfering with the growth of those cells in the body that reproduce quickly. As a result, the growth of those cells gets retarded, thus serving as an anti-tumour agent. Also, it decreases the undesired reactions of the body’s own immune-defense mechanism, thereby working as an effective immunosuppressant. Additionally, it also exhibits anti-inflammatory effects, thereby reducing pain, swelling, and redness. As a result, it manages the symptoms associated with diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis.
usageDetails:
How to use ONCOTREX 7.5MG TABLET

Take ONCOTREX 7.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

ONCOTREX 7.5MG TABLET is recommended to be administered with caution and in a lower dosage to elders due to diminished function of the liver and kidneys and reduced folate levels in the blood in old age. Also, it is recommended to closely monitor the elderly, taking ONCOTREX 7.5MG TABLET for the identification of possible side effects. Consult the doctor before taking ONCOTREX 7.5MG TABLET.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking ONCOTREX 7.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. amoxicillin, ciprofloxacin)
Medicines used to increase urine excretion (Ex. frusemide)
Medicines used to manage increased sugar levels (Ex. metformin)
Medicines used to manage fits (Ex. phenytoin)
Medicines used to manage increased cholesterol levels (Ex. cholestyramine)
Medicines used to manage gout (Ex. probenecid)
Medicines to manage reduced folic acid levels (Ex. folic acid preparations)
Medicines used to manage severe heartburn or ulcers (Ex. omeprazole)
Other medicines used to manage rheumatoid arthritis (Ex. leflunomide)
Medicines that can be harmful to the liver (Ex. sulfasalazine)
Medicines used in the management of cancer (Ex. doxorubicin, cisplatin, and mercaptopurine)
Medicines used to manage pain (Ex. ibuprofen, naproxen, diclofenac)
Other medicines used to manage rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis (Ex. leflunomide, phenylbutazone, or amidopyrine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. theophylline)
Medicines used in organ transplantation (Ex. cyclosporin, azathioprine)
Medicines used to induce sleep (Ex. phenobarbitone)
Medicines used to induce calmness and relieve anxiety (Ex. diazepam)
Medicines used for oral contraception (Ex. estrogen)
Medicines used to manage skin conditions (Ex. retinoids)
Medicines used to manage malaria (Ex. pyrimethamine)
Medicines that contain live vaccines (Ex. MMR vaccine)
Medicines used for general anesthesia and pain relief (Ex. nitrous oxide)
Medicines used to manage heart problems (Ex. amiodarone)
Medicines used to manage heart failure (Ex. digoxin)
Medicines used for the management of various inflammatory conditions like skin diseases and allergic reactions (Ex. hydrocortisone)

B. Drug-Food interactions:

It is recommended to avoid the consumption of drinks containing caffeine, such as black tea, coffee, and soft drinks, along with ONCOTREX 7.5MG TABLET, to manage dehydration.

Overdosage:

If you or someone else accidentally takes too much ONCOTREX 7.5MG TABLET, it is recommended to consult your doctor immediately. Symptoms of overdosage with ONCOTREX 7.5MG TABLET are an easy tendency to bruise or bleed, nausea, vomiting, and unusual weakness, along with the development of mouth sores and ulcers.

introduction:
Introduction About KEMOCARB 150MG INJECTION

KEMOCARB 150MG INJECTION contains Carboplatin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used to manage advanced ovarian cancer and small-cell lung cancer. It is generally used in combination with other anti-cancer medicines to achieve better results.

Advanced ovarian cancer is a cancer that originates in the ovary and spreads to other parts of the body and small cell lung cancer is cancer that occurs in the tissues of the lungs. It is caused mainly by smoking and is characterized by symptoms such as chest pain, coughing with blood, shortness of breath, tiredness, and weight loss.

Before receiving KEMOCARB 150MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have a fever or low blood counts before receiving KEMOCARB 150MG INJECTION. KEMOCARB 150MG INJECTION should not be used by pregnant or breastfeeding women.

Men receiving KEMOCARB 150MG INJECTION must not father a child during management with KEMOCARB 150MG INJECTION and up to six months after stopping the therapy. Both men and women receiving KEMOCARB 150MG INJECTION must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with KEMOCARB 150MG INJECTION.

The use of KEMOCARB 150MG INJECTION may cause an abnormal decrease in total blood counts. It may also cause nausea, vomiting, mouth sores, hearing loss, loss of taste, tingling or numbness of body parts, increased serum creatinine levels, difficulty passing urine, increased bilirubin levels in the blood, and changes in vision.

introduction:
Introduction About FOLITRAX 20MG INJECTION

FOLITRAX 20MG INJECTION contains Methotrexate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimetabolites. FOLITRAX 20MG INJECTION is used to manage active rheumatoid arthritis in adults. It is also used to manage polyarthritic forms (characterized by the involvement of five or more joints), which are severe, active, and idiopathic in nature and affect young people (Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis, or JIA). FOLITRAX 20MG INJECTION is also used to manage psoriasis.

In addition, FOLITRAX 20MG INJECTION is also used to manage Crohn’s disease and various cancers such as acute lymphocytic lymphoma, Non-Hodgkin’s Lymphoma, breast cancer, cervical cancer, bladder cancer, etc.

Rheumatoid arthritis is an autoimmune and inflammatory disease, which means that your immune system attacks healthy cells in your body by mistake, causing inflammation (painful swelling) in the affected parts of the body. Psoriasis is a skin condition characterized by itchy scales that is not responsive to conventional managements such as phototherapy and retinoids. Crohn’s disease is an inflammatory disease affecting the intestine.

Before getting FOLITRAX 20MG INJECTION administered, it is recommended to inform the doctor about your medical and family history, including the list of medicines (prescription, non-prescription medicines, and herbal medicines) that are being taken, before receiving FOLITRAX 20MG INJECTION.

Also, FOLITRAX 20MG INJECTION is not recommended for children less than the age of 3, pregnant and nursing women, women planning pregnancy, those who drink huge amounts of alcohol, and patients suffering from liver and kidney impairment.

Caution must be exercised by patients suffering from lung disorders, blood disorders, and gastric disorders before receiving FOLITRAX 20MG INJECTION. Care must be taken to avoid taking products containing caffeine, such as black tea, coffee, and cold drinks, while receiving FOLITRAX 20MG INJECTION.

The common side effects that can be experienced after receiving FOLITRAX 20MG INJECTION are headache, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and altered levels of blood cells. Consult a doctor if any of the above side effects worsen after receiving FOLITRAX 20MG INJECTION.

mechanismOfAction:
How FOLITRAX 20MG INJECTION Works

FOLITRAX 20MG INJECTION contains Methotrexate, a disease-modifying antirheumatic drug (DMARDs) which interferes with the growth of those cells in the body that reproduce quickly. As a result, the growth of those cells gets retarded, thus serving as an anti-tumour agent. Also, FOLITRAX 20MG INJECTION decreases the undesired reactions of the body’s own immune-defense mechanism, thereby working as an effective immunosuppressant. In addition, it also exhibits anti-inflammatory effects, thereby reducing pain, swelling, and redness. As a result, FOLITRAX 20MG INJECTION manages the symptoms associated with diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis.

FOLITRAX 20MG INJECTION will be administered to you into a muscle (intramuscularly) only by a doctor or a nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Medicines used to induce calmness and relieve anxiety (Ex. tranquilizers such as diazepam)

introduction:
Introduction About MEXT 7.5MG TABLET

MEXT 7.5MG TABLET contains Methotrexate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimetabolites. MEXT 7.5MG TABLET is used to manage active rheumatoid arthritis in adults, which is a form of severe arthritis occurring due to unknown reasons (idiopathic) and old age and is non-responsive to conventional painkillers (such as Non-Steroidal Anti Inflammatory Drugs Ex. Aceclofenac).

MEXT 7.5MG TABLET is also used to manage its polyarthritic forms (characterized by the involvement of five or more joints), which are severe, active, and idiopathic in nature and affect young people (Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis, JIA).

MEXT 7.5MG TABLET is also used to manage psoriasis and relapsed (reoccurred) and refractory (unaffected by other conventional managements) Non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma, which is a type of cancer of the lymphatic system.

Psoriasis is a skin condition characterized by itchy scales that is not responsive to conventional managements such as phototherapy and retinoids.

Before taking MEXT 7.5MG TABLET, it is recommended to inform the doctor about your medical and family history, including the list of medicines (prescription, non-prescription medicines, and herbal medicines) that are being taken.

Also, MEXT 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended to be taken by pregnant and nursing women, women planning pregnancy, those who drink huge amounts of alcohol, or patients suffering from liver and kidney impairment.

MEXT 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended in children for the management of psoriasis and rheumatoid arthritis. However, MEXT 7.5MG TABLET can be used with caution in children to manage polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis, which is characterized by the involvement of five or more joints that are of severe, active, juvenile, and idiopathic character. Consult the doctor before taking MEXT 7.5MG TABLET.

In addition, caution must be exercised by patients suffering from lung disorders, blood disorders, and gastric disorders before taking MEXT 7.5MG TABLET.

Care must be taken to avoid taking products containing caffeine, such as black tea, coffee, and cold drinks, while taking MEXT 7.5MG TABLET.

The common side effects seen after taking MEXT 7.5MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and altered levels of blood cells. Consult a doctor if any of the above side effects worsen after taking MEXT 7.5MG TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How MEXT 7.5MG TABLET Works

MEXT 7.5MG TABLET contains methotrexate that works by interfering with the growth of those cells in the body that reproduce quickly. As a result, the growth of those cells gets retarded, thus serving as an anti-tumour agent. Also, it decreases the undesired reactions of the body’s own immune-defense mechanism, thereby working as an effective immunosuppressant. Additionally, it also exhibits anti-inflammatory effects, thereby reducing pain, swelling, and redness. As a result, it manages the symptoms associated with diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis.

Take MEXT 7.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

warnings.details: MEXT 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are pregnant and/or are planning to become pregnant since it can be harmful to the foetus (growing baby) and lead to various malformations. Consult your doctor before taking MEXT 7.5MG TABLET.
MEXT 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended if you are a nursing mother. Consult your doctor before taking MEXT 7.5MG TABLET.
MEXT 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended if you feel tired or dizzy after taking the medicine. Consult your doctor before taking MEXT 7.5MG TABLET.
It is recommended to avoid the consumption of alcohol while taking MEXT 7.5MG TABLET, as it may increase the risk of liver damage. Consult your doctor before taking MEXT 7.5MG TABLET.
MEXT 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended if you have or have had a kidney disorder and/or are receiving any dialysis> management. Consult your doctor before taking MEXT 7.5MG TABLET.
MEXT 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended if you have a liver disorder. Consult your doctor before taking MEXT 7.5MG TABLET.
MEXT 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended if you are allergic to methotrexate and/or any other constituent of MEXT 7.5MG TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking MEXT 7.5MG TABLET.
MEXT 7.5MG TABLET is recommended to be taken with caution if you have issues with lung function and are diagnosed with pleural effusion. Consult your doctor before taking MEXT 7.5MG TABLET.

MEXT 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended in children for the management of psoriasis and rheumatoid arthritis. However, MEXT 7.5MG TABLET can be used with caution in children to manage polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis. Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depending on your child’s age, body weight, and health condition. Consult your doctor for advice before taking MEXT 7.5MG TABLET.

MEXT 7.5MG TABLET is recommended to be administered with caution and in a lower dosage to elders due to diminished function of the liver and kidneys and reduced folate levels in the blood in old age. Also, it is recommended to closely monitor the elderly, taking MEXT 7.5MG TABLET for the identification of possible side effects. Consult the doctor before taking MEXT 7.5MG TABLET.

Others

MEXT 7.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have bone marrow disorders
Have blood disorders
Have an impaired immune system
Have a severe and/or existing infection (Ex. tuberculosis, HIV)
Have ulcers in the gastro-intestinal tract
Have inflammation and ulcers of the mouth
Are receiving vaccinations containing live vaccines

Before taking MEXT 7.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have diabetes
Are overweight
Suffer from diarrhea
Ulcers in the colon (ulcerative colitis)
Are receiving radiotherapy for various conditions, such as X-rays and UV-rays
Have folate deficiency
Have lactose and/or galactose intolerance
Have mental illness

introduction:
Introduction About XYLUTIDE CAPSULE

XYLUTIDE CAPSULE contains Enzalutamide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Androgen receptor inhibitors. It is used to manage adult men with prostate cancer who no longer respond to hormone therapy or surgical management or if the cancer, despite responding to management, has spread to other parts of the body.

Prostate cancer occurs in the prostate gland (a gland in males that produces the seminal fluid to transport sperm). Symptoms include problems while urinating (difficulty, decreased force, or blood in the urine), blood in the semen, bone pain, erectile dysfunction, and weight loss.

Enzalutamide acts by blocking the activity of hormones called androgens (such as testosterone). By blocking androgens, it stops the growth of prostate cancer cells and can further induce cancer cell death and tumour regression.

Before taking XYLUTIDE CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, or heart conditions like arrhythmia (heart rhythm problem). XYLUTIDE CAPSULE is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. XYLUTIDE CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking XYLUTIDE CAPSULE are tiredness, broken bones, hot flushes, high blood pressure, headaches, feeling anxious, dry skin, itching, difficulty remembering, and breast enlargement in men. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About GEMITA 200MG INJECTION

GEMITA 200MG INJECTION contains Gemcitabine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimetabolites. GEMITA 200MG INJECTION is used in the management of non-small cell lung cancer (alone or combined with cisplatin), pancreatic cancer, breast cancer (with paclitaxel), ovarian cancer (with carboplatin) and bladder cancer (with cisplatin).

Cancer is a disease in which there is uncontrollable growth of some of the body’s cells that spread to other parts of the body. During GEMITA 200MG INJECTION management, your doctor might ask you to take certain blood tests to check your blood cell count, kidney function or liver function.

Avoid drinking alcohol during GEMITA 200MG INJECTION management as it can make you feel sleepy. Before receiving GEMITA 200MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or are going to have radiotherapy, have been vaccinated recently or if you have any liver, kidney or heart diseases.

GEMITA 200MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women, breastfeeding women, children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before receiving it.

The most common side effects of receiving GEMITA 200MG INJECTION are vomiting, constipation, hair loss, poor appetite, headache, insomnia, cough, itching, sweating, etc. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms or side effects bother you.
uses: Non-small cell lung cancer (alone or with cisplatin)

Uses Of GEMITA 200MG INJECTION

Used in the management of:

Non-small cell lung cancer (alone or with cisplatin)

Ovarian cancer (with carboplatin)
Bladder cancer (with cisplatin)
mechanismOfAction:
How GEMITA 200MG INJECTION Works

GEMITA 200MG INJECTION kills the dividing cancer cells by inhibition of their DNA (hereditary material) synthesis.
usageDetails:
How to use GEMITA 200MG INJECTION

GEMITA 200MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and surface area and disease condition.

name: CADILAP 250mg Tablet 30's
introduction:
Introduction About CADILAP 250MG TABLET

CADILAP 250MG TABLET contains Lapatinib which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer agents. It is used to manage metastatic breast cancer (cancer that has been spread to other parts of the body from breast). It is mostly used in combination with other anticancer or hormonal medicines (such as capecitabine, trastuzumab or anastrozole) to achieve better results.

CADILAP 250MG TABLET can be taken either one hour before or one hour after food. During management with CADILAP 250MG TABLET, your doctor will periodically monitor your heart, liver, kidney and lung functions as a precaution.

Before taking CADILAP 250MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diarrhea before taking this medicine.

Do not take CADILAP 250MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking CADILAP 250MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, weakness, indigestion, constipation, sore mouth, trouble sleeping, back pain, joint pain, headache, hot flushes, hair loss, nail disorder and abnormal heartbeat. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CADILAP 250MG TABLET
Manage metastatic breast cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How CADILAP 250MG TABLET Works

CADILAP 250MG TABLET is an anticancer agent. It works by blocking the actions of certain cellular proteins (tyrosine kinase) that triggers cancer cell formation. It also blocks various downstream cell signalling pathways that triggers cancer growth within the body. As a result, it reduces cancer formation and manages its further growth within the body.
usageDetails:
How to use CADILAP 250MG TABLET

Take CADILAP 250MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. CADILAP 250MG TABLET can be taken either one hour before or one hour after food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take CADILAP 250MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results.

name: INVISTA 50mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About INVISTA 50MG TABLET

INVISTA 50MG TABLET contains Dasatinib which belongs to the group of medicines called Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors. It is used to manage cancers of blood and bone marrow (such as chronic myeloid leukaemia (CML) and philadelphia chromosome positive (Ph+) acute lymphoblastic leukaemia) in adults, adolescents and in children (aged 1 year or above).

It is primarily used in patients when management with conventional therapies is not suitable or fails to provide adequate response.   

Leukaemia is the cancer of white blood cells. It is caused due to abnormal growth and multiplication of blood cells within the bone marrow. It is characterized by severe tiredness, breathlessness, increased bleeding tendency, tiredness, anemia, night sweats, fever, chills, frequent infections and weight loss.

During management with INVISTA 50MG TABLET your doctor will closely monitor your health condition through several blood tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking INVISTA 50MG TABLET as it may increase the risk of side effects.

Before taking INVISTA 50MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have or at risk of developing hepatitis C infection as a precaution.

Avoid concomitant use of antacids or any stomach medicines along with INVISTA 50MG TABLET. Leave a time gap of at least 2 hours between the medicines. INVISTA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women.

Men and women taking INVISTA 50MG TABLET must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with INVISTA 50MG TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking INVISTA 50MG TABLET are increased bleeding tendency, increased infections, feeling tired or weak, nausea, vomiting, hair loss, mouth ulcers, changes in taste, inflammation of the food pipe or stomach, muscle pain or spasm, skin rashes, headache, dizziness and weight loss. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Cancers of blood and bone marrow (such as chronic myeloid leukaemia and philadelphia chromosome positive (Ph+) acute lymphoblastic leukaemia)
usesDetails:
Uses Of INVISTA 50MG TABLET

It is used in adults, adolescents and in children (aged 1 year or above) to manage:

Cancers of blood and bone marrow (such as chronic myeloid leukaemia and philadelphia chromosome positive (Ph+) acute lymphoblastic leukaemia)
mechanismOfAction:
How INVISTA 50MG TABLET Works

INVISTA 50MG TABLET is an anti-cancer medicine. It works by blocking the actions of certain proteins (such as BCR-ABL, Src kinase, etc.) in the body that triggers cancer formation. As a result, it reduces abnormal growth and multiplication of cancer cells in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use INVISTA 50MG TABLET

Take INVISTA 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without meals. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Try to take INVISTA 50MG TABLET at the same time each day. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking INVISTA 50MG TABLET unless advised by your doctor.

mechanismOfAction:
How TREXODAT 15 TABLET Works

TREXODAT 15 TABLET contains methotrexate that works by interfering with the growth of those cells in the body that reproduce quickly. As a result, the growth of those cells gets retarded, thus serving as an anti-tumour agent. Also, it decreases the undesired reactions of the body’s own immune-defense mechanism, thereby working as an effective immunosuppressant. Additionally, it also exhibits anti-inflammatory effects, thereby reducing pain, swelling, and redness. As a result, it manages the symptoms associated with diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis.

Others

Have bone marrow disorders

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking TREXODAT 15 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. amoxicillin, ciprofloxacin)
Medicines used to increase urine excretion (Ex. frusemide)
Medicines used to manage increased sugar levels (Ex. metformin)
Medicines used to manage fits (Ex. phenytoin)
Medicines used to manage increased cholesterol levels (Ex. cholestyramine)
Medicines used to manage gout (Ex. probenecid)
Medicines to manage reduced folic acid levels (Ex. folic acid preparations)
Medicines used to manage severe heartburn or ulcers (Ex. omeprazole)
Other medicines used to manage rheumatoid arthritis (Ex. leflunomide)
Medicines that can be harmful to the liver (Ex. sulfasalazine)
Medicines used in the management of cancer (Ex. doxorubicin, cisplatin, and mercaptopurine)
Medicines used to manage pain (Ex. ibuprofen, naproxen, diclofenac)
Other medicines used to manage rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis (Ex. leflunomide, phenylbutazone, or amidopyrine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. theophylline)
Medicines used in organ transplantation (Ex. cyclosporin, azathioprine)
Medicines used to induce sleep (Ex. phenobarbitone)
Medicines used to induce calmness and relieve anxiety (Ex. diazepam)
Medicines used for oral contraception (Ex. estrogen)
Medicines used to manage skin conditions (Ex. retinoids)
Medicines used to manage malaria (Ex. pyrimethamine)
Medicines that contain live vaccines (Ex. MMR vaccine)
Medicines used for general anesthesia and pain relief (Ex. nitrous oxide)
Medicines used to manage heart problems (Ex. amiodarone)
Medicines used to manage heart failure (Ex. digoxin)
Medicines used for the management of various inflammatory conditions like skin diseases and allergic reactions (Ex. hydrocortisone)

B. Drug-Food interactions:

It is recommended to avoid the consumption of drinks containing caffeine, such as black tea, coffee, and soft drinks, along with TREXODAT 15 TABLET, to manage dehydration.

Overdosage:

If you or someone else accidentally takes too much TREXODAT 15 TABLET, it is recommended to consult your doctor immediately. Symptoms of overdosage with TREXODAT 15 TABLET are an easy tendency to bruise or bleed, nausea, vomiting, and unusual weakness, along with the development of mouth sores and ulcers.

name: Gliotem 20 Capsule 1'S
introduction:
Introduction About GLIOTEM 20MG CAPSULE

GLIOTEM 20MG CAPSULE contains Temozolomide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antineoplastic agents. It is used for specific forms of brain tumours in adults with newly diagnosed glioblastoma multiforme, which is used first together with radiotherapy as a concomitant phase of therapy and then used alone as a monotherapy. It is also used in children (above 3 years) and adults to manage malignant gliomas, such as glioblastoma multiforme or anaplastic astrocytoma, if they return or get worse after standard management.

Glioblastoma multiforme is an aggressive type of cancer that affects the brain or spinal cord and is generally characterized by symptoms such as headache, nausea, drowsiness, blurred vision, personality changes, and seizures.

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to take liver function tests to assess the hepatotoxicity and function of your liver. Before taking GLIOTEM 20MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had a hepatitis B infection (serious liver infection).

GLIOTEM 20MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have certain kinds of blood cells that are severely reduced, such as white blood cells and platelet count. GLIOTEM 20MG CAPSULE should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary and not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. It is not recommended for use in children below 3 years of age and should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from 3 to 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking GLIOTEM 20MG CAPSULE. The most common side effects of taking GLIOTEM 20MG CAPSULE are loss of appetite, difficulty while speaking, headache, vomiting, nausea, diarrhea, and constipation. Consult and inform your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How GLIOTEM 20MG CAPSULE Works

GLIOTEM 20MG CAPSULE works by damaging the genetic material (DNA and RNA) of the cancer cells inside the brain cells and works against the cell growth and multiplication.

name: Imatib 100mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About IMATIB 100MG TABLET

IMATIB 100MG TABLET contains Imatinib which belongs to the group of medicines called Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors. It is used in adults, children and adolescents to manage chronic myeloid leukaemia (CML) (a form of leukaemia in which certain abnormal white cells (named myeloid cells) start growing out of control) and philadelphia chromosome positive acute lymphoblastic leukaemia (Ph-positive ALL) (a form of leukaemia in which certain abnormal white cells (named lymphoblasts) start growing out of control).

Also, it is used in adults only to manage myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative diseases (MDS/MPD) (a group of blood diseases in which some blood cells start growing out of control), hyper eosinophilic syndrome (HES) and/or chronic eosinophilic leukaemia (CEL) (a blood diseases in which some blood cells (named eosinophils) start growing out of control), gastrointestinal stromal tumours (GIST) (cancer of the stomach and bowels) and dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans (DFSP) (cancer of the tissue beneath the skin in which some cells start growing out of control).

Before taking IMATIB 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or ever had kidney, liver or heart problems, hepatitis B infection and thrombotic microangiopathy (symptoms include bruising, bleeding, fever, fatigue and confusion).

IMATIB 100MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. IMATIB 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in children, adolescents and elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking IMATIB 100MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, weight gain, loss of appetite, disturbed sense of taste, blurred vision and weakness. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How IMATIB 100MG TABLET Works

IMATIB 100MG TABLET is a protein-tyrosine kinase inhibitor. Tyrosine kinases are proteins which act as chemical messengers that are used by the cancer cells to signal each other for their growth, therefore this medicine works by blocking the enzyme which stops the cancer cells from growing.

introduction:
Introduction About BIOTREXATE 500MG INJECTION

BIOTREXATE 500MG INJECTION contains Methotrexate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimetabolites. It is used to manage various cancers such as acute lymphocytic lymphoma (a type of cancer of the blood and bone marrow), meningeal leukemia (a type of cancer of white blood cells), Non-Hodgkin’s Lymphoma (a type of cancer of the lymphatic system), ovary cancer, head and neck region cancer, breast cancer, cervical cancer, lung cancer, bone cancer, cancer of the skin-originated T-cell lymphoma, bladder cancer, and various other cancers that are severe and unmanageable by conventional therapy.

BIOTREXATE 500MG INJECTION is also used to manage psoriasis, which is severe and not manageable by other managements.

Before receiving BIOTREXATE 500MG INJECTION, it is recommended to inform the doctor about your medical and family history, including the list of medicines (prescription, non-prescription medicines, and herbal medicines) that are being taken.

Also, BIOTREXATE 500MG INJECTION is not recommended to be administered to pregnant and nursing women, women planning pregnancy, those who drink huge amounts of alcohol, or patients suffering from liver and kidney impairment.

Caution must be exercised by patients suffering from lung disorders, blood disorders, and gastric disorders before receiving BIOTREXATE 500MG INJECTION.

Care must be taken to avoid taking products containing caffeine, such as black tea, coffee, and cold drinks, while receiving BIOTREXATE 500MG INJECTION.

The common side effects that can be experienced after receiving BIOTREXATE 500MG INJECTION are headache, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and altered levels of blood cells. Consult a doctor if any of the above side effects worsen after receiving BIOTREXATE 500MG INJECTION.

mechanismOfAction:
How BIOTREXATE 500MG INJECTION Works

BIOTREXATE 500MG INJECTION contains Methotrexate, which is a disease-modifying antirheumatic drug (DMARDs). It interferes with the growth of those cells in the body that reproduce quickly. As a result, the growth of those cells gets retarded, thus serving as an anti-tumour agent. BIOTREXATE 500MG INJECTION decreases the undesired reactions of the body’s own immune-defense mechanism, thereby working as an effective immunosuppressant. In addition, it also exhibits anti-inflammatory effects, thereby reducing pain, swelling, and redness.

Have bone marrow diseases
Have blood disorders
Have decreased levels of iron in the blood

Have stomach ulcers
Have ulcerative colitis
Have certain immunodeficiency syndromes

Before receiving BIOTREXATE 500MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Are receiving management for the spine that may cause inflammation in the spine
Are diagnosed with the conditions that can lead to the retention of fluid in the body's organs

introduction:
Introduction About TAXONAB 100MG INJECTION

TAXONAB 100MG INJECTION contains Paclitaxel which belongs to a group of anti-cancer medicines called Taxanes. TAXONAB 100MG INJECTION is used to manage ovarian and breast cancer as a first line of therapy and as a second line of management when platinum containing medicines (such as cisplatin) or anthracyclines are insufficient to manage the disease in affected individuals.

TAXONAB 100MG INJECTION is also used to manage advanced NSCLC (non-small cell lung cancer) when surgery/radiation therapy is not suitable. The medicine is also indicated for use to manage AIDS-related Kaposi’s sarcoma when other managements (such as anthracyclines) are insufficient to manage the disease in affected individuals.

TAXONAB 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to paclitaxel and polyoxyethylated castor oil. It is also not recommended for use in patients with few white blood cells count and serious & uncontrolled infection. The medicine is also not used in patients suffering from severe liver disease.

Before receiving TAXONAB 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had previously received radiation to your chest and/or suffering from thrombocytopenia (low platelet count)/acute infections (such as herpes zoster, chickenpox, herpes), kidney problems (such as chronic kidney disease), liver problems (such as mild/moderate hepatic impairment) and/or heart problems (such as severe coronary artery disease, myocardial infarction and arrhythmias).

TAXONAB 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use during pregnancy. Women of child-bearing potential should use effective contraception method while receiving TAXONAB 100MG INJECTION which should be continued for next-6 months after completing the management. The medicine is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

TAXONAB 100MG INJECTION is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The medicine can be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving TAXONAB 100MG INJECTION are minor allergic reactions (such as flushing, rash, itching), shortness of breath, sore throat/mouth ulcers, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting and/or loss of hair. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

name: TIPANAT 20 Tablet 20's
introduction:
Introduction About TIPANAT 20 TABLET

TIPANAT 20 TABLET is used to manage adults with colon cancer or rectal cancer (colorectal cancer). It is used when the cancer has spread to other parts of the body. It is also used when other treatments have not worked or when other treatments are not suitable. TIPANAT 20 TABLET is a combination of Tipiracil and Trifluridine which belongs to the group of medicines known as Antineoplastic Agent which interferes with DNA in cancer cells to stop them from making new cancer cells. Tipiracil stops trifluridine from being broken down by enzymes before it can act.

Before taking TIPANAT 20 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or had radiation treatment for your cancer, intolerance to galactose or the Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption. TIPANAT 20 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women.

TIPANAT 20 TABLET is not suitable for the use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. The most common side effects of TIPANAT 20 TABLET are weakness, feeling tired, decreased appetite, abdominal pain, indigestion and common cold. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects persists for a longer duration.

introduction:
Introduction About BENDIT 100MG INJECTION

BENDIT 100MG INJECTION contains Bendamustine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used to manage certain forms of cancer, such as chronic lymphocytic leukemia (cancer of the blood and bone marrow), Non-Hodgkin lymphomas (lymph cancer), and multiple myeloma (cancer of plasma cells).

BENDIT 100MG INJECTION can be used either alone or in combination with other anti-cancer agents to achieve better results. Therapy with BENDIT 100MG INJECTION is chosen only when the use of other first-line medicines is not suitable.

The use of BENDIT 100MG INJECTION may cause an abnormal decrease in white blood cells (WBC) and platelet count in the blood. To avoid this, your doctor will closely monitor your blood count periodically before and during management with BENDIT 100MG INJECTION.

Before receiving BENDIT 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have severe bone marrow depression, any infections, or severe changes in white blood cells and platelet count.

BENDIT 100MG INJECTION should not be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women, as it may cause serious harm to the growing fetus or nursing infant. Consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of receiving BENDIT 100MG INJECTION are nausea, vomiting, hair loss, oral sores, diarrhea, constipation, fever, dehydration, headache, and tiredness. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects bother you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BENDIT 100MG INJECTION

It is used either alone or in combination with other anticancer medicines to manage:

Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia
Non-Hodgkin’s Lymphoma
Multiple Myeloma
mechanismOfAction:
How BENDIT 100MG INJECTION Works

BENDIT 100MG INJECTION belongs to an anticancer agent that acts by damaging the genetic material (either DNA or RNA) of cancer cells, which inhibits the cancer cells from growing and multiplying within the body.
usageDetails:
How to use BENDIT 100MG INJECTION

BENDIT 100MG INJECTION will be administered into the vein only by a doctor or a nurse. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

BENDIT 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with respiratory diseases such as bronchitis. Consult your doctor before receiving it.
BENDIT 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with heart disease (such as chest pain, heart attack, or irregular heart rhythm). Consult your doctor before receiving it.
The safety and effectiveness of BENDIT 100MG INJECTION in children have not been established. Consult your doctor for advice.
BENDIT 100MG INJECTION should be used with caution with elderly patients. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

Have recently had or had any major surgery (less than 30 days before starting this management)
Have an infection accompanied by a low white blood cell count

Before receiving BENDIT 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have signs or symptoms of infection (fever, weakness, body pain, including lungs symptoms such as cough, shortness of breath, wheezing, or chest pain)

introduction:
Introduction About OXIPLAT 50 INJECTION

OXIPLAT 50 INJECTION contains Oxaliplatin which belongs to the group of medicine called Anticancer drugs. It is used to manage cancers of the colon and/or rectum. It is highly used in combination with other anti-cancer medicines (such as 5-flurouracil and folinic acid) as an adjunct to manage stage III colon cancer after removing the primary tumour. It can also be used to manage metastatic colorectal cancer (cancer of colon and rectum that has been spread to other parts of the body).

Before receiving OXIPLAT 50 INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have low white blood count in your blood or recently received or planning to receive any vaccination in the upcoming days.

OXIPLAT 50 INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years. Men and women receiving OXIPLAT 50 INJECTION must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with OXIPLAT 50 INJECTION.

The most common side effects of receiving OXIPLAT 50 INJECTION are tingling and numbness of body parts, abnormal sensation in the throat, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, headache, dizziness, tiredness, weight loss, changes in taste, skin rash, hair loss, mouth ulcers and low blood calcium levels. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of OXIPLAT 50 INJECTION

It is used to manage:

Colon cancer (stage III)
Metastatic colorectal cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How OXIPLAT 50 INJECTION Works

OXIPLAT 50 INJECTION is an anticancer medication. It works by damaging the DNA (genetic material) of the cancer cells. As a result, it reduces abnormal growth and multiplication of cancer cells in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use OXIPLAT 50 INJECTION

OXIPLAT 50 INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein (as an intravenous infusion).

introduction:
Introduction About DAUNOTEC 20MG INJECTION

DAUNOTEC 20MG INJECTION is used for inducing remissions of acute myelogenous and lymphocytic leukaemias and for the management of acute lymphocytic leukaemia and acute myloid leukaemia in children, as part of a combination regimen. DAUNOTEC 20MG INJECTION contains Daunorubicin which belongs to the group of medicines known as Chemotherapeutic agents. It works by attacking and destroying the abnormal white blood cells which are present in the person with leukaemia.

DAUNOTEC 20MG INJECTION is not recommended in patients who are recently exposed to, or with existing, chicken pox or herpes zoster, persistent myelosuppression, have severe infection, severe hepatic or renal function impairment. DAUNOTEC 20MG INJECTION should be used with caution if you had radiation therapy for the chest, have or had gout. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine. DAUNOTEC 20MG INJECTION should not be used during pregnancy unless the clinical condition of the woman requires treatment with DAUNOTEC 20MG INJECTION and justifies the potential risk to the foetus. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

Your doctor will administer the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and severity of the disease. DAUNOTEC 20MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients with inadequate bone marrow reserves to old age. The most common side effects of receiving DAUNOTEC 20MG INJECTION are nausea, vomiting or diarrhoea. If any of these side effects worsen, contact your doctor immediately.

mechanismOfAction:
How DAUNOTEC 20MG INJECTION Works

DAUNOTEC 20MG INJECTION contains Daunorubicin which is an anthracycline glycoside antibiotic and potent antileukaemic agent. The exact mechanism of antineoplastic action is uncertain but may involve binding to DNA by intercalation between base pairs and inhibition of DNA and RNA synthesis by template disordering and steric obstruction. It is most active in the S-phase of cell division but is not cycle phase specific.

DAUNOTEC 20MG INJECTION will be administered by your doctor or nurse by intravenously. It is not recommended for intramuscular administration. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.
