introduction:
Introduction About LUPORAL CAPSULE

LUPORAL CAPSULE is a combination of Tegafur and Uracil which belongs to the group of medicines called Thymidylate synthase inhibitors. It is used with calcium folinate to manage metastatic colorectal cancer which is a type of cancer that begins in the colon or rectum and spreads to other parts of the body and characterized by symptoms such as rectal bleeding, narrow stools, persistent abdominal pain and unexplained weight loss.

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you for a liver function test to assess the function of your liver. LUPORAL CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe hepatic impairment, bone marrow suppression from previous radiotherapy or dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase deficiency disease (a severe neurological disease marked by seizures).   

Before taking LUPORAL CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have heart, kidney or liver disease. LUPORAL CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women and it is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years).  

This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 75 years or above) with age-related impaired kidney, liver or heart function and other concomitant medications or diseases.

The most common side effects of taking LUPORAL CAPSULE are nausea, diarrhea, constipation, stomach pain, headache, dizziness and dry skin. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects get worse.
uses: Manage metastatic colorectal cancer (in combination with calcium folinate)

Manage metastatic colorectal cancer (in combination with calcium folinate)
mechanismOfAction:
How LUPORAL CAPSULE Works

LUPORAL CAPSULE helps in managing the spread of colorectal cancer cells, where tegafur works by converting into fluorouracil or 5-FU in the liver which causes destruction of cancer cells and uracil works by managing the degradation of 5-FU which results in the prolongation of its stay in the cancer cells thus resulting in the destruction of colorectal cancer cells and managing its spread to other parts of the body.

How to use LUPORAL CAPSULE

Always take this medicine as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your age and disease condition.

CYTOTREX 10 TABLET contains Methotrexate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimetabolites. CYTOTREX 10 TABLET is used to manage active rheumatoid arthritis in adults, which is a form of severe arthritis occurring due to unknown reasons (idiopathic) and old age and is non-responsive to conventional painkillers (such as Non-Steroidal Anti Inflammatory Drugs Ex. Aceclofenac).

CYTOTREX 10 TABLET is also used to manage its polyarthritic forms (characterized by the involvement of five or more joints), which are severe, active, and idiopathic in nature and affect young people (Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis, JIA).

CYTOTREX 10 TABLET is also used to manage psoriasis and relapsed (reoccurred) and refractory (unaffected by other conventional managements) Non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma, which is a type of cancer of the lymphatic system.

Psoriasis is a skin condition characterized by itchy scales that is not responsive to conventional managements such as phototherapy and retinoids.

Before taking CYTOTREX 10 TABLET, it is recommended to inform the doctor about your medical and family history, including the list of medicines (prescription, non-prescription medicines, and herbal medicines) that are being taken.

Also, CYTOTREX 10 TABLET is not recommended to be taken by pregnant and nursing women, women planning pregnancy, those who drink huge amounts of alcohol, or patients suffering from liver and kidney impairment.

CYTOTREX 10 TABLET is not recommended in children for the management of psoriasis and rheumatoid arthritis. However, CYTOTREX 10 TABLET can be used with caution in children to manage polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis, which is characterized by the involvement of five or more joints that are of severe, active, juvenile, and idiopathic character. Consult the doctor before taking CYTOTREX 10 TABLET.

In addition, caution must be exercised by patients suffering from lung disorders, blood disorders, and gastric disorders before taking CYTOTREX 10 TABLET.

Care must be taken to avoid taking products containing caffeine, such as black tea, coffee, and cold drinks, while taking CYTOTREX 10 TABLET.

The common side effects seen after taking CYTOTREX 10 TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and altered levels of blood cells. Consult a doctor if any of the above side effects worsen after taking CYTOTREX 10 TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How CYTOTREX 10 TABLET Works

CYTOTREX 10 TABLET contains methotrexate that works by interfering with the growth of those cells in the body that reproduce quickly. As a result, the growth of those cells gets retarded, thus serving as an anti-tumour agent. Also, it decreases the undesired reactions of the body’s own immune-defense mechanism, thereby working as an effective immunosuppressant. Additionally, it also exhibits anti-inflammatory effects, thereby reducing pain, swelling, and redness. As a result, it manages the symptoms associated with diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis.
usageDetails:
How to use CYTOTREX 10 TABLET

Take CYTOTREX 10 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

warnings.details: CYTOTREX 10 TABLET is not recommended for use if you are pregnant and/or are planning to become pregnant since it can be harmful to the foetus (growing baby) and lead to various malformations. Consult your doctor before taking CYTOTREX 10 TABLET.
CYTOTREX 10 TABLET is not recommended if you are a nursing mother. Consult your doctor before taking CYTOTREX 10 TABLET.
CYTOTREX 10 TABLET is not recommended if you feel tired or dizzy after taking the medicine. Consult your doctor before taking CYTOTREX 10 TABLET.
It is recommended to avoid the consumption of alcohol while taking CYTOTREX 10 TABLET, as it may increase the risk of liver damage. Consult your doctor before taking CYTOTREX 10 TABLET.
CYTOTREX 10 TABLET is not recommended if you have or have had a kidney disorder and/or are receiving any dialysis> management. Consult your doctor before taking CYTOTREX 10 TABLET.
CYTOTREX 10 TABLET is not recommended if you have a liver disorder. Consult your doctor before taking CYTOTREX 10 TABLET.
CYTOTREX 10 TABLET is not recommended if you are allergic to methotrexate and/or any other constituent of CYTOTREX 10 TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking CYTOTREX 10 TABLET.
CYTOTREX 10 TABLET is recommended to be taken with caution if you have issues with lung function and are diagnosed with pleural effusion. Consult your doctor before taking CYTOTREX 10 TABLET.

CYTOTREX 10 TABLET is not recommended in children for the management of psoriasis and rheumatoid arthritis. However, CYTOTREX 10 TABLET can be used with caution in children to manage polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis. Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depending on your child’s age, body weight, and health condition. Consult your doctor for advice before taking CYTOTREX 10 TABLET.

CYTOTREX 10 TABLET is recommended to be administered with caution and in a lower dosage to elders due to diminished function of the liver and kidneys and reduced folate levels in the blood in old age. Also, it is recommended to closely monitor the elderly, taking CYTOTREX 10 TABLET for the identification of possible side effects. Consult the doctor before taking CYTOTREX 10 TABLET.

Others

CYTOTREX 10 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have bone marrow disorders
Have blood disorders
Have an impaired immune system
Have a severe and/or existing infection (Ex. tuberculosis, HIV)
Have ulcers in the gastro-intestinal tract
Have inflammation and ulcers of the mouth
Are receiving vaccinations containing live vaccines

Before taking CYTOTREX 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have diabetes
Are overweight
Suffer from diarrhea
Ulcers in the colon (ulcerative colitis)
Are receiving radiotherapy for various conditions, such as X-rays and UV-rays
Have folate deficiency
Have lactose and/or galactose intolerance
Have mental illness

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking CYTOTREX 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. amoxicillin, ciprofloxacin)
Medicines used to increase urine excretion (Ex. frusemide)
Medicines used to manage increased sugar levels (Ex. metformin)
Medicines used to manage fits (Ex. phenytoin)
Medicines used to manage increased cholesterol levels (Ex. cholestyramine)
Medicines used to manage gout (Ex. probenecid)
Medicines to manage reduced folic acid levels (Ex. folic acid preparations)
Medicines used to manage severe heartburn or ulcers (Ex. omeprazole)
Other medicines used to manage rheumatoid arthritis (Ex. leflunomide)
Medicines that can be harmful to the liver (Ex. sulfasalazine)
Medicines used in the management of cancer (Ex. doxorubicin, cisplatin, and mercaptopurine)
Medicines used to manage pain (Ex. ibuprofen, naproxen, diclofenac)
Other medicines used to manage rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis (Ex. leflunomide, phenylbutazone, or amidopyrine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. theophylline)
Medicines used in organ transplantation (Ex. cyclosporin, azathioprine)
Medicines used to induce sleep (Ex. phenobarbitone)
Medicines used to induce calmness and relieve anxiety (Ex. diazepam)
Medicines used for oral contraception (Ex. estrogen)
Medicines used to manage skin conditions (Ex. retinoids)
Medicines used to manage malaria (Ex. pyrimethamine)
Medicines that contain live vaccines (Ex. MMR vaccine)
Medicines used for general anesthesia and pain relief (Ex. nitrous oxide)
Medicines used to manage heart problems (Ex. amiodarone)
Medicines used to manage heart failure (Ex. digoxin)
Medicines used for the management of various inflammatory conditions like skin diseases and allergic reactions (Ex. hydrocortisone)

B. Drug-Food interactions:

It is recommended to avoid the consumption of drinks containing caffeine, such as black tea, coffee, and soft drinks, along with CYTOTREX 10 TABLET, to manage dehydration.

Overdosage:

If you or someone else accidentally takes too much CYTOTREX 10 TABLET, it is recommended to consult your doctor immediately. Symptoms of overdosage with CYTOTREX 10 TABLET are an easy tendency to bruise or bleed, nausea, vomiting, and unusual weakness, along with the development of mouth sores and ulcers.

Introduction About FOLITRAX 20MG TABLET

FOLITRAX 20MG TABLET contains Methotrexate which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimetabolites. It is used to manage rheumatoid arthritis and ALL (acute lymphocytic/lymphoblastic leukemia) in adults. In addition, it is also used to manage bone cancer and lung cancer. FOLITRAX 20MG TABLET is also used to manage polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis in children.

Rheumatoid arthritis is an auto-immune disease that results in the inflammation of bones due to the body’s own immune system. Acute lymphocytic/lymphoblastic leukemia is a type of cancer that develops from white blood cells in the bone marrow and may suddenly spread to invade other body parts such as the spleen, brain, and lymph nodes. Polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis is characterized by the involvement of five or more joints that are severe, active, juvenile, and idiopathic in nature.

Before taking FOLITRAX 20MG TABLET, it is recommended to inform the doctor about your medical and family history, including the list of medicines (prescription, non-prescription medicines, and herbal medicines) that are being taken.

FOLITRAX 20MG TABLET is not recommended to be taken by pregnant and nursing women, women planning pregnancy, those who drink huge amounts of alcohol, or patients suffering from liver and kidney impairment.

FOLITRAX 20MG TABLET is not recommended in children for the management of psoriasis and rheumatoid arthritis. Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depending on your child’s age, body weight, and disease condition. Consult the doctor before taking FOLITRAX 20MG TABLET.

Caution must be exercised by patients suffering from lung disorders, blood disorders, and gastric disorders before taking FOLITRAX 20MG TABLET.

Care must be taken to avoid taking products containing caffeine, such as black tea, coffee, and cold drinks, while taking FOLITRAX 20MG TABLET.

The most common side effects seen after taking FOLITRAX 20MG TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and altered levels of blood cells. Consult a doctor if any of the above side effects worsen after taking FOLITRAX 20MG TABLET.

Allergy

CONTRAINDICATED

FOLITRAX 20MG TABLET is recommended to be taken with caution if you have issues with lung function and are diagnosed with pleural effusion. Consult your doctor before taking FOLITRAX 20MG TABLET.

FOLITRAX 20MG TABLET is not recommended in children for the management of psoriasis and rheumatoid arthritis. Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depending on your child’s age, body weight, and disease condition. Consult the doctor before taking FOLITRAX 20MG TABLET.

USE WITH CAUTION

FOLITRAX 20MG TABLET is recommended to be administered with caution and in a lower dosage to elderly patients due to diminished function of the liver and kidneys and reduced folate levels in the blood. Consult the doctor before taking FOLITRAX 20MG TABLET.

If you or someone else accidentally takes too much of FOLITRAX 20MG TABLET, it is recommended to consult your doctor immediately. introduction:
Introduction About IRINOTEL 40MG INJECTION

IRINOTEL 40MG INJECTION contains Irinotecan which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer agents. It is used to manage advanced or metastatic colorectal cancer (cancers of colon and rectum). It can also be used to manage colorectal cancer among patients whose disease has recurred or progressed following initial chemotherapy with 5-Fluorouracil.

IRINOTEL 40MG INJECTION is mostly used in combination with other anticancer medicines to achieve better results. Before receiving IRINOTEL 40MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have hypertension or any other heart problems.

You must also inform your doctor if you have high blood cholesterol levels, elevated bilirubin levels in the blood or any inflammation in the gut as a precaution. IRINOTEL 40MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women as it may harm the growing baby.

Both men and women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with this medicine. Men may seek advice on sperm preservation, if necessary, prior to the therapy with this medicine.

IRINOTEL 40MG INJECTION may cause severe nausea, vomiting and diarrhea. To manage this, your doctor will prescribe a suitable anti-emetic and antidiarrheal medicines along with this medicine. However, inform your doctor immediately if these side effects worsen.

Other most common side effects of receiving IRINOTEL 40MG INJECTION are stomach pain mouth ulcers, hair loss, tiredness, weakness, increased infections, increased bleeding tendency and difficulty in passing stools. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How IRINOTEL 40MG INJECTION Works

IRINOTEL 40MG INJECTION is an anticancer medication. It works by blocking the actions of certain enzymes (DNA-Topoisomerase-1) within the cells which is required for the cells to grow and multiply. As a result, it manages abnormal cell division and slows down the growth and spread of cancer cells within the body.

IRINOTEL 40MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (as an intravenous infusion).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Others

Have any obstructions or block in the gut
Have elevated bilirubin levels in the blood
Have severe bone marrow failure
Are in a poor general condition
Are taking an herbal medicine called St. John’s Wort for mental illnesses
Recently got vaccinated with a live attenuated vaccine (Ex. vaccine for chicken pox, shingles, measles, mumps, rubella, tuberculosis, rotavirus, influenza)

Have Gilbert’s syndrome (an inherited condition that causes elevated bilirubin levels and jaundice)
Have a habit of smoking
Have high blood cholesterol levels
Are scheduled for any surgeries (including minor dental surgeries)

introduction:
Introduction About INTAXEL 260MG INJECTION

INTAXEL 260MG INJECTION contains Paclitaxel which belongs to a group of anti-cancer medicines called Taxanes. INTAXEL 260MG INJECTION is used to manage ovarian and breast cancer as a first line of therapy and as a second line of management when platinum containing medicines (such as cisplatin) or anthracyclines are insufficient to manage the disease in affected individuals.

INTAXEL 260MG INJECTION is also used to manage advanced NSCLC (non-small cell lung cancer) when surgery/radiation therapy is not suitable. The medicine is also indicated for use to manage AIDS-related Kaposi’s sarcoma when other managements (such as anthracyclines) are insufficient to manage the disease in affected individuals.

INTAXEL 260MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to paclitaxel and polyoxyethylated castor oil. It is also not recommended for use in patients with few white blood cells count and serious & uncontrolled infection. The medicine is also not used in patients suffering from severe liver disease.

Before receiving INTAXEL 260MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had previously received radiation to your chest and/or suffering from thrombocytopenia (low platelet count)/acute infections (such as herpes zoster, chickenpox, herpes), kidney problems (such as chronic kidney disease), liver problems (such as mild/moderate hepatic impairment) and/or heart problems (such as severe coronary artery disease, myocardial infarction and arrhythmias).

INTAXEL 260MG INJECTION is not recommended for use during pregnancy. Women of child-bearing potential should use effective contraception method while receiving INTAXEL 260MG INJECTION which should be continued for next-6 months after completing the management. The medicine is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

INTAXEL 260MG INJECTION is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The medicine can be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving INTAXEL 260MG INJECTION are minor allergic reactions (such as flushing, rash, itching), shortness of breath, sore throat/mouth ulcers, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting and/or loss of hair. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About KEMOCARB 450MG INJECTION

KEMOCARB 450MG INJECTION contains Carboplatin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used to manage advanced ovarian cancer and small-cell lung cancer. It is generally used in combination with other anti-cancer medicines to achieve better results.

Advanced ovarian cancer is a cancer that originates in the ovary and spreads to other parts of the body and small cell lung cancer is cancer that occurs in the tissues of the lungs. It is caused mainly by smoking and is characterized by symptoms such as chest pain, coughing with blood, shortness of breath, tiredness, and weight loss.

Before receiving KEMOCARB 450MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have a fever or low blood counts before receiving KEMOCARB 450MG INJECTION. KEMOCARB 450MG INJECTION should not be used by pregnant or breastfeeding women.

Men receiving KEMOCARB 450MG INJECTION must not father a child during management with KEMOCARB 450MG INJECTION and up to six months after stopping the therapy. Both men and women receiving KEMOCARB 450MG INJECTION must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with KEMOCARB 450MG INJECTION.

The use of KEMOCARB 450MG INJECTION may cause an abnormal decrease in total blood counts. It may also cause nausea, vomiting, mouth sores, hearing loss, loss of taste, tingling or numbness of body parts, increased serum creatinine levels, difficulty passing urine, increased bilirubin levels in the blood, and changes in vision.

To avoid this, your doctor will closely monitor your blood count, liver functions, kidney functions, nerve functions, and ear functions. However, consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Advanced ovarian cancer (cancer that originated in the ovary and spread to other parts of the body)
usesDetails:
Uses Of KEMOCARB 450MG INJECTION

It is used either alone or in combination with other anticancer medicines to manage:

Advanced ovarian cancer (cancer that originated in the ovary and spread to other parts of the body)
Small cell lung carcinoma (lung cancer)
mechanismOfAction:
How KEMOCARB 450MG INJECTION Works

KEMOCARB 450MG INJECTION is an anticancer medicine. It acts by damaging the genetic material (DNA and RNA) of the cancer cells. This inhibits the cancer cells from growing and multiplying within the body.

How to use KEMOCARB 450MG INJECTION

KEMOCARB 450MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About MEDITREX 5 TABLET

MEDITREX 5 TABLET contains Methotrexate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimetabolites. MEDITREX 5 TABLET is used to manage active rheumatoid arthritis in adults, which is a form of severe arthritis occurring due to unknown reasons (idiopathic) and old age and is non-responsive to conventional painkillers (such as Non-Steroidal Anti Inflammatory Drugs Ex. Aceclofenac).

MEDITREX 5 TABLET is also used to manage its polyarthritic forms (characterized by the involvement of five or more joints), which are severe, active, and idiopathic in nature and affect young people (Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis, JIA).

MEDITREX 5 TABLET is also used to manage psoriasis and relapsed (reoccurred) and refractory (unaffected by other conventional managements) Non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma, which is a type of cancer of the lymphatic system.

Psoriasis is a skin condition characterized by itchy scales that is not responsive to conventional managements such as phototherapy and retinoids.

Before taking MEDITREX 5 TABLET, it is recommended to inform the doctor about your medical and family history, including the list of medicines (prescription, non-prescription medicines, and herbal medicines) that are being taken.

Also, MEDITREX 5 TABLET is not recommended to be taken by pregnant and nursing women, women planning pregnancy, those who drink huge amounts of alcohol, or patients suffering from liver and kidney impairment.

MEDITREX 5 TABLET is not recommended in children for the management of psoriasis and rheumatoid arthritis. However, MEDITREX 5 TABLET can be used with caution in children to manage polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis, which is characterized by the involvement of five or more joints that are of severe, active, juvenile, and idiopathic character. Consult the doctor before taking MEDITREX 5 TABLET.

In addition, caution must be exercised by patients suffering from lung disorders, blood disorders, and gastric disorders before taking MEDITREX 5 TABLET.

Care must be taken to avoid taking products containing caffeine, such as black tea, coffee, and cold drinks, while taking MEDITREX 5 TABLET.

The common side effects seen after taking MEDITREX 5 TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and altered levels of blood cells. Consult a doctor if any of the above side effects worsen after taking MEDITREX 5 TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How MEDITREX 5 TABLET Works

MEDITREX 5 TABLET contains methotrexate that works by interfering with the growth of those cells in the body that reproduce quickly. As a result, the growth of those cells gets retarded, thus serving as an anti-tumour agent. Also, it decreases the undesired reactions of the body’s own immune-defense mechanism, thereby working as an effective immunosuppressant. Additionally, it also exhibits anti-inflammatory effects, thereby reducing pain, swelling, and redness. As a result, it manages the symptoms associated with diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis.

How to use MEDITREX 5 TABLET

Take MEDITREX 5 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking MEDITREX 5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. amoxicillin, ciprofloxacin)
Medicines used to increase urine excretion (Ex. frusemide)
Medicines used to manage increased sugar levels (Ex. metformin)
Medicines used to manage fits (Ex. phenytoin)
Medicines used to manage increased cholesterol levels (Ex. cholestyramine)
Medicines used to manage gout (Ex. probenecid)
Medicines to manage reduced folic acid levels (Ex. folic acid preparations)
Medicines used to manage severe heartburn or ulcers (Ex. omeprazole)
Other medicines used to manage rheumatoid arthritis (Ex. leflunomide)
Medicines that can be harmful to the liver (Ex. sulfasalazine)
Medicines used in the management of cancer (Ex. doxorubicin, cisplatin, and mercaptopurine)
Medicines used to manage pain (Ex. ibuprofen, naproxen, diclofenac)
Other medicines used to manage rheumatoid arthritis and psoriasis (Ex. leflunomide, phenylbutazone, or amidopyrine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. theophylline)
Medicines used in organ transplantation (Ex. cyclosporin, azathioprine)
Medicines used to induce sleep (Ex. phenobarbitone)
Medicines used to induce calmness and relieve anxiety (Ex. diazepam)
Medicines used for oral contraception (Ex. estrogen)
Medicines used to manage skin conditions (Ex. retinoids)
Medicines used to manage malaria (Ex. pyrimethamine)
Medicines that contain live vaccines (Ex. MMR vaccine)
Medicines used for general anesthesia and pain relief (Ex. nitrous oxide)
Medicines used to manage heart problems (Ex. amiodarone)
Medicines used to manage heart failure (Ex. digoxin)
Medicines used for the management of various inflammatory conditions like skin diseases and allergic reactions (Ex. hydrocortisone)

B. Drug-Food interactions:

It is recommended to avoid the consumption of drinks containing caffeine, such as black tea, coffee, and soft drinks, along with MEDITREX 5 TABLET, to manage dehydration.

Overdosage:

If you or someone else accidentally takes too much MEDITREX 5 TABLET, it is recommended to consult your doctor immediately. Symptoms of overdosage with MEDITREX 5 TABLET are an easy tendency to bruise or bleed, nausea, vomiting, and unusual weakness, along with the development of mouth sores and ulcers.

introduction:
Introduction About LENALID 10MG CAPSULE

LENALID 10MG CAPSULE contains Lenalidomide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Immunomodulatory agents. It is used in the management of multiple myeloma, myelodysplastic syndromes, mantle cell lymphoma and follicular lymphoma. Cancer is a disease in which abnormal cells divide uncontrollably in the body and destroy body tissue.

Multiple myeloma is a type of cancer that affects a type of white blood cell (plasma cell) that collects in the bone marrow and divides uncontrollably, leading to kidney and bone damage. Myelodysplastic syndromes are a group of disorders that occur due to the abnormal functioning of blood cells.

Mantle cell lymphoma is a cancer of the lymph tissue where the B-cells or B lymphocytes (white blood cells) grow in an uncontrolled manner and build up in the lymph tissue, blood or bone marrow. Follicular lymphoma is slow-growing cancer that affects B lymphocytes that help fight infection.

Before taking LENALID 10MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have ever had blood clots, hepatitis B infection, varicella-zoster, HIV, kidney problems or a heart attack. LENALID 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use among pregnant or breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking LENALID 10MG CAPSULE are rashes, itching, muscle cramps, muscle weakness, muscle pain, muscle aches, bone pain, joint pain, back pain, pain in the extremities, weakness, tiredness, constipation, diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain and heartburn. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LENALID 10MG CAPSULE

It is used to manage:

Multiple myeloma
Myelodysplastic syndromes
Mantle cell lymphoma
Follicular lymphoma
mechanismOfAction:
How LENALID 10MG CAPSULE Works

LENALID 10MG CAPSULE works by enhancing the immune system that indirectly attacks the cancer cells. It stops the growth of new blood vessels within the tumour. It also limits the production of chemical messengers (cytokine and growth factor) which are responsible for the growth of cancer cells.
usageDetails:
How to use LENALID 10MG CAPSULE

Take LENALID 10MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About PEMETERO 100MG INJECTION

PEMETERO 100MG INJECTION contains Pemetrexed which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer agents. It is used to manage advanced stages of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). It can be used as a management option to control cancer progression in patients who have failed to respond adequately to conventional therapies.

PEMETERO 100MG INJECTION is also used to manage malignant cancer of pleural membrane (a protective layer surrounding the lungs), called as pleural mesothelioma. It is mostly used in combination with other anti-cancer medicines (such as cisplatin, carboplatin) to achieve better results.

Before receiving PEMETERO 100MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems or a previous history of the same. You must also inform your doctor if you have fluid accumulation in the lungs or recently received or planning to receive any radiation therapy or vaccination in the upcoming days as a precaution.

PEMETERO 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years. Men and women receiving PEMETERO 100MG INJECTION must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with PEMETERO 100MG INJECTION and for until 6 months after stopping the therapy.

The most common side effects of receiving PEMETERO 100MG INJECTION are increased infections, sore throat, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, dizziness, tiredness, weight loss, changes in taste, skin rash, hair loss and mouth ulcers. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How PEMETERO 100MG INJECTION Works

PEMETERO 100MG INJECTION is an anticancer medication. It works by blocking the activity of certain enzymes (Ex. dihydrofolate reductase, thymidylate synthase etc.) in the body that may help cancer cells to grow and multiply. As a result, it reduces abnormal growth and multiplication of cancer cells in the body.

How to use PEMETERO 100MG INJECTION

PEMETERO 100MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein (as an intravenous infusion).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Previously had severe reactions to fluoropyrimidine therapy (a group of anticancer medicines such as fluorouracil)
Have severely low levels of white cells or platelets in the blood (leukopenia, neutropenia, or thrombocytopenia)
Have complete DPD deficiency (do not have any activity of the enzyme dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (DPD)
Are being managed now or have been managed in the last 4 weeks for herpes zoster (chickenpox or shingles) with brivudine

Before taking CAPNAT 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have a partial deficiency in the activity of the enzyme dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (DPD)
Have a family member who has a partial or complete deficiency of the enzyme dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (DPD)
Have a brain disease (Ex. cancer that has spread to the brain) or nerve damage (neuropathy)
Have a calcium imbalance or other electrolyte imbalances
Have diabetes
Cannot keep food or water in your body because of severe nausea and vomiting
Have a history of eye problems
Have diarrhea
Are dehydrated
Have a severe skin reaction
Have intolerance to lactose or other sugars

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of CAPNAT 500MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdosage are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, inflammation or ulceration of the gut or mouth, pain or bleeding from the intestine or stomach, or bone marrow depression (reduction in certain kinds of blood cells).

introduction:
Introduction About CAZANAT 60 TABLET

CAZANAT 60 TABLET contains Cabozantinib, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer drugs. It is used in adults to manage advanced kidney cancer. It can also be used in the management of liver cancer and advanced thyroid cancer when management with other conventional cancer medicines (such as sorafenib) and radiotherapy is not responding appropriately.

Take CAZANAT 60 TABLET on an empty stomach. You should not eat anything for at least 2 hours before and for 1 hour after taking the medicine. Before taking CAZANAT 60 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems.

You must also inform your doctor if you have high blood pressure, thyroid problems, inflammatory bowel diseases, abnormal bulging or tears in blood vessels, a recent history of blood clot formation, a stroke, or a heart attack, as a precaution.

During management with CAZANAT 60 TABLET, it is important for you to practice good oral hygiene. You must also inform your dentist about this medicine if you need to visit the dentist regularly.

Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking CAZANAT 60 TABLET, as it may increase the risk of side effects. CAZANAT 60 TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women.

Men and women taking CAZANAT 60 TABLET must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with CAZANAT 60 TABLET. Men may also seek advice on sperm preservation, if necessary, prior to therapy with this medicine.

The most common side effects of taking CAZANAT 60 TABLET are nausea, vomiting, stomach upset, skin rashes, blisters, and pain in the hands or soles of the feet, weight loss, altered taste sensation, tiredness, weakness, sore mouth, throat, and tongue, fistulas, and piles. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CAZANAT 60 TABLET

It is used by adults to manage:

Advanced kidney cancer
Liver cancer
Advanced thyroid cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How CAZANAT 60 TABLET Works

CAZANAT 60 TABLET is an anti-cancer medicine. It works by blocking the actions of certain proteins (such as receptor tyrosine kinases) in the body that trigger cancer formation. As a result, it manages abnormal cell division within the body and slows down the growth of cancer cells in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use CAZANAT 60 TABLET

Take CAZANAT 60 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. CAZANAT 60 TABLET should not be taken with food. You should not eat anything for at least 2 hours before and for 1 hour after taking the medicine.

Try to take CAZANAT 60 TABLET at the same time each day. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight, and health condition. Do not stop taking CAZANAT 60 TABLET unless advised by your doctor.

name: PHOXELON 500 Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About PHOXELON 500 INJECTION

PHOXELON 500 INJECTION contains Cyclophosphamide, which belongs to a group of medicines called Cytotoxic agents or Anti-cancer agents. It is indicated for malignant diseases in adults and children (such as malignant lymphomas, Hodgkin’s disease, Non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma, lymphocytic lymphoma mixed-cell type lymphoma, histiocytic lymphoma, Burkitt’s lymphoma, multiple myeloma, chronic lymphocytic leukemia, chronic granulocytic leukemia, acute myelogenous and monocytic leukemia, acute lymphoblastic leukemia, mycosis fungoides, neuroblastoma, adenocarcinoma of the ovary, retinoblastoma, Ewing’s sarcoma, breast cancer. It is also used for minimal change nephrotic syndrome in children.

PHOXELON 500 INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with acute infections, bone-marrow aplasia, urinary tract infections like cystitis, acute urothelial toxicity from cytotoxic chemotherapy or radiation therapy, urinary outflow obstruction, or unmanageed infections. Before receiving PHOXELON 500 INJECTION inform your doctor if you are allergic or have anaphylactic reactions, bone marrow suppression, neutropenic fever, serious infections, severe immune suppression, concomitant chemotherapy and/or radiation therapy, urinary tract and renal diseases, heart diseases, pneumonitis, pulmonary fibrosis, pulmonary veno-occlusive disease, respiratory failure, pneumonitis and secondary malignancies, veno-occlusive liver disease, SIADH (syndrome of inappropriate secretion of antidiuretic hormone), rare hereditary problems of fructose intolerance, galactose intolerance, glucose-galactose malabsorption, Lapp lactase deficiency, sucrase-isomaltase insufficiency, adrenal insufficiency, diabetes and poor general health.

PHOXELON 500 INJECTION is not recommended for use by pregnant women. It is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. PHOXELON 500 INJECTION should be used with caution in children and adolescents. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of receiving PHOXELON 500 INJECTION are nausea, vomiting, weight loss, alopecia, hematuria and leukopenia. Contact your doctor if any of your symptoms gets worse or persists for a long duration.

mechanismOfAction:
How PHOXELON 500 INJECTION Works

PHOXELON 500 INJECTION works by interfering with the malignant cell growth by cross-linking of cancer cells DNA. PHOXELON 500 INJECTION also transfers alkyl groups to DNA during the process of cell division, thus managing the normal synthesis of DNA. Therefore it works against the growth and multiplication of cancer cells.

PHOXELON 500 INJECTION will be administered only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous injection or infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About KRABEVA 400MG INJECTION

KRABEVA 400MG INJECTION contains Bevacizumab, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antineoplastic agents. It is used in adult patients with fluoropyrimidine (a chemotherapy medicine) to manage metastatic cancer in the large bowel (colon or rectum). It is also used with Paclitaxel or Capecitabine (chemotherapy medicine) to manage metastatic breast cancer in adult patients.

KRABEVA 400MG INJECTION is used with a chemotherapy regimen containing platinum to manage advanced non-small cell lung cancer without epidermal growth factor receptor (a mutated protein responsible for causing cancer in a cell) and with Erlotinib (a chemotherapy medicine) to manage metastatic non-small cell lung cancer with epidermal growth factor receptor (in cancer cells) in adult patients.

This medicine is indicated for use to manage metastatic kidney cancer along with interferon (chemotherapy medicine), which is also indicated for use with carboplatin, gemcitabine, and/or carboplatin and Paclitaxel (chemotherapy medicine) to manage recurrent advanced epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer in adult patients.

This medicine is also used to manage persistent, recurrent, or metastatic cervical cancer with or without Paclitaxel, Cisplatin, or Paclitaxel and Topotecan in adult patients. KRABEVA 400MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Bevacizumab, Chinese hamster ovary (CHO) cell products, and/or other recombinant human or humanized antibodies. It is also not recommended for use in patients who have recently undergone major operations or surgery.

Before receiving KRABEVA 400MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for an invasive dental management or surgery and/or suffer from conditions such as inflammation inside the abdomen, uncontrolled high blood pressure, dental problems, kidney problems, and liver problems (such as hepatic injury).

KRABEVA 400MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women or in women planning for pregnancy since it may cause harm to the unborn baby. It is also not recommended for use by breast-feeding women since it may interfere with the growth and development of the baby.

KRABEVA 400MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) since the safety and efficacy of the medicine are not established in this age group. It is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and older) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving KRABEVA 400MG INJECTION are constipation, loss of appetite, fever, eye problems (such as an increase in the production of tears), changes in speech or sense of taste, runny nose, and/or loss of body weight. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How KRABEVA 400MG INJECTION Works

KRABEVA 400MG INJECTION works by reducing microvascular growth of tumour blood vessels which leads to reduced blood flow to the tumour cells resulting in its death thus managing the disease and managing its spread to other parts of the body in affected individuals.

KRABEVA 400MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will determine the correct dose and duration for you based upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: TIPANAT 15 Tablet 20's
introduction:
Introduction About TIPANAT 15 TABLET

TIPANAT 15 TABLET is used to manage adults with colon cancer or rectal cancer (colorectal cancer). It is used when the cancer has spread to other parts of the body. It is also used when other treatments have not worked or when other treatments are not suitable. TIPANAT 15 TABLET is a combination of Tipiracil and Trifluridine which belongs to the group of medicines known as Antineoplastic Agent which interferes with DNA in cancer cells to stop them from making new cancer cells. Tipiracil stops trifluridine from being broken down by enzymes before it can act.

Before taking TIPANAT 15 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or had radiation treatment for your cancer, intolerance to galactose or the Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption. TIPANAT 15 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women.

TIPANAT 15 TABLET is not suitable for the use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. The most common side effects of TIPANAT 15 TABLET are weakness, feeling tired, decreased appetite, abdominal pain, indigestion and common cold. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects persists for a longer duration.

Introduction About GLIOZ 250MG CAPSULE

GLIOZ 250MG CAPSULE contains Temozolomide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antineoplastic agents. It is used for specific forms of brain tumours in adults with newly diagnosed glioblastoma multiforme, which is used first together with radiotherapy as a concomitant phase of therapy and then used alone as a monotherapy. It is also used in children (above 3 years) and adults to manage malignant gliomas, such as glioblastoma multiforme or anaplastic astrocytoma, if they return or get worse after standard management.

Glioblastoma multiforme is an aggressive type of cancer that affects the brain or spinal cord and is generally characterized by symptoms such as headache, nausea, drowsiness, blurred vision, personality changes, and seizures.

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to take liver function tests to assess the hepatotoxicity and function of your liver. Before taking GLIOZ 250MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had a hepatitis B infection (serious liver infection).

GLIOZ 250MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have certain kinds of blood cells that are severely reduced, such as white blood cells and platelet count. GLIOZ 250MG CAPSULE should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary and not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. It is not recommended for use in children below 3 years of age and should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from 3 to 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking GLIOZ 250MG CAPSULE. The most common side effects of taking GLIOZ 250MG CAPSULE are loss of appetite, difficulty while speaking, headache, vomiting, nausea, diarrhea, and constipation. Consult and inform your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.

introduction:
Introduction About ONCODOX 50MG INJECTION

ONCODOX 50MG INJECTION contains Doxorubicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used to manage certain types of cancers. It is used either alone or along with other anti-cancer medicines.

Cancer is a disease in which some of the cells of the body grow uncontrollably and spread to other parts of the body.

Before receiving ONCODOX 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had heart disease, either before or during radiotherapy, had or having live or live-attenuated vaccinations, are currently taking or have recently taken Trastuzumab (used in the management of certain cancers).

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Consult your doctor during breast-feeding before starting management with this medicine as it may pass through the breast milk and possibly harm your child. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

The most common side effects of ONCODOX 50MG INJECTION are infection, lack of appetite, inflammation in the mouth, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, reddening, swelling, pain, numbness and tingling in the palms and feet may also occur whilst being managed with this medicine.

Hair loss is very common and may be quite severe, beard growth may stop in men, fever, feeling weak, chills, abnormal ECG (electrical trace of the heart) results, raised levels of liver enzymes (as detected by a blood test) can determine if the medicine is having an abnormal effect on your liver, weight increased in patients with early breast cancer.
uses: Used to manage certain types of cancer
usesDetails:
Uses Of ONCODOX 50MG INJECTION
Used to manage certain types of cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How ONCODOX 50MG INJECTION Works

ONCODOX 50MG INJECTION works by suppressing the activity of an enzyme (topoisomerase II) involved in the DNA multiplication of the cancer cells. On the other hand, this also forms harmful chemicals (free radicals) which cause damage to the DNA. This slowdown the growth of cancer cells and eventually works against them.
usageDetails:
How to use ONCODOX 50MG INJECTION

ONCODOX 50MG INJECTION will be administered intravenously (IV) into the vein by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: ERLOTERO 150mg Tablet 30's
introduction:
Introduction About ERLOTERO 150MG TABLET

ERLOTERO 150MG TABLET contains Erlotinib which belongs to the group of medicines called Kinase inhibitors. It is used in adults to manage non-small cell lung cancer at an advanced stage, as initial therapy (or as therapy if disease remains largely unchanged after initial chemotherapy, provided your cancer cells have specific EGFR mutations).

It is also used if previous chemotherapy has not helped to stop the disease and to manage cancer of the pancreas at a metastatic stage in combination with gemcitabine. Cancer can be defined as body cells beginning to grow out of control. Cells in any part of the body can become cancer cells and can spread to other areas of the body. Your doctor may perform certain blood tests prior to the management.

Avoid smoking during the management of ERLOTERO 150MG TABLET, as it decreases the effect of the medicine. ERLOTERO 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe liver or kidney disease. Before taking ERLOTERO 150MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have diarrhea, glucuronidation disorder like Gilbert’s syndrome, history of peptic ulcers or diverticular disease, you use contact lenses, or have a history of eye problems (severe dry eyes, inflammation or ulcers of the cornea).

ERLOTERO 150MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary, therefore consult your doctor before taking it. ERLOTERO 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. The most common side effects of taking ERLOTERO 150MG TABLET are rash, infection, loss of appetite, decreased weight, or depression. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How ERLOTERO 150MG TABLET Works

ERLOTERO 150MG TABLET binds to the intracellular portion (tyrosine kinase) of the epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) and inhibits its activity. EGFR is expressed on the surface of both normal as well as cancer cells. Inhibition of EGFR and its signaling significantly decreases tumor multiplication and survival, resulting in cell death.

How to use ERLOTERO 150MG TABLET

Take ERLOTERO 150MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not take medicine with food. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CABOLONG 40 TABLET

CABOLONG 40 TABLET contains Cabozantinib, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer drugs. It is used in adults to manage advanced kidney cancer. It can also be used in the management of liver cancer and advanced thyroid cancer when management with other conventional cancer medicines (such as sorafenib) and radiotherapy is not responding appropriately.

Take CABOLONG 40 TABLET on an empty stomach. You should not eat anything for at least 2 hours before and for 1 hour after taking the medicine. Before taking CABOLONG 40 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems.

You must also inform your doctor if you have high blood pressure, thyroid problems, inflammatory bowel diseases, abnormal bulging or tears in blood vessels, a recent history of blood clot formation, a stroke, or a heart attack, as a precaution.

During management with CABOLONG 40 TABLET, it is important for you to practice good oral hygiene. You must also inform your dentist about this medicine if you need to visit the dentist regularly.

Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking CABOLONG 40 TABLET, as it may increase the risk of side effects. CABOLONG 40 TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women.

Men and women taking CABOLONG 40 TABLET must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with CABOLONG 40 TABLET. Men may also seek advice on sperm preservation, if necessary, prior to therapy with this medicine.

The most common side effects of taking CABOLONG 40 TABLET are nausea, vomiting, stomach upset, skin rashes, blisters, and pain in the hands or soles of the feet, weight loss, altered taste sensation, tiredness, weakness, sore mouth, throat, and tongue, fistulas, and piles. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CABOLONG 40 TABLET

It is used by adults to manage:

Advanced kidney cancer
Liver cancer
Advanced thyroid cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How CABOLONG 40 TABLET Works

CABOLONG 40 TABLET is an anti-cancer medicine. It works by blocking the actions of certain proteins (such as receptor tyrosine kinases) in the body that trigger cancer formation. As a result, it manages abnormal cell division within the body and slows down the growth of cancer cells in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use CABOLONG 40 TABLET

Take CABOLONG 40 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. CABOLONG 40 TABLET should not be taken with food. You should not eat anything for at least 2 hours before and for 1 hour after taking the medicine.

Try to take CABOLONG 40 TABLET at the same time each day. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight, and health condition. Do not stop taking CABOLONG 40 TABLET unless advised by your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About GLIOZ 100MG CAPSULE

GLIOZ 100MG CAPSULE contains Temozolomide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antineoplastic agents. It is used for specific forms of brain tumours in adults with newly diagnosed glioblastoma multiforme, which is used first together with radiotherapy as a concomitant phase of therapy and then used alone as a monotherapy. It is also used in children (above 3 years) and adults to manage malignant gliomas, such as glioblastoma multiforme or anaplastic astrocytoma, if they return or get worse after standard management.

Glioblastoma multiforme is an aggressive type of cancer that affects the brain or spinal cord and is generally characterized by symptoms such as headache, nausea, drowsiness, blurred vision, personality changes, and seizures.

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to take liver function tests to assess the hepatotoxicity and function of your liver. Before taking GLIOZ 100MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had a hepatitis B infection (serious liver infection).

GLIOZ 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have certain kinds of blood cells that are severely reduced, such as white blood cells and platelet count. GLIOZ 100MG CAPSULE should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary and not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. It is not recommended for use in children below 3 years of age and should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from 3 to 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking GLIOZ 100MG CAPSULE. The most common side effects of taking GLIOZ 100MG CAPSULE are loss of appetite, difficulty while speaking, headache, vomiting, nausea, diarrhea, and constipation. Consult and inform your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.

introduction:
Introduction About CAPESTATIC 500 TABLET

CAPESTATIC 500 TABLET contains capecitabine, which belongs to the group of medicines called antineoplastic agents. It is used in the management of abnormal growth of cells present in the colon, rectal, gastric, and breast regions. It may be used either alone or in combination with other medicines.

CAPESTATIC 500 TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe liver or kidney disease. CAPESTATIC 500 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease, kidney disease, heart problems, brain disease or nerve damage, diabetes, or a history of eye problems. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

CAPESTATIC 500 TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

CAPESTATIC 500 TABLET is not recommended for use by children and adolescents. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

The most common side effects of taking CAPESTATIC 500 TABLET are abdominal pain, rash, dry or itchy skin, tiredness, and loss of appetite. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: It inhibits the abnormal growth of cells present in the colon, rectal, gastric, and breast regions.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CAPESTATIC 500 TABLET
It inhibits the abnormal growth of cells present in the colon, rectal, gastric, and breast regions.
mechanismOfAction:
How CAPESTATIC 500 TABLET Works

CAPESTATIC 500 TABLET is an antimetabolite that works by stopping the abnormal growth of cells. Thus, it helps manage the conditions associated with it.
usageDetails:
How to use CAPESTATIC 500 TABLET

Take CAPESTATIC 500 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Take the medicine within 30 minutes after the end of a meal.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of CAPESTATIC 500 TABLET for you depending upon your age, body surface area, and disease condition. Do not stop taking CAPESTATIC 500 TABLET unless your doctor has told you to.

warnings.details: CAPESTATIC 500 TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant women. Women of childbearing potential should use effective contraception during management with CAPESTATIC 500 TABLET and for 6 months after the last dose.
CAPESTATIC 500 TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women, and do not breastfeed for 2 weeks after the last dose of CAPESTATIC 500 TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy, nauseous, or tired after taking CAPESTATIC 500 TABLET.
CAPESTATIC 500 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.
CAPESTATIC 500 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take CAPESTATIC 500 TABLET if you are allergic to Capecitabine or any of the other ingredients in this medicine.

CAPESTATIC 500 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart problems (Ex. an irregular heartbeat or chest pain radiating to the jaw and back brought on by physical effort and due to problems with the blood flow to the heart). Consult your doctor before taking CAPESTATIC 500 TABLET.
CAPESTATIC 500 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. Consult your doctor before taking CAPESTATIC 500 TABLET.

Others

CAPESTATIC 500 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Previously had severe reactions to fluoropyrimidine therapy (a group of anticancer medicines such as fluorouracil)
Have severely low levels of white cells or platelets in the blood (leukopenia, neutropenia, or thrombocytopenia)
Have complete DPD deficiency (do not have any activity of the enzyme dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (DPD)
Are being managed now or have been managed in the last 4 weeks for herpes zoster (chickenpox or shingles) with brivudine

Before taking CAPESTATIC 500 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have a partial deficiency in the activity of the enzyme dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (DPD)
Have a family member who has a partial or complete deficiency of the enzyme dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (DPD)
Have a brain disease (Ex. cancer that has spread to the brain) or nerve damage (neuropathy)
Have a calcium imbalance or other electrolyte imbalances
Have diabetes
Cannot keep food or water in your body because of severe nausea and vomiting
Have a history of eye problems
Have diarrhea
Are dehydrated
Have a severe skin reaction
Have intolerance to lactose or other sugars

name: Zelgor 500mg Tablet 60'S
introduction:
Introduction About ZELGOR 500MG TABLET

ZELGOR 500MG TABLET contains Abiraterone, which belongs to a group of medicines called Androgen biosynthesis inhibitors. ZELGOR 500MG TABLET is used with prednisone or prednisolone in adult men to manage prostate cancer that has spread to other parts of the body.

ZELGOR 500MG TABLET is also used to manage early stages of prostate cancer when used with androgen deprivation therapy (management that lowers testosterone hormone) and prednisone/prednisolone (medication) in affected individuals. ZELGOR 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to abiraterone. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from severe liver disease.

Before taking ZELGOR 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have high blood pressure, any other blood vessel problems (such as blood pressure, stroke), swelling in the feet, ankles, or legs, diabetes, lung problems (such as shortness of breath), heart problems (such as heart failure, irregular or rapid heart rate), kidney, and/or liver problems.

ZELGOR 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women since it is intended to be used only in male patients.While taking ZELGOR 500MG TABLET, male patients must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid exposure of this medicine to their female partners.

ZELGOR 500MG TABLET is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 75 years or older) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking ZELGOR 500MG TABLET are swelling in the legs or feet, high blood pressure, urinary tract infection, diarrhea, indigestion, chest pain, an irregular heartbeat, and/or a rash. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

usesDetails:
Uses Of ZELGOR 500MG TABLET

ZELGOR 500MG TABLET is used with prednisone/prednisolone:

To manage prostate cancer that has spread to other parts of the body
To manage early stages of prostate cancer when used with androgen deprivation therapy (management that lowers testosterone hormone) in affected individuals
mechanismOfAction:
How ZELGOR 500MG TABLET Works

ZELGOR 500MG TABLET is an androgen biosynthesis inhibitor that works by inhibiting the production of the 17α-hydroxylase (CYP17) enzyme needed to produce testosterone (male sex hormone), which enables the growth of cancer cells in the prostate gland. Since ZELGOR 500MG TABLET suppresses the production of testosterone, the cancer cells in the prostate gland won't be able to grow, thus managing its effects on the gland in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use ZELGOR 500MG TABLET

Take ZELGOR 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Avoid taking medicine with food. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking ZELGOR 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Tranquilizers (medicines used to manage fear, agitation, anxiety, tension, and related states of mental disturbance) Ex. diazepam, lorazepam, and chlordiazepoxide
Medicines used to manage diabetes (Ex. metformin, insulin, and pramlintide)
St. John’s wort (an herbal medicine used to manage depression)
Ketoconazole (medicine used to manage skin infections such as athlete's foot, jock itch, ringworm, and certain kinds of dandruff)
RA-223 (a radioactive drug used to manage prostate cancer)
Quinidine, procainamide, amiodarone, and sotalol (medicines used to manage an irregular heartbeat)
Medicines used in androgen deprivation management to manage prostate cancer (Ex. leuprolide, goserelin, triptorelin, and histrelin)
Methadone (medicine used for pain relief and part of drug addiction therapy)
Moxifloxacin (an antibiotic used to manage bacterial infections)
Antipsychotics (used for serious mental illnesses) Ex. aripiprazole, asenapine, and cariprazine

B. Drug-Food Interactions:

ZELGOR 500MG TABLET should not be taken with grapefruit juice since it may increase the risk of side effects.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of ZELGOR 500MG TABLET, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital right away.

PRO 5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease, kidney disease, heart problems, brain disease or nerve damage, diabetes, or a history of eye problems. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

PRO 5 TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

PRO 5 TABLET is not recommended for use by children and adolescents. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

The most common side effects of taking PRO 5 TABLET are abdominal pain, rash, dry or itchy skin, tiredness, and loss of appetite. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

usageDetails:
How to use PRO 5 TABLET

Take PRO 5 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Take the medicine within 30 minutes after the end of a meal.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of PRO 5 TABLET for you depending upon your age, body surface area, and disease condition. Do not stop taking PRO 5 TABLET unless your doctor has told you to.

Previously had severe reactions to fluoropyrimidine therapy (a group of anticancer medicines such as fluorouracil)
Have severely low levels of white cells or platelets in the blood (leukopenia, neutropenia, or thrombocytopenia)
Have complete DPD deficiency (do not have any activity of the enzyme dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (DPD)
Are being managed now or have been managed in the last 4 weeks for herpes zoster (chickenpox or shingles) with brivudine

Before taking PRO 5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have a partial deficiency in the activity of the enzyme dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (DPD)
Have a family member who has a partial or complete deficiency of the enzyme dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (DPD)
Have a brain disease (Ex. cancer that has spread to the brain) or nerve damage (neuropathy)
Have a calcium imbalance or other electrolyte imbalances
Have diabetes
Cannot keep food or water in your body because of severe nausea and vomiting
Have a history of eye problems
Have diarrhea
Are dehydrated
Have a severe skin reaction
Have intolerance to lactose or other sugars

introduction:
Introduction About LETRONAT + TABLET

LETRONAT + TABLET contains Letrozole which belongs to the group of medicines called Hormonal Chemotherapeutic agents. It is used for breast cancer in postmenopausal women. It can be given either as an initial therapy or following therapy with other medicines such as tamoxifen. It is also used for patients with advanced breast cancer with breast tumour spreading to other parts of the body. Breast cancer can be defined as the uncontrollable growth and division of cells present in the breast. It is predominantly caused due to hormonal imbalance (increased estrogen production) or due to lifestyle factors. Symptoms include breast pain or tenderness, purple or red colored breasts, nipple discharge and lump growths.

Before taking LETRONAT + TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems in your kidneys or liver. You must also inform your doctor before taking LETRONAT + TABLET if you have a history of any bone problems such as osteoporosis or joint pain.

LETRONAT + TABLET is only intended for use in women who have reached their menopause. It is strictly not recommended for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. The most common side effects of taking LETRONAT + TABLET are hot flushes, fatigue, increased sweating, joint pain, hair loss, vaginal bleeding, and high blood cholesterol levels. Talk to your doctor if any of these above side effect bothers you.

mechanismOfAction:
How LETRONAT + TABLET Works

LETRONAT + TABLET contains Letrozole which is an aromatase inhibitor acts by blocking the actions of an enzyme called aromatase in the body which is involved in the production of estrogen. This suppresses the release of excessive estrogen in the body that triggers breast cancer. As a result, it slows down from growing and spreading to other parts of the body.

Take LETRONAT + TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: HERDUO 250mg Tablet 30's
introduction:
Introduction About HERDUO 250MG TABLET

HERDUO 250MG TABLET contains Lapatinib which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer agents. It is used to manage metastatic breast cancer (cancer that has been spread to other parts of the body from breast). It is mostly used in combination with other anticancer or hormonal medicines (such as capecitabine, trastuzumab or anastrozole) to achieve better results.

HERDUO 250MG TABLET can be taken either one hour before or one hour after food. During management with HERDUO 250MG TABLET, your doctor will periodically monitor your heart, liver, kidney and lung functions as a precaution.

Before taking HERDUO 250MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diarrhea before taking this medicine.

Do not take HERDUO 250MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking HERDUO 250MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, weakness, indigestion, constipation, sore mouth, trouble sleeping, back pain, joint pain, headache, hot flushes, hair loss, nail disorder and abnormal heartbeat. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of HERDUO 250MG TABLET
Manage metastatic breast cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How HERDUO 250MG TABLET Works

HERDUO 250MG TABLET is an anticancer agent. It works by blocking the actions of certain cellular proteins (tyrosine kinase) that triggers cancer cell formation. It also blocks various downstream cell signalling pathways that triggers cancer growth within the body. As a result, it reduces cancer formation and manages its further growth within the body.
usageDetails:
How to use HERDUO 250MG TABLET

Take HERDUO 250MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. HERDUO 250MG TABLET can be taken either one hour before or one hour after food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take HERDUO 250MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About SUTIB 25 CAPSULE

SUTIB 25 CAPSULE contains Sunitinib which belongs to the group of medicines called Protein Kinase Inhibitors. It is used in the management of gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST) (a type of cancer of the stomach and bowel) where another anticancer medicine (imatinib) no longer works or you cannot take it and metastatic renal cell carcinoma (MRCC) (type of kidney cancer that has spread to other parts of the body).

SUTIB 25 CAPSULE is also used to manage pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (pNET) (tumors of the hormone-producing cells in the pancreas) that have progressed or cannot be removed with surgery. Your doctor might ask you to take blood tests, check your blood pressure and take your ECG during management with SUTIB 25 CAPSULE and as clinically indicated.

Before taking SUTIB 25 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have heart, kidney, liver, blood, thyroid or pancreatic problems, seizures and diabetes or if you recently had or are going to undergo any surgery.

Ask your doctor before taking SUTIB 25 CAPSULE during pregnancy. You should not breastfeed while taking SUTIB 25 CAPSULE so, consult your doctor before taking it. It is not known if SUTIB 25 CAPSULE is safe and effective in children and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking SUTIB 25 CAPSULE are rashes, itching, muscle cramps, bone pain weakness, tiredness, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, etc. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen or persists.

Gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST)

mechanismOfAction:
How SUTIB 25 CAPSULE Works

SUTIB 25 CAPSULE helps control cancer advancement by inhibiting the activity of a special group of proteins which are found to be involved in the growth and spread of cancer cells.
usageDetails:
How to use SUTIB 25 CAPSULE

Take SUTIB 25 CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow with enough water. Do not crush or chew it. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of SUTIB 25 CAPSULE management depending on your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking SUTIB 25 CAPSULE unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About ALRUBICIN 150MG INJECTION

ALRUBICIN 150MG INJECTION contains Epirubicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer agents. It is used to manage various types of cancer such as breast cancer, ovarian cancer, gastric cancer (stomach cancer), small cell lung cancer, head and neck cancer, liver cancer, blood cancer (leukemia), lymph cancer (lymphoma), pancreatic cancer and colorectal cancer (cancers of colon or rectum).  

It can also be used to manage cancers of soft tissues such as soft tissues sarcoma (cancer of the soft tissues that connects muscles, fats, blood vessels, nerves, tendons etc.) and helps to stop the occurrence of bladder cancer following surgeries (such as transurethral resection).

Before receiving ALRUBICIN 150MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any severe infections, low blood count or any bladder problems (such as problems in passing urine, burning sensation while passing urine etc.) as a precaution.

ALRUBICIN 150MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. Both men and women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with this medicine. Men may seek advice on sperm preservation, if necessary, prior to the therapy with this medicine.

The most common side effects of receiving ALRUBICIN 150MG INJECTION are hair loss, red urine, increased infection, hot flashes, mouth ulcers, inflammation of oesophagus, nausea, vomiting (within first 24 hours), loss of appetite, bladder infection, burning sensation while passing urine and pain, redness and swelling at the site of injection. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How ALRUBICIN 150MG INJECTION Works

ALRUBICIN 150MG INJECTION is an anticancer medication. It works by blocking the synthesis of genetic material (DNA and RNA) and certain essential proteins and enzymes which are required for the cells to grow and multiply. As a result, it stops abnormal cell division within the body, slows down the growth of cancer cells and eventually kills them.

ALRUBICIN 150MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (as an intravenous infusion) or into the bladder (intravesical administration).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy during the management and for at least 6.5 months after the last dose.
ALRUBICIN 150MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in women who are breastfeeding. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
ALRUBICIN 150MG INJECTION does not affect your ability to drive or handle any heavy tools or machines.

ALRUBICIN 150MG INJECTION is not recommended to use in patients with severe kidney problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other mild kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.

ALRUBICIN 150MG INJECTION is not recommended to use in patients with severe liver problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other mild liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
Talk to your doctor before receiving ALRUBICIN 150MG INJECTION if you are allergic to Epirubicin.

ALRUBICIN 150MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other mild heart problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
The safety and efficacy of ALRUBICIN 150MG INJECTION have not been established in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
ALRUBICIN 150MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.

Others

ALRUBICIN 150MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have previously received high doses of similar anticancer medicines
Suffer from severely reduced number of blood cells
Have an acute severe infection
Have bladder cancer that has been spread until the bladder wall
Have urinary tract infection
Have pain or inflammation of the bladder
Have problems in emptying your bladder
Pass bloody urine
Have a contracted bladder

Inform your doctor, before receiving ALRUBICIN 150MG INJECTION, if you:

Recently received any vaccine or plan to receive any vaccines
Recently had radiation therapy
