name: Pegadria 50mg Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About PEGADRIA 50MG INJECTION

PEGADRIA 50MG INJECTION contains Doxorubicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used to manage certain types of cancers. It is used either alone or along with other anti-cancer medicines.

Cancer is a disease in which some of the cells of the body grow uncontrollably and spread to other parts of the body.

Before receiving PEGADRIA 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had heart disease, either before or during radiotherapy, had or having live or live-attenuated vaccinations, are currently taking or have recently taken Trastuzumab (used in the management of certain cancers).

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Consult your doctor during breast-feeding before starting management with this medicine as it may pass through the breast milk and possibly harm your child. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

The most common side effects of PEGADRIA 50MG INJECTION are infection, lack of appetite, inflammation in the mouth, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, reddening, swelling, pain, numbness and tingling in the palms and feet may also occur whilst being managed with this medicine.

Hair loss is very common and may be quite severe, beard growth may stop in men, fever, feeling weak, chills, abnormal ECG (electrical trace of the heart) results, raised levels of liver enzymes (as detected by a blood test) can determine if the medicine is having an abnormal effect on your liver, weight increased in patients with early breast cancer.
uses: Used to manage certain types of cancer
usesDetails:
Uses Of PEGADRIA 50MG INJECTION
Used to manage certain types of cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How PEGADRIA 50MG INJECTION Works

PEGADRIA 50MG INJECTION works by suppressing the activity of an enzyme (topoisomerase II) involved in the DNA multiplication of the cancer cells. On the other hand, this also forms harmful chemicals (free radicals) which cause damage to the DNA. This slowdown the growth of cancer cells and eventually works against them.
usageDetails:
How to use PEGADRIA 50MG INJECTION

PEGADRIA 50MG INJECTION will be administered intravenously (IV) into the vein by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Nails and skin may appear darker than usual
Injection site reactions such as redness and swelling

Dizzy, feverish, short of breath with a tight chest or throat or having an itchy rash
Decrease in white blood cell counts which in turn causes an increase in infections and a raised temperature (fever)
Platelets can be affected which could make a bruise or bleed more easily
Irritation or bleeding in the intestines
Inflammation of the lining of the stomach
Soreness or ulcers in the mouth

name: ENZYL 160 Tablet 7's
introduction:
Introduction About ENZYL 160 TABLET

ENZYL 160 TABLET contains Enzalutamide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Androgen receptor inhibitors. It is used to manage adult men with prostate cancer who no longer respond to hormone therapy or surgical management or if the cancer, despite responding to management, has spread to other parts of the body.

Prostate cancer occurs in the prostate gland (a gland in males that produces the seminal fluid to transport sperm). Symptoms include problems while urinating (difficulty, decreased force, or blood in the urine), blood in the semen, bone pain, erectile dysfunction, and weight loss.

Enzalutamide acts by blocking the activity of hormones called androgens (such as testosterone). By blocking androgens, it stops the growth of prostate cancer cells and can further induce cancer cell death and tumour regression.

Before taking ENZYL 160 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, or heart conditions like arrhythmia (heart rhythm problem). ENZYL 160 TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ENZYL 160 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking ENZYL 160 TABLET are tiredness, broken bones, hot flushes, high blood pressure, headaches, feeling anxious, dry skin, itching, difficulty remembering, and breast enlargement in men. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

Take ENZYL 160 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow it with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: Clokeran 2mg Tablet 30'S
introduction:
Introduction About CLOKERAN 2MG TABLET

CLOKERAN 2MG TABLET contains Chlorambucil which belongs to a group of medicines called Antineoplastics. It is used for Hodgkin's disease and Non-Hodgkin’s Lymphoma (cancer of the lymphatic system), Chronic lymphocytic leukaemia (a type of white blood cell cancer where the bone marrow produces a large number of abnormal white cells). CLOKERAN 2MG TABLET is also used for Waldenstrom's macroglobulinaemia (a rare lymphoma associated with an abnormal increase of B-cells, a type of white blood cell, resulting in the release of an abnormal protein into the blood).

CLOKERAN 2MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver, kidney disease and fits. CLOKERAN 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CLOKERAN 2MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking CLOKERAN 2MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, mouth ulcers (sores), fits in children with a kidney problem known as nephrotic syndrome. Contact your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About CABOTRES 20 TABLET

CABOTRES 20 TABLET contains Cabozantinib, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer drugs. It is used in adults to manage advanced kidney cancer. It can also be used in the management of liver cancer and advanced thyroid cancer when management with other conventional cancer medicines (such as sorafenib) and radiotherapy is not responding appropriately.

Take CABOTRES 20 TABLET on an empty stomach. You should not eat anything for at least 2 hours before and for 1 hour after taking the medicine. Before taking CABOTRES 20 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems.

You must also inform your doctor if you have high blood pressure, thyroid problems, inflammatory bowel diseases, abnormal bulging or tears in blood vessels, a recent history of blood clot formation, a stroke, or a heart attack, as a precaution.

During management with CABOTRES 20 TABLET, it is important for you to practice good oral hygiene. You must also inform your dentist about this medicine if you need to visit the dentist regularly.

Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking CABOTRES 20 TABLET, as it may increase the risk of side effects. CABOTRES 20 TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women.

Men and women taking CABOTRES 20 TABLET must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with CABOTRES 20 TABLET. Men may also seek advice on sperm preservation, if necessary, prior to therapy with this medicine.

The most common side effects of taking CABOTRES 20 TABLET are nausea, vomiting, stomach upset, skin rashes, blisters, and pain in the hands or soles of the feet, weight loss, altered taste sensation, tiredness, weakness, sore mouth, throat, and tongue, fistulas, and piles. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CABOTRES 20 TABLET

It is used by adults to manage:

Advanced kidney cancer
Liver cancer
Advanced thyroid cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How CABOTRES 20 TABLET Works

CABOTRES 20 TABLET is an anti-cancer medicine. It works by blocking the actions of certain proteins (such as receptor tyrosine kinases) in the body that trigger cancer formation. As a result, it manages abnormal cell division within the body and slows down the growth of cancer cells in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use CABOTRES 20 TABLET

Take CABOTRES 20 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. CABOTRES 20 TABLET should not be taken with food. You should not eat anything for at least 2 hours before and for 1 hour after taking the medicine.

Try to take CABOTRES 20 TABLET at the same time each day. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight, and health condition. Do not stop taking CABOTRES 20 TABLET unless advised by your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About CYPHOS 500MG INJECTION

CYPHOS 500MG INJECTION contains Cyclophosphamide, which belongs to a group of medicines called Cytotoxic agents or Anti-cancer agents. It is indicated for malignant diseases in adults and children (such as malignant lymphomas, Hodgkin’s disease, Non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma, lymphocytic lymphoma mixed-cell type lymphoma, histiocytic lymphoma, Burkitt’s lymphoma, multiple myeloma, chronic lymphocytic leukemia, chronic granulocytic leukemia, acute myelogenous and monocytic leukemia, acute lymphoblastic leukemia, mycosis fungoides, neuroblastoma, adenocarcinoma of the ovary, retinoblastoma, Ewing’s sarcoma, breast cancer. It is also used for minimal change nephrotic syndrome in children.

CYPHOS 500MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with acute infections, bone-marrow aplasia, urinary tract infections like cystitis, acute urothelial toxicity from cytotoxic chemotherapy or radiation therapy, urinary outflow obstruction, or unmanageed infections. Before receiving CYPHOS 500MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you are allergic or have anaphylactic reactions, bone marrow suppression, neutropenic fever, serious infections, severe immune suppression, concomitant chemotherapy and/or radiation therapy, urinary tract and renal diseases, heart diseases, pneumonitis, pulmonary fibrosis, pulmonary veno-occlusive disease, respiratory failure, pneumonitis and secondary malignancies, veno-occlusive liver disease, SIADH (syndrome of inappropriate secretion of antidiuretic hormone), rare hereditary problems of fructose intolerance, galactose intolerance, glucose-galactose malabsorption, Lapp lactase deficiency, sucrase-isomaltase insufficiency, adrenal insufficiency, diabetes and poor general health.

CYPHOS 500MG INJECTION is not recommended for use by pregnant women. It is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. CYPHOS 500MG INJECTION should be used with caution in children and adolescents. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of receiving CYPHOS 500MG INJECTION are nausea, vomiting, weight loss, alopecia, hematuria and leukopenia. Contact your doctor if any of your symptoms gets worse or persists for a long duration.

How CYPHOS 500MG INJECTION Works

CYPHOS 500MG INJECTION works by interfering with the malignant cell growth by cross-linking of cancer cells DNA. Therefore it works against the growth and multiplication of cancer cells.

introduction:
Introduction About DOCETERE 20MG INJECTION

DOCETERE 20MG INJECTION contains Docetaxel which belongs to the group of medicines called Taxoids. DOCETERE 20MG INJECTION is used in the management of breast cancer, special forms of lung cancer (non-small cell lung cancer), prostate cancer, gastric (stomach) cancer and/or head and neck cancer in affected individuals.        

DOCETERE 20MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to docetaxel. It is not recommended for use in patients with low number of white blood cells and in patients suffering from severe liver disease.   

Before receiving DOCETERE 20MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are alcohol dependent, and/or suffering from epilepsy, heart and/or kidney disease.

DOCETERE 20MG INJECTION is not recommended for use during pregnancy unless it is clearly necessary. Women of child-bearing potential should use effective contraception method to avoid getting pregnant while receiving DOCETERE 20MG INJECTION. The medicine is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.  

DOCETERE 20MG INJECTION should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) which is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.  

The most common side effects of receiving DOCETERE 20MG INJECTION are infection, hair loss, headache, loss of appetite, indigestion, nausea, vomiting, and/or constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

How DOCETERE 20MG INJECTION Works

DOCETERE 20MG INJECTION works by interfering with the microtubule structures in the cell (substance which aids cancer cells to divide and multiply) thus inhibiting the growth of cancer cells and stopping its spread in affected individuals.

introduction:
Introduction About NUPHOS 500MG INJECTION

NUPHOS 500MG INJECTION contains Cyclophosphamide, which belongs to a group of medicines called Cytotoxic agents or Anti-cancer agents. It is indicated for malignant diseases in adults and children (such as malignant lymphomas, Hodgkin’s disease, Non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma, lymphocytic lymphoma mixed-cell type lymphoma, histiocytic lymphoma, Burkitt’s lymphoma, multiple myeloma, chronic lymphocytic leukemia, chronic granulocytic leukemia, acute myelogenous and monocytic leukemia, acute lymphoblastic leukemia, mycosis fungoides, neuroblastoma, adenocarcinoma of the ovary, retinoblastoma, Ewing’s sarcoma, breast cancer. It is also used for minimal change nephrotic syndrome in children.

NUPHOS 500MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with acute infections, bone-marrow aplasia, urinary tract infections like cystitis, acute urothelial toxicity from cytotoxic chemotherapy or radiation therapy, urinary outflow obstruction, or unmanageed infections. Before receiving NUPHOS 500MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you are allergic or have anaphylactic reactions, bone marrow suppression, neutropenic fever, serious infections, severe immune suppression, concomitant chemotherapy and/or radiation therapy, urinary tract and renal diseases, heart diseases, pneumonitis, pulmonary fibrosis, pulmonary veno-occlusive disease, respiratory failure, pneumonitis and secondary malignancies, veno-occlusive liver disease, SIADH (syndrome of inappropriate secretion of antidiuretic hormone), rare hereditary problems of fructose intolerance, galactose intolerance, glucose-galactose malabsorption, Lapp lactase deficiency, sucrase-isomaltase insufficiency, adrenal insufficiency, diabetes and poor general health.

NUPHOS 500MG INJECTION is not recommended for use by pregnant women. It is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. NUPHOS 500MG INJECTION should be used with caution in children and adolescents. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of receiving NUPHOS 500MG INJECTION are nausea, vomiting, weight loss, alopecia, hematuria and leukopenia. Contact your doctor if any of your symptoms gets worse or persists for a long duration.

mechanismOfAction:
How NUPHOS 500MG INJECTION Works

NUPHOS 500MG INJECTION works by interfering with the malignant cell growth by cross-linking of cancer cells DNA. NUPHOS 500MG INJECTION also transfers alkyl groups to DNA during the process of cell division, thus managing the normal synthesis of DNA. Therefore it works against the growth and multiplication of cancer cells.

introduction:
Introduction About TEMODAL 100MG CAPSULE

TEMODAL 100MG CAPSULE contains Temozolomide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antineoplastic agents. It is used for specific forms of brain tumours in adults with newly diagnosed glioblastoma multiforme, which is used first together with radiotherapy as a concomitant phase of therapy and then used alone as a monotherapy. It is also used in children (above 3 years) and adults to manage malignant gliomas, such as glioblastoma multiforme or anaplastic astrocytoma, if they return or get worse after standard management.

Glioblastoma multiforme is an aggressive type of cancer that affects the brain or spinal cord and is generally characterized by symptoms such as headache, nausea, drowsiness, blurred vision, personality changes, and seizures.

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to take liver function tests to assess the hepatotoxicity and function of your liver. Before taking TEMODAL 100MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had a hepatitis B infection (serious liver infection).

TEMODAL 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have certain kinds of blood cells that are severely reduced, such as white blood cells and platelet count. TEMODAL 100MG CAPSULE should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary and not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. It is not recommended for use in children below 3 years of age and should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from 3 to 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking TEMODAL 100MG CAPSULE. The most common side effects of taking TEMODAL 100MG CAPSULE are loss of appetite, difficulty while speaking, headache, vomiting, nausea, diarrhea, and constipation. Consult and inform your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How TEMODAL 100MG CAPSULE Works

TEMODAL 100MG CAPSULE works by damaging the genetic material (DNA and RNA) of the cancer cells inside the brain cells and works against the cell growth and multiplication.

introduction:
Introduction About CAPIIBINE 500MG TABLET

CAPIIBINE 500MG TABLET contains capecitabine, which belongs to the group of medicines called antineoplastic agents. It is used in the management of abnormal growth of cells present in the colon, rectal, gastric, and breast regions. It may be used either alone or in combination with other medicines.

CAPIIBINE 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe liver or kidney disease. CAPIIBINE 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease, kidney disease, heart problems, brain disease or nerve damage, diabetes, or a history of eye problems. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

CAPIIBINE 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

CAPIIBINE 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use by children and adolescents. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

The most common side effects of taking CAPIIBINE 500MG TABLET are abdominal pain, rash, dry or itchy skin, tiredness, and loss of appetite. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of CAPIIBINE 500MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body surface area, and disease condition. Do not stop taking CAPIIBINE 500MG TABLET unless your doctor has told you to.

introduction:
Introduction About ABIONE 250MG TABLET

ABIONE 250MG TABLET contains Abiraterone, which belongs to a group of medicines called Androgen biosynthesis inhibitors. ABIONE 250MG TABLET is used with prednisone or prednisolone in adult men to manage prostate cancer that has spread to other parts of the body.

ABIONE 250MG TABLET is also used to manage early stages of prostate cancer when used with androgen deprivation therapy (management that lowers testosterone hormone) and prednisone/prednisolone (medication) in affected individuals. ABIONE 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to abiraterone. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from severe liver disease.

Before taking ABIONE 250MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have high blood pressure, any other blood vessel problems (such as blood pressure, stroke), swelling in the feet, ankles, or legs, diabetes, lung problems (such as shortness of breath), heart problems (such as heart failure, irregular or rapid heart rate), kidney, and/or liver problems.

ABIONE 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women since it is intended to be used only in male patients.While taking ABIONE 250MG TABLET, male patients must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid exposure of this medicine to their female partners.

ABIONE 250MG TABLET is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 75 years or older) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking ABIONE 250MG TABLET are swelling in the legs or feet, high blood pressure, urinary tract infection, diarrhea, indigestion, chest pain, an irregular heartbeat, and/or a rash. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: To manage prostate cancer that has spread to other parts of the body
To manage early stages of prostate cancer when used with androgen deprivation therapy (management that lowers testosterone hormone) in affected individuals
usesDetails:
Uses Of ABIONE 250MG TABLET

ABIONE 250MG TABLET is used with prednisone/prednisolone:

To manage prostate cancer that has spread to other parts of the body
To manage early stages of prostate cancer when used with androgen deprivation therapy (management that lowers testosterone hormone) in affected individuals
mechanismOfAction:
How ABIONE 250MG TABLET Works

ABIONE 250MG TABLET is an androgen biosynthesis inhibitor that works by inhibiting the production of the 17α-hydroxylase (CYP17) enzyme needed to produce testosterone (male sex hormone), which enables the growth of cancer cells in the prostate gland. Since ABIONE 250MG TABLET suppresses the production of testosterone, the cancer cells in the prostate gland won't be able to grow, thus managing its effects on the gland in affected individuals.

How to use ABIONE 250MG TABLET

Take ABIONE 250MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Avoid taking medicine with food. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NUDOXA 20MG INJECTION

NUDOXA 20MG INJECTION contains Doxorubicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used to manage certain types of cancers. It is used either alone or along with other anti-cancer medicines.

Cancer is a disease in which some of the cells of the body grow uncontrollably and spread to other parts of the body.

Before receiving NUDOXA 20MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had heart disease, either before or during radiotherapy, had or having live or live-attenuated vaccinations, are currently taking or have recently taken Trastuzumab (used in the management of certain cancers).

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Consult your doctor during breast-feeding before starting management with this medicine as it may pass through the breast milk and possibly harm your child. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

The most common side effects of NUDOXA 20MG INJECTION are infection, lack of appetite, inflammation in the mouth, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, reddening, swelling, pain, numbness and tingling in the palms and feet may also occur whilst being managed with this medicine.

Hair loss is very common and may be quite severe, beard growth may stop in men, fever, feeling weak, chills, abnormal ECG (electrical trace of the heart) results, raised levels of liver enzymes (as detected by a blood test) can determine if the medicine is having an abnormal effect on your liver, weight increased in patients with early breast cancer.
uses: Used to manage certain types of cancer
usesDetails:
Uses Of NUDOXA 20MG INJECTION
Used to manage certain types of cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How NUDOXA 20MG INJECTION Works

NUDOXA 20MG INJECTION works by suppressing the activity of an enzyme (topoisomerase II) involved in the DNA multiplication of the cancer cells. On the other hand, this also forms harmful chemicals (free radicals) which cause damage to the DNA. This slowdown the growth of cancer cells and eventually works against them.

How to use NUDOXA 20MG INJECTION

NUDOXA 20MG INJECTION will be administered intravenously (IV) into the vein by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CLOKERAN 5MG TABLET

CLOKERAN 5MG TABLET contains Chlorambucil which belongs to a group of medicines called Antineoplastics. It is used for Hodgkin's disease and Non-Hodgkin’s Lymphoma (cancer of the lymphatic system), Chronic lymphocytic leukaemia (a type of white blood cell cancer where the bone marrow produces a large number of abnormal white cells). CLOKERAN 5MG TABLET is also used for Waldenstrom's macroglobulinaemia (a rare lymphoma associated with an abnormal increase of B-cells, a type of white blood cell, resulting in the release of an abnormal protein into the blood).

CLOKERAN 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver, kidney disease and fits. CLOKERAN 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CLOKERAN 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking CLOKERAN 5MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, mouth ulcers (sores), fits in children with a kidney problem known as nephrotic syndrome. Contact your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About XELODA 500MG TABLET

XELODA 500MG TABLET contains capecitabine, which belongs to the group of medicines called antineoplastic agents. It is used in the management of abnormal growth of cells present in the colon, rectal, gastric, and breast regions. It may be used either alone or in combination with other medicines.

XELODA 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe liver or kidney disease. XELODA 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease, kidney disease, heart problems, brain disease or nerve damage, diabetes, or a history of eye problems. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

XELODA 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

XELODA 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use by children and adolescents. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

The most common side effects of taking XELODA 500MG TABLET are abdominal pain, rash, dry or itchy skin, tiredness, and loss of appetite. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

How to use XELODA 500MG TABLET

Take XELODA 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Take the medicine within 30 minutes after the end of a meal.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of XELODA 500MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body surface area, and disease condition. Do not stop taking XELODA 500MG TABLET unless your doctor has told you to.

name: DASLEMIA 100 Tablet 30's
introduction:
Introduction About DASLEMIA 100 TABLET

DASLEMIA 100 TABLET contains Dasatinib which belongs to the group of medicines called Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors. It is used to manage cancers of blood and bone marrow (such as chronic myeloid leukaemia (CML) and philadelphia chromosome positive (Ph+) acute lymphoblastic leukaemia) in adults, adolescents and in children (aged 1 year or above).

It is primarily used in patients when management with conventional therapies is not suitable or fails to provide adequate response.   

Leukaemia is the cancer of white blood cells. It is caused due to abnormal growth and multiplication of blood cells within the bone marrow. It is characterized by severe tiredness, breathlessness, increased bleeding tendency, tiredness, anemia, night sweats, fever, chills, frequent infections and weight loss.

During management with DASLEMIA 100 TABLET your doctor will closely monitor your health condition through several blood tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking DASLEMIA 100 TABLET as it may increase the risk of side effects.

Before taking DASLEMIA 100 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have or at risk of developing hepatitis C infection as a precaution.

Avoid concomitant use of antacids or any stomach medicines along with DASLEMIA 100 TABLET. Leave a time gap of at least 2 hours between the medicines. DASLEMIA 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women.

Men and women taking DASLEMIA 100 TABLET must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with DASLEMIA 100 TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking DASLEMIA 100 TABLET are increased bleeding tendency, increased infections, feeling tired or weak, nausea, vomiting, hair loss, mouth ulcers, changes in taste, inflammation of the food pipe or stomach, muscle pain or spasm, skin rashes, headache, dizziness and weight loss. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Cancers of blood and bone marrow (such as chronic myeloid leukaemia and philadelphia chromosome positive (Ph+) acute lymphoblastic leukaemia)
usesDetails:
Uses Of DASLEMIA 100 TABLET

It is used in adults, adolescents and in children (aged 1 year or above) to manage:

Cancers of blood and bone marrow (such as chronic myeloid leukaemia and philadelphia chromosome positive (Ph+) acute lymphoblastic leukaemia)
mechanismOfAction:
How DASLEMIA 100 TABLET Works

DASLEMIA 100 TABLET is an anti-cancer medicine. It works by blocking the actions of certain proteins (such as BCR-ABL, Src kinase, etc.) in the body that triggers cancer formation. As a result, it reduces abnormal growth and multiplication of cancer cells in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use DASLEMIA 100 TABLET

Take DASLEMIA 100 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without meals. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About TEMOREL 250MG CAPSULE

TEMOREL 250MG CAPSULE contains Temozolomide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antineoplastic agents. It is used for specific forms of brain tumours in adults with newly diagnosed glioblastoma multiforme, which is used first together with radiotherapy as a concomitant phase of therapy and then used alone as a monotherapy. It is also used in children (above 3 years) and adults to manage malignant gliomas, such as glioblastoma multiforme or anaplastic astrocytoma, if they return or get worse after standard management.

Glioblastoma multiforme is an aggressive type of cancer that affects the brain or spinal cord and is generally characterized by symptoms such as headache, nausea, drowsiness, blurred vision, personality changes, and seizures.

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to take liver function tests to assess the hepatotoxicity and function of your liver. Before taking TEMOREL 250MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had a hepatitis B infection (serious liver infection).

TEMOREL 250MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have certain kinds of blood cells that are severely reduced, such as white blood cells and platelet count. TEMOREL 250MG CAPSULE should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary and not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. It is not recommended for use in children below 3 years of age and should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from 3 to 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking TEMOREL 250MG CAPSULE. The most common side effects of taking TEMOREL 250MG CAPSULE are loss of appetite, difficulty while speaking, headache, vomiting, nausea, diarrhea, and constipation. Consult and inform your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.

name: Lenome 10mg Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About LENOME 10MG CAPSULE

LENOME 10MG CAPSULE contains Lenalidomide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Immunomodulatory agents. It is used in the management of multiple myeloma, myelodysplastic syndromes, mantle cell lymphoma and follicular lymphoma. Cancer is a disease in which abnormal cells divide uncontrollably in the body and destroy body tissue.

Multiple myeloma is a type of cancer that affects a type of white blood cell (plasma cell) that collects in the bone marrow and divides uncontrollably, leading to kidney and bone damage. Myelodysplastic syndromes are a group of disorders that occur due to the abnormal functioning of blood cells.

Mantle cell lymphoma is a cancer of the lymph tissue where the B-cells or B lymphocytes (white blood cells) grow in an uncontrolled manner and build up in the lymph tissue, blood or bone marrow. Follicular lymphoma is slow-growing cancer that affects B lymphocytes that help fight infection.

Before taking LENOME 10MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have ever had blood clots, hepatitis B infection, varicella-zoster, HIV, kidney problems or a heart attack. LENOME 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use among pregnant or breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking LENOME 10MG CAPSULE are rashes, itching, muscle cramps, muscle weakness, muscle pain, muscle aches, bone pain, joint pain, back pain, pain in the extremities, weakness, tiredness, constipation, diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain and heartburn. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LENOME 10MG CAPSULE

It is used to manage:

Multiple myeloma
Myelodysplastic syndromes
Mantle cell lymphoma
Follicular lymphoma
mechanismOfAction:
How LENOME 10MG CAPSULE Works

LENOME 10MG CAPSULE works by enhancing the immune system that indirectly attacks the cancer cells. It stops the growth of new blood vessels within the tumour. It also limits the production of chemical messengers (cytokine and growth factor) which are responsible for the growth of cancer cells.

introduction:
Introduction About DOXULIP 20MG INJECTION

DOXULIP 20MG INJECTION contains Doxorubicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used to manage certain types of cancers. It is used either alone or along with other anti-cancer medicines.

Cancer is a disease in which some of the cells of the body grow uncontrollably and spread to other parts of the body.

Before receiving DOXULIP 20MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had heart disease, either before or during radiotherapy, had or having live or live-attenuated vaccinations, are currently taking or have recently taken Trastuzumab (used in the management of certain cancers).

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Consult your doctor during breast-feeding before starting management with this medicine as it may pass through the breast milk and possibly harm your child. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

The most common side effects of DOXULIP 20MG INJECTION are infection, lack of appetite, inflammation in the mouth, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, reddening, swelling, pain, numbness and tingling in the palms and feet may also occur whilst being managed with this medicine.

Hair loss is very common and may be quite severe, beard growth may stop in men, fever, feeling weak, chills, abnormal ECG (electrical trace of the heart) results, raised levels of liver enzymes (as detected by a blood test) can determine if the medicine is having an abnormal effect on your liver, weight increased in patients with early breast cancer.
uses: Used to manage certain types of cancer
usesDetails:
Uses Of DOXULIP 20MG INJECTION
Used to manage certain types of cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How DOXULIP 20MG INJECTION Works

DOXULIP 20MG INJECTION works by suppressing the activity of an enzyme (topoisomerase II) involved in the DNA multiplication of the cancer cells. On the other hand, this also forms harmful chemicals (free radicals) which cause damage to the DNA. This slowdown the growth of cancer cells and eventually works against them.
usageDetails:
How to use DOXULIP 20MG INJECTION

DOXULIP 20MG INJECTION will be administered intravenously (IV) into the vein by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Caxeta 500 mg Tablet 4'S
introduction:
Introduction About CAXETA 500 MG TABLET

CAXETA 500 MG TABLET contains capecitabine, which belongs to the group of medicines called antineoplastic agents. It is used in the management of abnormal growth of cells present in the colon, rectal, gastric, and breast regions. It may be used either alone or in combination with other medicines.

CAXETA 500 MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe liver or kidney disease. CAXETA 500 MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease, kidney disease, heart problems, brain disease or nerve damage, diabetes, or a history of eye problems. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

CAXETA 500 MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

CAXETA 500 MG TABLET is not recommended for use by children and adolescents. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

The most common side effects of taking CAXETA 500 MG TABLET are abdominal pain, rash, dry or itchy skin, tiredness, and loss of appetite. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: It inhibits the abnormal growth of cells present in the colon, rectal, gastric, and breast regions.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CAXETA 500 MG TABLET
It inhibits the abnormal growth of cells present in the colon, rectal, gastric, and breast regions.
mechanismOfAction:
How CAXETA 500 MG TABLET Works

CAXETA 500 MG TABLET is an antimetabolite that works by stopping the abnormal growth of cells. Thus, it helps manage the conditions associated with it.
usageDetails:
How to use CAXETA 500 MG TABLET

Take CAXETA 500 MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Take the medicine within 30 minutes after the end of a meal.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of CAXETA 500 MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body surface area, and disease condition. Do not stop taking CAXETA 500 MG TABLET unless your doctor has told you to.

If you are a male patient and your female partner could become pregnant, you should use effective contraception during management with CAXETA 500 MG TABLET and for 3 months after the last dose. Consult your doctor before taking CAXETA 500 MG TABLET.

Breastfeeding
CONTRAINDICATED

CAXETA 500 MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women, and do not breastfeed for 2 weeks after the last dose of CAXETA 500 MG TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Driving and Using Machines
CONTRAINDICATED

Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy, nauseous, or tired after taking CAXETA 500 MG TABLET.

Kidney
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

CAXETA 500 MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CAXETA 500 MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking CAXETA 500 MG TABLET.

Liver
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

CAXETA 500 MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CAXETA 500 MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Allergy
CONTRAINDICATED

Do not take CAXETA 500 MG TABLET if you are allergic to Capecitabine or any of the other ingredients in this medicine.

Heart Disease
USE WITH CAUTION

CAXETA 500 MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart problems (Ex. an irregular heartbeat or chest pain radiating to the jaw and back brought on by physical effort and due to problems with the blood flow to the heart). Consult your doctor before taking CAXETA 500 MG TABLET.

Use In Pediatrics
CONTRAINDICATED

CAXETA 500 MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. Consult your doctor before taking CAXETA 500 MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About DOXULIP 50MG INJECTION

DOXULIP 50MG INJECTION contains Doxorubicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used to manage certain types of cancers. It is used either alone or along with other anti-cancer medicines.

Cancer is a disease in which some of the cells of the body grow uncontrollably and spread to other parts of the body.

Before receiving DOXULIP 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had heart disease, either before or during radiotherapy, had or having live or live-attenuated vaccinations, are currently taking or have recently taken Trastuzumab (used in the management of certain cancers).

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Consult your doctor during breast-feeding before starting management with this medicine as it may pass through the breast milk and possibly harm your child. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

The most common side effects of DOXULIP 50MG INJECTION are infection, lack of appetite, inflammation in the mouth, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, reddening, swelling, pain, numbness and tingling in the palms and feet may also occur whilst being managed with this medicine.

Hair loss is very common and may be quite severe, beard growth may stop in men, fever, feeling weak, chills, abnormal ECG (electrical trace of the heart) results, raised levels of liver enzymes (as detected by a blood test) can determine if the medicine is having an abnormal effect on your liver, weight increased in patients with early breast cancer.
uses: Used to manage certain types of cancer
usesDetails:
Uses Of DOXULIP 50MG INJECTION
Used to manage certain types of cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How DOXULIP 50MG INJECTION Works

DOXULIP 50MG INJECTION works by suppressing the activity of an enzyme (topoisomerase II) involved in the DNA multiplication of the cancer cells. On the other hand, this also forms harmful chemicals (free radicals) which cause damage to the DNA. This slowdown the growth of cancer cells and eventually works against them.
usageDetails:
How to use DOXULIP 50MG INJECTION

DOXULIP 50MG INJECTION will be administered intravenously (IV) into the vein by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Lenalid 5mg Capsule 30'S
introduction:
Introduction About LENALID 5MG CAPSULE

LENALID 5MG CAPSULE contains Lenalidomide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Immunomodulatory agents. It is used in the management of multiple myeloma, myelodysplastic syndromes, mantle cell lymphoma and follicular lymphoma. Cancer is a disease in which abnormal cells divide uncontrollably in the body and destroy body tissue.

Multiple myeloma is a type of cancer that affects a type of white blood cell (plasma cell) that collects in the bone marrow and divides uncontrollably, leading to kidney and bone damage. Myelodysplastic syndromes are a group of disorders that occur due to the abnormal functioning of blood cells.

Mantle cell lymphoma is a cancer of the lymph tissue where the B-cells or B lymphocytes (white blood cells) grow in an uncontrolled manner and build up in the lymph tissue, blood or bone marrow. Follicular lymphoma is slow-growing cancer that affects B lymphocytes that help fight infection.

Before taking LENALID 5MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have ever had blood clots, hepatitis B infection, varicella-zoster, HIV, kidney problems or a heart attack. LENALID 5MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use among pregnant or breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking LENALID 5MG CAPSULE are rashes, itching, muscle cramps, muscle weakness, muscle pain, muscle aches, bone pain, joint pain, back pain, pain in the extremities, weakness, tiredness, constipation, diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain and heartburn. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LENALID 5MG CAPSULE

It is used to manage:

Multiple myeloma
Myelodysplastic syndromes
Mantle cell lymphoma
Follicular lymphoma
mechanismOfAction:
How LENALID 5MG CAPSULE Works

LENALID 5MG CAPSULE works by enhancing the immune system that indirectly attacks the cancer cells. It stops the growth of new blood vessels within the tumour. It also limits the production of chemical messengers (cytokine and growth factor) which are responsible for the growth of cancer cells.
usageDetails:
How to use LENALID 5MG CAPSULE

Take LENALID 5MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TEMOREL 100MG CAPSULE

TEMOREL 100MG CAPSULE contains Temozolomide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antineoplastic agents. It is used for specific forms of brain tumours in adults with newly diagnosed glioblastoma multiforme, which is used first together with radiotherapy as a concomitant phase of therapy and then used alone as a monotherapy. It is also used in children (above 3 years) and adults to manage malignant gliomas, such as glioblastoma multiforme or anaplastic astrocytoma, if they return or get worse after standard management.

Glioblastoma multiforme is an aggressive type of cancer that affects the brain or spinal cord and is generally characterized by symptoms such as headache, nausea, drowsiness, blurred vision, personality changes, and seizures.

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to take liver function tests to assess the hepatotoxicity and function of your liver. Before taking TEMOREL 100MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had a hepatitis B infection (serious liver infection).

TEMOREL 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have certain kinds of blood cells that are severely reduced, such as white blood cells and platelet count. TEMOREL 100MG CAPSULE should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary and not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. It is not recommended for use in children below 3 years of age and should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from 3 to 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking TEMOREL 100MG CAPSULE. The most common side effects of taking TEMOREL 100MG CAPSULE are loss of appetite, difficulty while speaking, headache, vomiting, nausea, diarrhea, and constipation. Consult and inform your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.

introduction:
Introduction About CELKERAN 5MG TABLET

CELKERAN 5MG TABLET contains Chlorambucil which belongs to a group of medicines called Antineoplastics. It is used for Hodgkin's disease and Non-Hodgkin’s Lymphoma (cancer of the lymphatic system), Chronic lymphocytic leukaemia (a type of white blood cell cancer where the bone marrow produces a large number of abnormal white cells). CELKERAN 5MG TABLET is also used for Waldenstrom's macroglobulinaemia (a rare lymphoma associated with an abnormal increase of B-cells, a type of white blood cell, resulting in the release of an abnormal protein into the blood).

CELKERAN 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver, kidney disease and fits. CELKERAN 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CELKERAN 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking CELKERAN 5MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, mouth ulcers (sores), fits in children with a kidney problem known as nephrotic syndrome. Contact your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.

name: ZYBIRAA 500 Tablet 60's
introduction:
Introduction About ZYBIRAA 500 TABLET

ZYBIRAA 500 TABLET contains Abiraterone, which belongs to a group of medicines called Androgen biosynthesis inhibitors. ZYBIRAA 500 TABLET is used with prednisone or prednisolone in adult men to manage prostate cancer that has spread to other parts of the body.

ZYBIRAA 500 TABLET is also used to manage early stages of prostate cancer when used with androgen deprivation therapy (management that lowers testosterone hormone) and prednisone/prednisolone (medication) in affected individuals. ZYBIRAA 500 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to abiraterone. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from severe liver disease.

Before taking ZYBIRAA 500 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have high blood pressure, any other blood vessel problems (such as blood pressure, stroke), swelling in the feet, ankles, or legs, diabetes, lung problems (such as shortness of breath), heart problems (such as heart failure, irregular or rapid heart rate), kidney, and/or liver problems.

ZYBIRAA 500 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women since it is intended to be used only in male patients.While taking ZYBIRAA 500 TABLET, male patients must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid exposure of this medicine to their female partners.

ZYBIRAA 500 TABLET is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 75 years or older) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking ZYBIRAA 500 TABLET are swelling in the legs or feet, high blood pressure, urinary tract infection, diarrhea, indigestion, chest pain, an irregular heartbeat, and/or a rash. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

usesDetails:

ZYBIRAA 500 TABLET is used with prednisone/prednisolone:

To manage prostate cancer that has spread to other parts of the body
To manage early stages of prostate cancer when used with androgen deprivation therapy (management that lowers testosterone hormone) in affected individuals
mechanismOfAction:
How ZYBIRAA 500 TABLET Works

ZYBIRAA 500 TABLET is an androgen biosynthesis inhibitor that works by inhibiting the production of the 17α-hydroxylase (CYP17) enzyme needed to produce testosterone (male sex hormone), which enables the growth of cancer cells in the prostate gland. Since ZYBIRAA 500 TABLET suppresses the production of testosterone, the cancer cells in the prostate gland won't be able to grow, thus managing its effects on the gland in affected individuals.

Take ZYBIRAA 500 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Avoid taking medicine with food. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: ENZAMIDE 80 Capsule 14's
introduction:
Introduction About ENZAMIDE 80 CAPSULE

ENZAMIDE 80 CAPSULE contains Enzalutamide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Androgen receptor inhibitors. It is used to manage adult men with prostate cancer who no longer respond to hormone therapy or surgical management or if the cancer, despite responding to management, has spread to other parts of the body.

Prostate cancer occurs in the prostate gland (a gland in males that produces the seminal fluid to transport sperm). Symptoms include problems while urinating (difficulty, decreased force, or blood in the urine), blood in the semen, bone pain, erectile dysfunction, and weight loss.

Enzalutamide acts by blocking the activity of hormones called androgens (such as testosterone). By blocking androgens, it stops the growth of prostate cancer cells and can further induce cancer cell death and tumour regression.

Before taking ENZAMIDE 80 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, or heart conditions like arrhythmia (heart rhythm problem). ENZAMIDE 80 CAPSULE is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ENZAMIDE 80 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking ENZAMIDE 80 CAPSULE are tiredness, broken bones, hot flushes, high blood pressure, headaches, feeling anxious, dry skin, itching, difficulty remembering, and breast enlargement in men. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

TEMOTERO 250MG CAPSULE contains Temozolomide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antineoplastic agents. It is used for specific forms of brain tumours in adults with newly diagnosed glioblastoma multiforme, which is used first together with radiotherapy as a concomitant phase of therapy and then used alone as a monotherapy. It is also used in children (above 3 years) and adults to manage malignant gliomas, such as glioblastoma multiforme or anaplastic astrocytoma, if they return or get worse after standard management.

Glioblastoma multiforme is an aggressive type of cancer that affects the brain or spinal cord and is generally characterized by symptoms such as headache, nausea, drowsiness, blurred vision, personality changes, and seizures.

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to take liver function tests to assess the hepatotoxicity and function of your liver. Before taking TEMOTERO 250MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had a hepatitis B infection (serious liver infection).

TEMOTERO 250MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have certain kinds of blood cells that are severely reduced, such as white blood cells and platelet count. TEMOTERO 250MG CAPSULE should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary and not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. It is not recommended for use in children below 3 years of age and should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from 3 to 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking TEMOTERO 250MG CAPSULE. The most common side effects of taking TEMOTERO 250MG CAPSULE are loss of appetite, difficulty while speaking, headache, vomiting, nausea, diarrhea, and constipation. Consult and inform your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.

introduction:
Introduction About ENDOXAN N 200MG INJECTION

ENDOXAN N 200MG INJECTION contains Cyclophosphamide, which belongs to a group of medicines called Cytotoxic agents or Anti-cancer agents. It is indicated for malignant diseases in adults and children (such as malignant lymphomas, Hodgkin’s disease, Non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma, lymphocytic lymphoma mixed-cell type lymphoma, histiocytic lymphoma, Burkitt’s lymphoma, multiple myeloma, chronic lymphocytic leukemia, chronic granulocytic leukemia, acute myelogenous and monocytic leukemia, acute lymphoblastic leukemia, mycosis fungoides, neuroblastoma, adenocarcinoma of the ovary, retinoblastoma, Ewing’s sarcoma, breast cancer. It is also used for minimal change nephrotic syndrome in children.

ENDOXAN N 200MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with acute infections, bone-marrow aplasia, urinary tract infections like cystitis, acute urothelial toxicity from cytotoxic chemotherapy or radiation therapy, urinary outflow obstruction, or unmanageed infections. Before receiving ENDOXAN N 200MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you are allergic or have anaphylactic reactions, bone marrow suppression, neutropenic fever, serious infections, severe immune suppression, concomitant chemotherapy and/or radiation therapy, urinary tract and renal diseases, heart diseases, pneumonitis, pulmonary fibrosis, pulmonary veno-occlusive disease, respiratory failure, pneumonitis and secondary malignancies, veno-occlusive liver disease, SIADH (syndrome of inappropriate secretion of antidiuretic hormone), rare hereditary problems of fructose intolerance, galactose intolerance, glucose-galactose malabsorption, Lapp lactase deficiency, sucrase-isomaltase insufficiency, adrenal insufficiency, diabetes and poor general health.

ENDOXAN N 200MG INJECTION is not recommended for use by pregnant women. It is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. ENDOXAN N 200MG INJECTION should be used with caution in children and adolescents. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of receiving ENDOXAN N 200MG INJECTION are nausea, vomiting, weight loss, alopecia, hematuria and leukopenia. Contact your doctor if any of your symptoms gets worse or persists for a long duration.

mechanismOfAction:
How ENDOXAN N 200MG INJECTION Works

ENDOXAN N 200MG INJECTION works by interfering with the malignant cell growth by cross-linking of cancer cells DNA. ENDOXAN N 200MG INJECTION also transfers alkyl groups to DNA during the process of cell division, thus managing the normal synthesis of DNA. Therefore it works against the growth and multiplication of cancer cells.

ENDOXAN N 200MG INJECTION will be administered only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous injection or infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: ABIRATRED 500mg Tablet 60's
introduction:
Introduction About ABIRATRED 500MG TABLET

ABIRATRED 500MG TABLET contains Abiraterone, which belongs to a group of medicines called Androgen biosynthesis inhibitors. ABIRATRED 500MG TABLET is used with prednisone or prednisolone in adult men to manage prostate cancer that has spread to other parts of the body.

ABIRATRED 500MG TABLET is also used to manage early stages of prostate cancer when used with androgen deprivation therapy (management that lowers testosterone hormone) and prednisone/prednisolone (medication) in affected individuals. ABIRATRED 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to abiraterone. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from severe liver disease.

Before taking ABIRATRED 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have high blood pressure, any other blood vessel problems (such as blood pressure, stroke), swelling in the feet, ankles, or legs, diabetes, lung problems (such as shortness of breath), heart problems (such as heart failure, irregular or rapid heart rate), kidney, and/or liver problems.

ABIRATRED 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women since it is intended to be used only in male patients.While taking ABIRATRED 500MG TABLET, male patients must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid exposure of this medicine to their female partners.

ABIRATRED 500MG TABLET is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 75 years or older) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking ABIRATRED 500MG TABLET are swelling in the legs or feet, high blood pressure, urinary tract infection, diarrhea, indigestion, chest pain, an irregular heartbeat, and/or a rash. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: To manage prostate cancer that has spread to other parts of the body
To manage early stages of prostate cancer when used with androgen deprivation therapy (management that lowers testosterone hormone) in affected individuals
usesDetails:
Uses Of ABIRATRED 500MG TABLET

ABIRATRED 500MG TABLET is used with prednisone/prednisolone:

To manage prostate cancer that has spread to other parts of the body
To manage early stages of prostate cancer when used with androgen deprivation therapy (management that lowers testosterone hormone) in affected individuals
mechanismOfAction:
How ABIRATRED 500MG TABLET Works

ABIRATRED 500MG TABLET is an androgen biosynthesis inhibitor that works by inhibiting the production of the 17α-hydroxylase (CYP17) enzyme needed to produce testosterone (male sex hormone), which enables the growth of cancer cells in the prostate gland. Since ABIRATRED 500MG TABLET suppresses the production of testosterone, the cancer cells in the prostate gland won't be able to grow, thus managing its effects on the gland in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use ABIRATRED 500MG TABLET

introduction:
Introduction About CELKERAN 2MG TABLET

CELKERAN 2MG TABLET contains Chlorambucil which belongs to a group of medicines called Antineoplastics. It is used for Hodgkin's disease and Non-Hodgkin’s Lymphoma (cancer of the lymphatic system), Chronic lymphocytic leukaemia (a type of white blood cell cancer where the bone marrow produces a large number of abnormal white cells). CELKERAN 2MG TABLET is also used for Waldenstrom's macroglobulinaemia (a rare lymphoma associated with an abnormal increase of B-cells, a type of white blood cell, resulting in the release of an abnormal protein into the blood).

CELKERAN 2MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver, kidney disease and fits. CELKERAN 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CELKERAN 2MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking CELKERAN 2MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, mouth ulcers (sores), fits in children with a kidney problem known as nephrotic syndrome. Contact your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.

name: Doceaqualip 20mg Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About DOCEAQUALIP 20MG INJECTION

DOCEAQUALIP 20MG INJECTION contains Docetaxel which belongs to the group of medicines called Taxoids. DOCEAQUALIP 20MG INJECTION is used in the management of breast cancer, special forms of lung cancer (non-small cell lung cancer), prostate cancer, gastric (stomach) cancer and/or head and neck cancer in affected individuals.        

DOCEAQUALIP 20MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to docetaxel. It is not recommended for use in patients with low number of white blood cells and in patients suffering from severe liver disease.   

Before receiving DOCEAQUALIP 20MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are alcohol dependent, and/or suffering from epilepsy, heart and/or kidney disease.

DOCEAQUALIP 20MG INJECTION is not recommended for use during pregnancy unless it is clearly necessary. Women of child-bearing potential should use effective contraception method to avoid getting pregnant while receiving DOCEAQUALIP 20MG INJECTION. The medicine is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.  

DOCEAQUALIP 20MG INJECTION should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) which is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.  

The most common side effects of receiving DOCEAQUALIP 20MG INJECTION are infection, hair loss, headache, loss of appetite, indigestion, nausea, vomiting, and/or constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

How DOCEAQUALIP 20MG INJECTION Works

DOCEAQUALIP 20MG INJECTION works by interfering with the microtubule structures in the cell (substance which aids cancer cells to divide and multiply) thus inhibiting the growth of cancer cells and stopping its spread in affected individuals.

introduction:
Introduction About ENDOXAN N 500MG INJECTION

ENDOXAN N 500MG INJECTION contains Cyclophosphamide, which belongs to a group of medicines called Cytotoxic agents or Anti-cancer agents. It is indicated for malignant diseases in adults and children (such as malignant lymphomas, Hodgkin’s disease, Non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma, lymphocytic lymphoma mixed-cell type lymphoma, histiocytic lymphoma, Burkitt’s lymphoma, multiple myeloma, chronic lymphocytic leukemia, chronic granulocytic leukemia, acute myelogenous and monocytic leukemia, acute lymphoblastic leukemia, mycosis fungoides, neuroblastoma, adenocarcinoma of the ovary, retinoblastoma, Ewing’s sarcoma, breast cancer. It is also used for minimal change nephrotic syndrome in children.

ENDOXAN N 500MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with acute infections, bone-marrow aplasia, urinary tract infections like cystitis, acute urothelial toxicity from cytotoxic chemotherapy or radiation therapy, urinary outflow obstruction, or unmanageed infections. Before receiving ENDOXAN N 500MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you are allergic or have anaphylactic reactions, bone marrow suppression, neutropenic fever, serious infections, severe immune suppression, concomitant chemotherapy and/or radiation therapy, urinary tract and renal diseases, heart diseases, pneumonitis, pulmonary fibrosis, pulmonary veno-occlusive disease, respiratory failure, pneumonitis and secondary malignancies, veno-occlusive liver disease, SIADH (syndrome of inappropriate secretion of antidiuretic hormone), rare hereditary problems of fructose intolerance, galactose intolerance, glucose-galactose malabsorption, Lapp lactase deficiency, sucrase-isomaltase insufficiency, adrenal insufficiency, diabetes and poor general health.

ENDOXAN N 500MG INJECTION is not recommended for use by pregnant women. It is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. ENDOXAN N 500MG INJECTION should be used with caution in children and adolescents. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of receiving ENDOXAN N 500MG INJECTION are nausea, vomiting, weight loss, alopecia, hematuria and leukopenia. Contact your doctor if any of your symptoms gets worse or persists for a long duration.

mechanismOfAction:
How ENDOXAN N 500MG INJECTION Works

ENDOXAN N 500MG INJECTION works by interfering with the malignant cell growth by cross-linking of cancer cells DNA. ENDOXAN N 500MG INJECTION also transfers alkyl groups to DNA during the process of cell division, thus managing the normal synthesis of DNA. Therefore it works against the growth and multiplication of cancer cells.

introduction:
Introduction About I DOX 20MG INJECTION

I DOX 20MG INJECTION contains Doxorubicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used to manage certain types of cancers. It is used either alone or along with other anti-cancer medicines.

Cancer is a disease in which some of the cells of the body grow uncontrollably and spread to other parts of the body.

Before receiving I DOX 20MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had heart disease, either before or during radiotherapy, had or having live or live-attenuated vaccinations, are currently taking or have recently taken Trastuzumab (used in the management of certain cancers).

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Consult your doctor during breast-feeding before starting management with this medicine as it may pass through the breast milk and possibly harm your child. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

The most common side effects of I DOX 20MG INJECTION are infection, lack of appetite, inflammation in the mouth, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, reddening, swelling, pain, numbness and tingling in the palms and feet may also occur whilst being managed with this medicine.

Hair loss is very common and may be quite severe, beard growth may stop in men, fever, feeling weak, chills, abnormal ECG (electrical trace of the heart) results, raised levels of liver enzymes (as detected by a blood test) can determine if the medicine is having an abnormal effect on your liver, weight increased in patients with early breast cancer.
uses: Used to manage certain types of cancer
usesDetails:
Uses Of I DOX 20MG INJECTION
Used to manage certain types of cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How I DOX 20MG INJECTION Works

I DOX 20MG INJECTION works by suppressing the activity of an enzyme (topoisomerase II) involved in the DNA multiplication of the cancer cells. On the other hand, this also forms harmful chemicals (free radicals) which cause damage to the DNA. This slowdown the growth of cancer cells and eventually works against them.
usageDetails:
How to use I DOX 20MG INJECTION

I DOX 20MG INJECTION will be administered intravenously (IV) into the vein by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About INLYTA 1MG TABLET

INLYTA 1MG TABLET contains Axitinib which belongs to the group of medicines called Kinase inhibitors. It manages advanced kidney tumour in adults, when another medicine (called sunitinib or a cytokine) is no longer stopping disease from progressing.

INLYTA 1MG TABLET works by reducing the blood supply to the cancer cells and slows down the growth of cancer. Avoid consumption of grapefruit during treatment with INLYTA 1MG TABLET.

Before taking INLYTA 1MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have high blood pressure, have had a recent problem with blood clots in your veins and arteries including stroke, heart attack, embolism, or thrombosis, thyroid gland problems, bleeding problems, aneurysm, liver problem or have an operation or an unhealed wound.

INLYTA 1MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (aged below 18 years) unless advised by the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking INLYTA 1MG TABLETare diarrhoea, nausea or vomiting, stomach ache, indigestion, soreness of the mouth, tongue or throat, and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

faqs.question: Q: What is INLYTA 1MG TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: INLYTA 1MG TABLET is a targeted therapy drug used primarily to manage advanced renal cell carcinoma (RCC), a type of kidney cancer. It works by inhibiting the growth of blood vessels that supply cancers, thereby slowing down the growth and spread of cancer cells.

faqs.question: Q: How does INLYTA 1MG TABLET work?
faqs.answer: A: INLYTA 1MG TABLET is a tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI). It targets and inhibits specific enzymes (kinases) involved in the formation of new blood vessels (angiogenesis) that cancer cells need to grow. By blocking these enzymes, it helps to starve the cancer cells for nutrients and slows its progression.

faqs.question: Q: How is INLYTA 1MG TABLET administered?
faqs.answer: A: INLYTA 1MG TABLET is usually taken orally in the form of tablets. The dosage and schedule will be determined by your healthcare provider based on your specific condition and response to treatment. It is typically taken twice daily.

faqs.question: Q: What are the common side effects of INLYTA 1MG TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: The most common side effects of taking INLYTA 1MG TABLETare diarrhoea, nausea or vomiting, stomach ache, indigestion, soreness of the mouth, tongue or throat, and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

faqs.question: Q: What are the serious side effects?
faqs.answer: A: Serious side effects may include severe high blood pressure, heart problems, liver problems. bleeding issues and gastrointestinal perforation.

faqs.question: Q: How should INLYTA 1MG TABLET be taken?
faqs.answer: A: Take INLYTA 1MG TABLETas advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

faqs.question: Q: What should I do if I miss a dose?
faqs.answer: A: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember unless it’s almost time for your next dose. Do not double up on doses to make up for a missed one. Contact your healthcare provider for specific instructions.

faqs.question: Q: Are there any interactions with other medications?
faqs.answer: A: INLYTA 1MG TABLET can interact with other medications, including certain antibiotics, antifungals, and medications used for high blood pressure. Inform your healthcare provider about all the medications, supplements, and herbs you are taking.

faqs.question: Q: Who should not take INLYTA 1MG TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: INLYTA 1MG TABLET should not be taken by individuals who are allergic to it or any of its ingredients. Additionally, it may not be suitable for people with certain health conditions, so discuss your medical history with your healthcare provider.

faqs.question: Q: What should I do in case of an emergency?
faqs.answer: A: Seek immediate medical help if you experience severe side effects or symptoms such as chest pain, severe headache, vision changes, or signs of bleeding, seek immediate medical attention.

introduction:
Introduction About LEUKERAN 2MG TABLET

LEUKERAN 2MG TABLET contains Chlorambucil which belongs to a group of medicines called Antineoplastics. It is used for Hodgkin's disease and Non-Hodgkin’s Lymphoma (cancer of the lymphatic system), Chronic lymphocytic leukaemia (a type of white blood cell cancer where the bone marrow produces a large number of abnormal white cells). LEUKERAN 2MG TABLET is also used for Waldenstrom's macroglobulinaemia (a rare lymphoma associated with an abnormal increase of B-cells, a type of white blood cell, resulting in the release of an abnormal protein into the blood).

LEUKERAN 2MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver, kidney disease and fits. LEUKERAN 2MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it.

LEUKERAN 2MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking LEUKERAN 2MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, mouth ulcers (sores), fits in children with a kidney problem known as nephrotic syndrome. Contact your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.

name: SUTIB 50 Capsule 7's
introduction:
Introduction About SUTIB 50 CAPSULE

SUTIB 50 CAPSULE contains Sunitinib which belongs to the group of medicines called Protein Kinase Inhibitors. It is used in the management of gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST) (a type of cancer of the stomach and bowel) where another anticancer medicine (imatinib) no longer works or you cannot take it and metastatic renal cell carcinoma (MRCC) (type of kidney cancer that has spread to other parts of the body).

SUTIB 50 CAPSULE is also used to manage pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (pNET) (tumors of the hormone-producing cells in the pancreas) that have progressed or cannot be removed with surgery. Your doctor might ask you to take blood tests, check your blood pressure and take your ECG during management with SUTIB 50 CAPSULE and as clinically indicated.

Before taking SUTIB 50 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have heart, kidney, liver, blood, thyroid or pancreatic problems, seizures and diabetes or if you recently had or are going to undergo any surgery.

Ask your doctor before taking SUTIB 50 CAPSULE during pregnancy. You should not breastfeed while taking SUTIB 50 CAPSULE so, consult your doctor before taking it. It is not known if SUTIB 50 CAPSULE is safe and effective in children and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking SUTIB 50 CAPSULE are rashes, itching, muscle cramps, bone pain weakness, tiredness, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, etc. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen or persists.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SUTIB 50 CAPSULE

SUTIB 50 CAPSULE manages:

Gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST)
Metastatic renal cell carcinoma (MRCC)
Pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (pNET)
mechanismOfAction:
How SUTIB 50 CAPSULE Works

SUTIB 50 CAPSULE helps control cancer advancement by inhibiting the activity of a special group of proteins which are found to be involved in the growth and spread of cancer cells.

Take SUTIB 50 CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow with enough water. Do not crush or chew it. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of SUTIB 50 CAPSULE management depending on your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking SUTIB 50 CAPSULE unless your doctor advises you to stop.

Painful skin ulceration
Inflammation of the liver or thyroid gland

Stop taking SUTIB 50 CAPSULE and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Heart problems like heart failure and heart muscle problems (feeling very tired or breathless, swollen feet and ankles)
Lung or breathing problems like pulmonary embolism (cough, chest pain, sudden onset of breathlessness, coughing up blood)
Kidney disorders like kidney failure (altered frequency or absence of urination)
Bleeding problems (painful, swollen stomach, vomiting blood, black, sticky stools, bloody urine, headache, change in the mental status, coughing up blood or bloody sputum from the lungs or airway)
Tumor destruction leading to a hole in the intestine (severe abdominal pain, fever, nausea, vomiting, blood in your stool, change in bowel habits)
Blood clot in blood vessels (chest pain or pressure, pain in your arms, back, neck or jaw, breathlessness, numbness or weakness on one side of your body, trouble talking, headache or dizziness)
Getting tired more easily, feeling colder than other people, voice deepening
Skin conditions like pyoderma gangrenosum or necrotizing fasciitis (fever, pain, redness, swelling, drainage of pus or blood)
Toxic epidermal necrolysis, erythema multiforme, Stevens-Johnson syndrome (reddish target-like spots or circular patches often with central blisters on the trunk, rash that may progress to widespread blistering or peeling of the skin)

Severe liver problems (itching, yellow eyes or skin, dark urine, pain or discomfort in the right upper stomach area)
