introduction:
Introduction About I DOX 50MG INJECTION

I DOX 50MG INJECTION contains Doxorubicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used to manage certain types of cancers. It is used either alone or along with other anti-cancer medicines.

Cancer is a disease in which some of the cells of the body grow uncontrollably and spread to other parts of the body.

Before receiving I DOX 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had heart disease, either before or during radiotherapy, had or having live or live-attenuated vaccinations, are currently taking or have recently taken Trastuzumab (used in the management of certain cancers).

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Consult your doctor during breast-feeding before starting management with this medicine as it may pass through the breast milk and possibly harm your child. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

The most common side effects of I DOX 50MG INJECTION are infection, lack of appetite, inflammation in the mouth, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, reddening, swelling, pain, numbness and tingling in the palms and feet may also occur whilst being managed with this medicine.

Hair loss is very common and may be quite severe, beard growth may stop in men, fever, feeling weak, chills, abnormal ECG (electrical trace of the heart) results, raised levels of liver enzymes (as detected by a blood test) can determine if the medicine is having an abnormal effect on your liver, weight increased in patients with early breast cancer.
uses: Used to manage certain types of cancer
usesDetails:
Uses Of I DOX 50MG INJECTION
Used to manage certain types of cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How I DOX 50MG INJECTION Works

I DOX 50MG INJECTION works by suppressing the activity of an enzyme (topoisomerase II) involved in the DNA multiplication of the cancer cells. On the other hand, this also forms harmful chemicals (free radicals) which cause damage to the DNA. This slowdown the growth of cancer cells and eventually works against them.
usageDetails:
How to use I DOX 50MG INJECTION

I DOX 50MG INJECTION will be administered intravenously (IV) into the vein by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: ROMY Injection 0.5ml
introduction:
Introduction About ROMY INJECTION

ROMY INJECTION is used for chronic immune thrombocytopenic purpura (ITP) patients one year of age and older who have had an insufficient response to corticosteroids, immunoglobulins or splenectomy. It contains Romiplostim which belongs to the group of medicines called Thrombopoietin receptor agonists which works by stimulating the bone marrow (part of the bone which makes blood cells) to produce more platelets. This should help to manage bruising and bleeding associated with ITP.

ROMY INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with thromboembolism including but not limited to inherited or acquired risk factors, advanced age, prolonged periods of immobilization, malignancies, have any clinical conditions associated with thrombocytopenia or have any renal impairment. ROMY INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women and patients having severe to moderate liver impairment.

The safety and efficacy of ROMY INJECTION in children under the age of one year has not been established. The most common side effects of receiving ROMY INJECTION are fatigue, oedema peripheral, influenza like illness, pain, chills, injection site reaction. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen or persist for a long time.
uses: It is used for chronic immune thrombocytopenic purpura (ITP) patients one year of age and older who have had an insufficient response to corticosteroids, immunoglobulins or splenectomy
usesDetails:
Uses Of ROMY INJECTION
It is used for chronic immune thrombocytopenic purpura (ITP) patients one year of age and older who have had an insufficient response to corticosteroids, immunoglobulins or splenectomy
mechanismOfAction:
How ROMY INJECTION Works

ROMY INJECTION contains Romiplostim, an Fc-peptide fusion protein (peptibody) that signals and activates intracellular transcriptional pathways via the TPO receptor to increase platelet production. The peptibody molecule is comprised of a human immunoglobulin IgG1 Fc domain, with each single-chain subunit covalently linked at the C-terminus to a peptide chain containing 2 TPO receptor-binding domains. It has no amino acid sequence homology to endogenous TPO.
usageDetails:
How to use ROMY INJECTION

ROMY INJECTION will be administered subcutaneously by your doctor or nurse. Self-administration of ROMY INJECTION is not allowed for pediatric patients.

warnings.details: ROMY INJECTION is not recommended during pregnancy and in women of childbearing potential not using contraception.

It is unknown whether ROMY INJECTION is excreted in human milk. A risk to the newborns/infants cannot be excluded. A decision must be made whether to discontinue breast-feeding or to discontinue/abstain from romiplostim therapy taking into account the benefit of breast feeding for the child and the benefit of therapy for the woman.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience dizziness after receiving ROMY INJECTION.
ROMY INJECTION should be used with caution if you have renal impairment. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

ROMY INJECTION should not be used in patients with moderate to severe hepatic impairment, unless the expected benefit outweighs the identified risk of portal venous thrombosis in patients with thrombocytopenia associated to hepatic insufficiency treated with thrombopoietin (TPO) agonists. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.
Do not receive ROMY INJECTION if you are allergic to Romiplostim or any other ingredients of this medicine.
The safety and efficacy of ROMY INJECTION in children under the age of one year has not been established.
There is no difference between safety or efficacy that have been observed in patients above 65 years of age. Dose adjustment is not required for older patients

Have prolonged periods of immobilization
Have malignancies
Have undergone any surgery/trauma
Have any clinical conditions associated with thrombocytopenia
Are obesity
Are smoking

faqs.answer: A: ROMY INJECTION is a shot (injection) given by your doctor or nurse once a week. It has no dietary restrictions and no known drug interactions. This means you do not have to change your meal schedule or other medicines.

faqs.question: Q: How will I receive ROMY INJECTION?
faqs.answer: A: ROMY INJECTION is given as an injection under the skin (subcutaneous) one time each week by your healthcare provider. Your healthcare provider will check your platelet count every week and change your dose of the medicine as needed.

faqs.question: Q: Is there information on long-term safety for ROMY INJECTION?
faqs.answer: A: The long-term safety data for ROMY INJECTION that side effects did not increase in frequency with longer drug exposure. The study looked at some patients from previous studies.

faqs.question: Q: Is ROMY INJECTION suitable for thrombocytopenia occuring due to Myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS)?
faqs.answer: A: It is not approved to manage thrombocytopenia caused by Myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS) or any other cause of thrombocytopenia apart from chronic ITP.

introduction:
Introduction About ENZUTA CAPSULE

ENZUTA CAPSULE contains Enzalutamide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Androgen receptor inhibitors. It is used to manage adult men with prostate cancer who no longer respond to hormone therapy or surgical management or if the cancer, despite responding to management, has spread to other parts of the body.

Prostate cancer occurs in the prostate gland (a gland in males that produces the seminal fluid to transport sperm). Symptoms include problems while urinating (difficulty, decreased force, or blood in the urine), blood in the semen, bone pain, erectile dysfunction, and weight loss.

Enzalutamide acts by blocking the activity of hormones called androgens (such as testosterone). By blocking androgens, it stops the growth of prostate cancer cells and can further induce cancer cell death and tumour regression.

Before taking ENZUTA CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, or heart conditions like arrhythmia (heart rhythm problem). ENZUTA CAPSULE is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. ENZUTA CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking ENZUTA CAPSULE are tiredness, broken bones, hot flushes, high blood pressure, headaches, feeling anxious, dry skin, itching, difficulty remembering, and breast enlargement in men. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About TEGAFI 100/224MG CAPSULE

TEGAFI 100/224MG CAPSULE is a combination of Tegafur and Uracil which belongs to the group of medicines called Thymidylate synthase inhibitors. It is used with calcium folinate to manage metastatic colorectal cancer which is a type of cancer that begins in the colon or rectum and spreads to other parts of the body and characterized by symptoms such as rectal bleeding, narrow stools, persistent abdominal pain and unexplained weight loss.

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you for a liver function test to assess the function of your liver. TEGAFI 100/224MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe hepatic impairment, bone marrow suppression from previous radiotherapy or dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase deficiency disease (a severe neurological disease marked by seizures).   

Before taking TEGAFI 100/224MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have heart, kidney or liver disease. TEGAFI 100/224MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women and it is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years).  

This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 75 years or above) with age-related impaired kidney, liver or heart function and other concomitant medications or diseases.

The most common side effects of taking TEGAFI 100/224MG CAPSULE are nausea, diarrhea, constipation, stomach pain, headache, dizziness and dry skin. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects get worse.
uses: Manage metastatic colorectal cancer (in combination with calcium folinate)

How TEGAFI 100/224MG CAPSULE Works

TEGAFI 100/224MG CAPSULE helps in managing the spread of colorectal cancer cells, where tegafur works by converting into fluorouracil or 5-FU in the liver which causes destruction of cancer cells and uracil works by managing the degradation of 5-FU which results in the prolongation of its stay in the cancer cells thus resulting in the destruction of colorectal cancer cells and managing its spread to other parts of the body.

introduction:
Introduction About NUDOXA 50MG INJECTION

NUDOXA 50MG INJECTION contains Doxorubicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used to manage certain types of cancers. It is used either alone or along with other anti-cancer medicines.

Cancer is a disease in which some of the cells of the body grow uncontrollably and spread to other parts of the body.

Before receiving NUDOXA 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had heart disease, either before or during radiotherapy, had or having live or live-attenuated vaccinations, are currently taking or have recently taken Trastuzumab (used in the management of certain cancers).

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Consult your doctor during breast-feeding before starting management with this medicine as it may pass through the breast milk and possibly harm your child. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

The most common side effects of NUDOXA 50MG INJECTION are infection, lack of appetite, inflammation in the mouth, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, reddening, swelling, pain, numbness and tingling in the palms and feet may also occur whilst being managed with this medicine.

Hair loss is very common and may be quite severe, beard growth may stop in men, fever, feeling weak, chills, abnormal ECG (electrical trace of the heart) results, raised levels of liver enzymes (as detected by a blood test) can determine if the medicine is having an abnormal effect on your liver, weight increased in patients with early breast cancer.
uses: Used to manage certain types of cancer
usesDetails:
Uses Of NUDOXA 50MG INJECTION
Used to manage certain types of cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How NUDOXA 50MG INJECTION Works

NUDOXA 50MG INJECTION works by suppressing the activity of an enzyme (topoisomerase II) involved in the DNA multiplication of the cancer cells. On the other hand, this also forms harmful chemicals (free radicals) which cause damage to the DNA. This slowdown the growth of cancer cells and eventually works against them.
usageDetails:
How to use NUDOXA 50MG INJECTION

NUDOXA 50MG INJECTION will be administered intravenously (IV) into the vein by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ABIRAPRO 500MG TABLET

ABIRAPRO 500MG TABLET contains Abiraterone, which belongs to a group of medicines called Androgen biosynthesis inhibitors. ABIRAPRO 500MG TABLET is used with prednisone or prednisolone in adult men to manage prostate cancer that has spread to other parts of the body.

ABIRAPRO 500MG TABLET is also used to manage early stages of prostate cancer when used with androgen deprivation therapy (management that lowers testosterone hormone) and prednisone/prednisolone (medication) in affected individuals. ABIRAPRO 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to abiraterone. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from severe liver disease.

Before taking ABIRAPRO 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have high blood pressure, any other blood vessel problems (such as blood pressure, stroke), swelling in the feet, ankles, or legs, diabetes, lung problems (such as shortness of breath), heart problems (such as heart failure, irregular or rapid heart rate), kidney, and/or liver problems.

ABIRAPRO 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women since it is intended to be used only in male patients.While taking ABIRAPRO 500MG TABLET, male patients must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid exposure of this medicine to their female partners.

ABIRAPRO 500MG TABLET is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 75 years or older) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking ABIRAPRO 500MG TABLET are swelling in the legs or feet, high blood pressure, urinary tract infection, diarrhea, indigestion, chest pain, an irregular heartbeat, and/or a rash. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: To manage prostate cancer that has spread to other parts of the body
To manage early stages of prostate cancer when used with androgen deprivation therapy (management that lowers testosterone hormone) in affected individuals
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How ABIRAPRO 500MG TABLET Works

ABIRAPRO 500MG TABLET is an androgen biosynthesis inhibitor that works by inhibiting the production of the 17α-hydroxylase (CYP17) enzyme needed to produce testosterone (male sex hormone), which enables the growth of cancer cells in the prostate gland. Since ABIRAPRO 500MG TABLET suppresses the production of testosterone, the cancer cells in the prostate gland won't be able to grow, thus managing its effects on the gland in affected individuals.

Take ABIRAPRO 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Avoid taking medicine with food. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Introduction About ZODOX 50MG INJECTION

ZODOX 50MG INJECTION contains Doxorubicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used to manage certain types of cancers. It is used either alone or along with other anti-cancer medicines.

Cancer is a disease in which some of the cells of the body grow uncontrollably and spread to other parts of the body.

Before receiving ZODOX 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had heart disease, either before or during radiotherapy, had or having live or live-attenuated vaccinations, are currently taking or have recently taken Trastuzumab (used in the management of certain cancers).

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Consult your doctor during breast-feeding before starting management with this medicine as it may pass through the breast milk and possibly harm your child. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

The most common side effects of ZODOX 50MG INJECTION are infection, lack of appetite, inflammation in the mouth, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, reddening, swelling, pain, numbness and tingling in the palms and feet may also occur whilst being managed with this medicine.

Hair loss is very common and may be quite severe, beard growth may stop in men, fever, feeling weak, chills, abnormal ECG (electrical trace of the heart) results, raised levels of liver enzymes (as detected by a blood test) can determine if the medicine is having an abnormal effect on your liver, weight increased in patients with early breast cancer.
uses: Used to manage certain types of cancer

mechanismOfAction:
How ZODOX 50MG INJECTION Works

ZODOX 50MG INJECTION works by suppressing the activity of an enzyme (topoisomerase II) involved in the DNA multiplication of the cancer cells. On the other hand, this also forms harmful chemicals (free radicals) which cause damage to the DNA. This slowdown the growth of cancer cells and eventually works against them.

name: Olimab Prefilled Syringe 1'S
introduction:
Introduction About OLIMAB PREFILLED SYRINGE

OLIMAB PREFILLED SYRINGE contains Denosumab which belongs to the group of medicines called Monoclonal antibodies. It is used in adults to manage advanced cancer and to manage serious complications caused by bone metastasis (Ex. fractures, pressure on the spinal cord, radiation therapy, or surgery). It is also used to manage giant cell tumours of the bone, which cannot be managed by surgery, especially in adults whose bones have stopped growing. Symptoms include a visible mass and bone joints being affected (fracture, fluid buildup, limited movement, swelling, and pain in the joints).

Denosumab binds to RANKL, a protein that is essential for the formation, function, and survival of osteoclasts (the cells responsible for bone resorption). It inhibits osteoclast formation, function, and survival, thereby decreasing bone resorption and increasing bone mass and strength. Along with this management, your doctor might ask you to make certain lifestyle changes, such as maintaining good oral hygiene and quitting smoking. Your doctor may ask you to undergo a dental examination before you start the management. OLIMAB PREFILLED SYRINGE is not recommended for use in patients with hypocalcemia (low calcium levels in the blood) and unhealed wounds from oral surgery. Before receiving OLIMAB PREFILLED SYRINGE, inform your doctor if you have any problems with your mouth or teeth (poor dental health, gum disease, etc.).

OLIMAB PREFILLED SYRINGE is not recommended among women who are pregnant. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving OLIMAB PREFILLED SYRINGE if you are breast-feeding. OLIMAB PREFILLED SYRINGE is not recommended for children and adolescents under 18 years of age, except for adolescents with giant cell tumours of the bone whose bones have stopped growing. The most common side effects of receiving OLIMAB PREFILLED SYRINGE are pain in the bones, joints, and muscles, shortness of breath, diarrhea, hypophosphatemia (low phosphate level), and excessive sweating.

introduction:
Introduction About CELDAZ 500MG INJECTION

CELDAZ 500MG INJECTION contains Dacarbazine which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer Agents. It is used to manage certain types of skin cancer (such as metastatic melanoma) and lymph cancer (such as Hodgkin’s disease). It can also be used in the management of soft tissue sarcoma (cancer of connective tissues).

Before receiving CELDAZ 500MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have low WBC and platelet counts in blood or currently receiving radiotherapy as a precaution. Avoid consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with this medicine.

CELDAZ 500MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. Both men and women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with this medicine and until 6 months after the last dose.

The common side effects associated with the use of CELDAZ 500MG INJECTION are nausea, vomiting, flu-like symptoms, nerve damage and low RBC, WBC and platelet counts causing tiredness, pale skin, increased infections, fever, sore throat, chills and increased bleeding or bruising. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects troubles you.
uses: Soft tissue sarcoma (cancer of connective tissues passing between muscles, fat, blood vessels and supporting tissues)
usesDetails:
Uses Of CELDAZ 500MG INJECTION

It is used in the management of:

Skin cancer (metastatic melanoma)

mechanismOfAction:
How CELDAZ 500MG INJECTION Works

CELDAZ 500MG INJECTION is an anticancer medication. It works by damaging the cellular genetic material (DNA). This interferes with the functions of DNA and stops cancer cells from multiplying. Therefore, it stops the multiplication of abnormal cell division within the body and decreases cancer progression.
usageDetails:
How to use CELDAZ 500MG INJECTION

CELDAZ 500MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor specialized in oncology or haematology into the vein (intravenously).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with CELDAZ 500MG INJECTION and until 6 months after stopping the therapy. CELDAZ 500MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Therefore, inform your doctor before receiving it.

CELDAZ 500MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney diseases. It should be used with caution in patients with mild or moderate kidney problems. Therefore, inform your doctor before receiving it.

CELDAZ 500MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver diseases. It should be used with caution in patients with mild or moderate liver problems. Therefore, inform your doctor before receiving it.
Talk to your doctor before receiving CELDAZ 500MG INJECTION if you are allergic to dacarbazine.
CELDAZ 500MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety data. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.
CELDAZ 500MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.

Others

CELDAZ 500MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have leukopenia (low count of white blood cells)
Have thrombocytopenia (low blood platelet count)
Are scheduled for a live vaccine immunization

Are currently undergoing radiation therapy

introduction:
Introduction About PEGADRIA 20MG INJECTION

PEGADRIA 20MG INJECTION contains Doxorubicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used to manage certain types of cancers. It is used either alone or along with other anti-cancer medicines.

Cancer is a disease in which some of the cells of the body grow uncontrollably and spread to other parts of the body.

Before receiving PEGADRIA 20MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had heart disease, either before or during radiotherapy, had or having live or live-attenuated vaccinations, are currently taking or have recently taken Trastuzumab (used in the management of certain cancers).

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Consult your doctor during breast-feeding before starting management with this medicine as it may pass through the breast milk and possibly harm your child. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

The most common side effects of PEGADRIA 20MG INJECTION are infection, lack of appetite, inflammation in the mouth, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, reddening, swelling, pain, numbness and tingling in the palms and feet may also occur whilst being managed with this medicine.

Hair loss is very common and may be quite severe, beard growth may stop in men, fever, feeling weak, chills, abnormal ECG (electrical trace of the heart) results, raised levels of liver enzymes (as detected by a blood test) can determine if the medicine is having an abnormal effect on your liver, weight increased in patients with early breast cancer.
uses: Used to manage certain types of cancer
usesDetails:
Uses Of PEGADRIA 20MG INJECTION
Used to manage certain types of cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How PEGADRIA 20MG INJECTION Works

PEGADRIA 20MG INJECTION works by suppressing the activity of an enzyme (topoisomerase II) involved in the DNA multiplication of the cancer cells. On the other hand, this also forms harmful chemicals (free radicals) which cause damage to the DNA. This slowdown the growth of cancer cells and eventually works against them.
usageDetails:
How to use PEGADRIA 20MG INJECTION

PEGADRIA 20MG INJECTION will be administered intravenously (IV) into the vein by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Pemetero 500mg Injection 1'S
introduction:
Introduction About PEMETERO 500MG INJECTION

PEMETERO 500MG INJECTION contains Pemetrexed which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer agents. It is used to manage advanced stages of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). It can be used as a management option to control cancer progression in patients who have failed to respond adequately to conventional therapies.

PEMETERO 500MG INJECTION is also used to manage malignant cancer of pleural membrane (a protective layer surrounding the lungs), called as pleural mesothelioma. It is mostly used in combination with other anti-cancer medicines (such as cisplatin, carboplatin) to achieve better results.

Before receiving PEMETERO 500MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems or a previous history of the same. You must also inform your doctor if you have fluid accumulation in the lungs or recently received or planning to receive any radiation therapy or vaccination in the upcoming days as a precaution.

PEMETERO 500MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years. Men and women receiving PEMETERO 500MG INJECTION must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with PEMETERO 500MG INJECTION and for until 6 months after stopping the therapy.

The most common side effects of receiving PEMETERO 500MG INJECTION are increased infections, sore throat, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, dizziness, tiredness, weight loss, changes in taste, skin rash, hair loss and mouth ulcers. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC)
Manage malignant pleural mesothelioma (cancer of the protective layer of the lungs)
usesDetails:

Manage malignant pleural mesothelioma (cancer of the protective layer of the lungs)
mechanismOfAction:
How PEMETERO 500MG INJECTION Works

PEMETERO 500MG INJECTION is an anticancer medication. It works by blocking the activity of certain enzymes (Ex. dihydrofolate reductase, thymidylate synthase etc.) in the body that may help cancer cells to grow and multiply. As a result, it reduces abnormal growth and multiplication of cancer cells in the body.

How to use PEMETERO 500MG INJECTION

PEMETERO 500MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein (as an intravenous infusion).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CAELYX 20MG INJECTION

CAELYX 20MG INJECTION contains Doxorubicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used to manage certain types of cancers. It is used either alone or along with other anti-cancer medicines.

Cancer is a disease in which some of the cells of the body grow uncontrollably and spread to other parts of the body.

Before receiving CAELYX 20MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had heart disease, either before or during radiotherapy, had or having live or live-attenuated vaccinations, are currently taking or have recently taken Trastuzumab (used in the management of certain cancers).

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Consult your doctor during breast-feeding before starting management with this medicine as it may pass through the breast milk and possibly harm your child. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

The most common side effects of CAELYX 20MG INJECTION are infection, lack of appetite, inflammation in the mouth, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, reddening, swelling, pain, numbness and tingling in the palms and feet may also occur whilst being managed with this medicine.

Hair loss is very common and may be quite severe, beard growth may stop in men, fever, feeling weak, chills, abnormal ECG (electrical trace of the heart) results, raised levels of liver enzymes (as detected by a blood test) can determine if the medicine is having an abnormal effect on your liver, weight increased in patients with early breast cancer.
uses: Used to manage certain types of cancer
usesDetails:
Uses Of CAELYX 20MG INJECTION
Used to manage certain types of cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How CAELYX 20MG INJECTION Works

CAELYX 20MG INJECTION works by suppressing the activity of an enzyme (topoisomerase II) involved in the DNA multiplication of the cancer cells. On the other hand, this also forms harmful chemicals (free radicals) which cause damage to the DNA. This slowdown the growth of cancer cells and eventually works against them.

How to use CAELYX 20MG INJECTION

CAELYX 20MG INJECTION will be administered intravenously (IV) into the vein by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Lenalid 25mg Capsule 30'S
introduction:
Introduction About LENALID 25MG CAPSULE

LENALID 25MG CAPSULE contains Lenalidomide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Immunomodulatory agents. It is used in the management of multiple myeloma, myelodysplastic syndromes, mantle cell lymphoma and follicular lymphoma. Cancer is a disease in which abnormal cells divide uncontrollably in the body and destroy body tissue.

Multiple myeloma is a type of cancer that affects a type of white blood cell (plasma cell) that collects in the bone marrow and divides uncontrollably, leading to kidney and bone damage. Myelodysplastic syndromes are a group of disorders that occur due to the abnormal functioning of blood cells.

Mantle cell lymphoma is a cancer of the lymph tissue where the B-cells or B lymphocytes (white blood cells) grow in an uncontrolled manner and build up in the lymph tissue, blood or bone marrow. Follicular lymphoma is slow-growing cancer that affects B lymphocytes that help fight infection.

Before taking LENALID 25MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have ever had blood clots, hepatitis B infection, varicella-zoster, HIV, kidney problems or a heart attack. LENALID 25MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use among pregnant or breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking LENALID 25MG CAPSULE are rashes, itching, muscle cramps, muscle weakness, muscle pain, muscle aches, bone pain, joint pain, back pain, pain in the extremities, weakness, tiredness, constipation, diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain and heartburn. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LENALID 25MG CAPSULE

It is used to manage:

Multiple myeloma
Myelodysplastic syndromes
Mantle cell lymphoma
Follicular lymphoma
mechanismOfAction:
How LENALID 25MG CAPSULE Works

LENALID 25MG CAPSULE works by enhancing the immune system that indirectly attacks the cancer cells. It stops the growth of new blood vessels within the tumour. It also limits the production of chemical messengers (cytokine and growth factor) which are responsible for the growth of cancer cells.
usageDetails:
How to use LENALID 25MG CAPSULE

Take LENALID 25MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About LIPISOL INJECTION

LIPISOL INJECTION contains Doxorubicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used to manage certain types of cancers. It is used either alone or along with other anti-cancer medicines.

Cancer is a disease in which some of the cells of the body grow uncontrollably and spread to other parts of the body.

Before receiving LIPISOL INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had heart disease, either before or during radiotherapy, had or having live or live-attenuated vaccinations, are currently taking or have recently taken Trastuzumab (used in the management of certain cancers).

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Consult your doctor during breast-feeding before starting management with this medicine as it may pass through the breast milk and possibly harm your child. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

The most common side effects of LIPISOL INJECTION are infection, lack of appetite, inflammation in the mouth, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, reddening, swelling, pain, numbness and tingling in the palms and feet may also occur whilst being managed with this medicine.

Hair loss is very common and may be quite severe, beard growth may stop in men, fever, feeling weak, chills, abnormal ECG (electrical trace of the heart) results, raised levels of liver enzymes (as detected by a blood test) can determine if the medicine is having an abnormal effect on your liver, weight increased in patients with early breast cancer.
uses: Used to manage certain types of cancer
usesDetails:
Uses Of LIPISOL INJECTION
Used to manage certain types of cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How LIPISOL INJECTION Works

LIPISOL INJECTION works by suppressing the activity of an enzyme (topoisomerase II) involved in the DNA multiplication of the cancer cells. On the other hand, this also forms harmful chemicals (free radicals) which cause damage to the DNA. This slowdown the growth of cancer cells and eventually works against them.
usageDetails:
How to use LIPISOL INJECTION

LIPISOL INJECTION will be administered intravenously (IV) into the vein by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Alrubicin 10mg Injection 1'S
introduction:
Introduction About ALRUBICIN 10MG INJECTION

ALRUBICIN 10MG INJECTION contains Epirubicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer agents. It is used to manage various types of cancer such as breast cancer, ovarian cancer, gastric cancer (stomach cancer), small cell lung cancer, head and neck cancer, liver cancer, blood cancer (leukemia), lymph cancer (lymphoma), pancreatic cancer and colorectal cancer (cancers of colon or rectum).  

It can also be used to manage cancers of soft tissues such as soft tissues sarcoma (cancer of the soft tissues that connects muscles, fats, blood vessels, nerves, tendons etc.) and helps to stop the occurrence of bladder cancer following surgeries (such as transurethral resection).

Before receiving ALRUBICIN 10MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any severe infections, low blood count or any bladder problems (such as problems in passing urine, burning sensation while passing urine etc.) as a precaution.

ALRUBICIN 10MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. Both men and women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with this medicine. Men may seek advice on sperm preservation, if necessary, prior to the therapy with this medicine.

The most common side effects of receiving ALRUBICIN 10MG INJECTION are hair loss, red urine, increased infection, hot flashes, mouth ulcers, inflammation of oesophagus, nausea, vomiting (within first 24 hours), loss of appetite, bladder infection, burning sensation while passing urine and pain, redness and swelling at the site of injection. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Soft tissue sarcoma (cancer of the soft tissues that connects muscles, fats, blood vessels, nerves, tendons etc.) and manages bladder cancer following surgery (such as transurethral resection)
usesDetails:
Uses Of ALRUBICIN 10MG INJECTION

It is used to manage:

Breast cancer
Ovarian cancer
Gastric cancer (stomach cancer)
Small cell lung cancer
Head and neck cancer
Liver cancer (hepatic carcinoma)

mechanismOfAction:
How ALRUBICIN 10MG INJECTION Works

ALRUBICIN 10MG INJECTION is an anticancer medication. It works by blocking the synthesis of genetic material (DNA and RNA) and certain essential proteins and enzymes which are required for the cells to grow and multiply. As a result, it stops abnormal cell division within the body, slows down the growth of cancer cells and eventually kills them.
usageDetails:
How to use ALRUBICIN 10MG INJECTION

ALRUBICIN 10MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (as an intravenous infusion) or into the bladder (intravesical administration).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: There is no proper information regarding the use of ALRUBICIN 10MG INJECTION in pregnant women. Animal studies have indicated harm to the growing offspring. Therefore, ALRUBICIN 10MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy during the management and for at least 6.5 months after the last dose.
ALRUBICIN 10MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in women who are breastfeeding. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
ALRUBICIN 10MG INJECTION does not affect your ability to drive or handle any heavy tools or machines.

ALRUBICIN 10MG INJECTION is not recommended to use in patients with severe kidney problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other mild kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.

ALRUBICIN 10MG INJECTION is not recommended to use in patients with severe liver problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other mild liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
Talk to your doctor before receiving ALRUBICIN 10MG INJECTION if you are allergic to Epirubicin.

ALRUBICIN 10MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other mild heart problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
The safety and efficacy of ALRUBICIN 10MG INJECTION have not been established in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
ALRUBICIN 10MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.

Others

ALRUBICIN 10MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have previously received high doses of similar anticancer medicines
Suffer from severely reduced number of blood cells
Have an acute severe infection
Have bladder cancer that has been spread until the bladder wall
Have urinary tract infection
Have pain or inflammation of the bladder
Have problems in emptying your bladder
Pass bloody urine
Have a contracted bladder

Inform your doctor, before receiving ALRUBICIN 10MG INJECTION, if you:

Recently received any vaccine or plan to receive any vaccines
Recently had radiation therapy

Have an acute severe infection

Have urinary tract infection
Have pain or inflammation of the bladder
Have problems in emptying your bladder
Pass bloody urine
Have a contracted bladder

Inform your doctor, before receiving ALRUBICIN 10MG INJECTION, if you:

Recently received any vaccine or plan to receive any vaccines
Recently had radiation therapy

introduction:
Introduction About DYRONIB 50 TABLET

DYRONIB 50 TABLET contains Dasatinib which belongs to the group of medicines called Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors. It is used to manage cancers of blood and bone marrow (such as chronic myeloid leukaemia (CML) and philadelphia chromosome positive (Ph+) acute lymphoblastic leukaemia) in adults, adolescents and in children (aged 1 year or above).

It is primarily used in patients when management with conventional therapies is not suitable or fails to provide adequate response.   

Leukaemia is the cancer of white blood cells. It is caused due to abnormal growth and multiplication of blood cells within the bone marrow. It is characterized by severe tiredness, breathlessness, increased bleeding tendency, tiredness, anemia, night sweats, fever, chills, frequent infections and weight loss.

During management with DYRONIB 50 TABLET your doctor will closely monitor your health condition through several blood tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking DYRONIB 50 TABLET as it may increase the risk of side effects.

Before taking DYRONIB 50 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have or at risk of developing hepatitis C infection as a precaution.

Avoid concomitant use of antacids or any stomach medicines along with DYRONIB 50 TABLET. Leave a time gap of at least 2 hours between the medicines. DYRONIB 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women.

Men and women taking DYRONIB 50 TABLET must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with DYRONIB 50 TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking DYRONIB 50 TABLET are increased bleeding tendency, increased infections, feeling tired or weak, nausea, vomiting, hair loss, mouth ulcers, changes in taste, inflammation of the food pipe or stomach, muscle pain or spasm, skin rashes, headache, dizziness and weight loss. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Cancers of blood and bone marrow (such as chronic myeloid leukaemia and philadelphia chromosome positive (Ph+) acute lymphoblastic leukaemia)
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How DYRONIB 50 TABLET Works

DYRONIB 50 TABLET is an anti-cancer medicine. It works by blocking the actions of certain proteins (such as BCR-ABL, Src kinase, etc.) in the body that triggers cancer formation. As a result, it reduces abnormal growth and multiplication of cancer cells in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use DYRONIB 50 TABLET

Take DYRONIB 50 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without meals. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Try to take DYRONIB 50 TABLET at the same time each day. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking DYRONIB 50 TABLET unless advised by your doctor.

Introduction About TYKERB 250MG TABLET

TYKERB 250MG TABLET contains Lapatinib which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer agents. It is used to manage metastatic breast cancer (cancer that has been spread to other parts of the body from breast). It is mostly used in combination with other anticancer or hormonal medicines (such as capecitabine, trastuzumab or anastrozole) to achieve better results.

TYKERB 250MG TABLET can be taken either one hour before or one hour after food. During management with TYKERB 250MG TABLET, your doctor will periodically monitor your heart, liver, kidney and lung functions as a precaution.

Before taking TYKERB 250MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diarrhea before taking this medicine.

Do not take TYKERB 250MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking TYKERB 250MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, weakness, indigestion, constipation, sore mouth, trouble sleeping, back pain, joint pain, headache, hot flushes, hair loss, nail disorder and abnormal heartbeat. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Manage metastatic breast cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How TYKERB 250MG TABLET Works

TYKERB 250MG TABLET is an anticancer agent. It works by blocking the actions of certain cellular proteins (tyrosine kinase) that triggers cancer cell formation. It also blocks various downstream cell signalling pathways that triggers cancer growth within the body. As a result, it reduces cancer formation and manages its further growth within the body.

Take TYKERB 250MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. TYKERB 250MG TABLET can be taken either one hour before or one hour after food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take TYKERB 250MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About OXALTERO 100MG INJECTION

OXALTERO 100MG INJECTION contains Oxaliplatin which belongs to the group of medicine called Anticancer drugs. It is used to manage cancers of the colon and/or rectum. It is highly used in combination with other anti-cancer medicines (such as 5-flurouracil and folinic acid) as an adjunct to manage stage III colon cancer after removing the primary tumour. It can also be used to manage metastatic colorectal cancer (cancer of colon and rectum that has been spread to other parts of the body).

Before receiving OXALTERO 100MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have low white blood count in your blood or recently received or planning to receive any vaccination in the upcoming days.

OXALTERO 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children aged below 18 years. Men and women receiving OXALTERO 100MG INJECTION must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with OXALTERO 100MG INJECTION.

The most common side effects of receiving OXALTERO 100MG INJECTION are tingling and numbness of body parts, abnormal sensation in the throat, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, headache, dizziness, tiredness, weight loss, changes in taste, skin rash, hair loss, mouth ulcers and low blood calcium levels. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of OXALTERO 100MG INJECTION

It is used to manage:

Colon cancer (stage III)
Metastatic colorectal cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How OXALTERO 100MG INJECTION Works

OXALTERO 100MG INJECTION is an anticancer medication. It works by damaging the DNA (genetic material) of the cancer cells. As a result, it reduces abnormal growth and multiplication of cancer cells in the body.

OXALTERO 100MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein (as an intravenous infusion).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ALRUBICIN 50MG INJECTION

ALRUBICIN 50MG INJECTION contains Epirubicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer agents. It is used to manage various types of cancer such as breast cancer, ovarian cancer, gastric cancer (stomach cancer), small cell lung cancer, head and neck cancer, liver cancer, blood cancer (leukemia), lymph cancer (lymphoma), pancreatic cancer and colorectal cancer (cancers of colon or rectum).  

It can also be used to manage cancers of soft tissues such as soft tissues sarcoma (cancer of the soft tissues that connects muscles, fats, blood vessels, nerves, tendons etc.) and helps to stop the occurrence of bladder cancer following surgeries (such as transurethral resection).

Before receiving ALRUBICIN 50MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any severe infections, low blood count or any bladder problems (such as problems in passing urine, burning sensation while passing urine etc.) as a precaution.

ALRUBICIN 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. Both men and women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with this medicine. Men may seek advice on sperm preservation, if necessary, prior to the therapy with this medicine.

The most common side effects of receiving ALRUBICIN 50MG INJECTION are hair loss, red urine, increased infection, hot flashes, mouth ulcers, inflammation of oesophagus, nausea, vomiting (within first 24 hours), loss of appetite, bladder infection, burning sensation while passing urine and pain, redness and swelling at the site of injection. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Soft tissue sarcoma (cancer of the soft tissues that connects muscles, fats, blood vessels, nerves, tendons etc.) and manages bladder cancer following surgery (such as transurethral resection)

mechanismOfAction:
How ALRUBICIN 50MG INJECTION Works

ALRUBICIN 50MG INJECTION is an anticancer medication. It works by blocking the synthesis of genetic material (DNA and RNA) and certain essential proteins and enzymes which are required for the cells to grow and multiply. As a result, it stops abnormal cell division within the body, slows down the growth of cancer cells and eventually kills them.
usageDetails:
How to use ALRUBICIN 50MG INJECTION

ALRUBICIN 50MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (as an intravenous infusion) or into the bladder (intravesical administration).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Therefore, ALRUBICIN 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy during the management and for at least 6.5 months after the last dose.
ALRUBICIN 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in women who are breastfeeding. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
ALRUBICIN 50MG INJECTION does not affect your ability to drive or handle any heavy tools or machines.

ALRUBICIN 50MG INJECTION is not recommended to use in patients with severe kidney problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other mild kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.

ALRUBICIN 50MG INJECTION is not recommended to use in patients with severe liver problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other mild liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
Talk to your doctor before receiving ALRUBICIN 50MG INJECTION if you are allergic to Epirubicin.

ALRUBICIN 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other mild heart problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
The safety and efficacy of ALRUBICIN 50MG INJECTION have not been established in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
ALRUBICIN 50MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.

Others

ALRUBICIN 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have previously received high doses of similar anticancer medicines
Suffer from severely reduced number of blood cells
Have an acute severe infection
Have bladder cancer that has been spread until the bladder wall
Have urinary tract infection
Have pain or inflammation of the bladder
Have problems in emptying your bladder
Pass bloody urine
Have a contracted bladder

Inform your doctor, before receiving ALRUBICIN 50MG INJECTION, if you:

Recently received any vaccine or plan to receive any vaccines
Recently had radiation therapy

introduction:
Introduction About RIBOREA CAPSULE

RIBOREA CAPSULE contains Hydroxyurea, which belongs to a group of medicines called Antimetabolites. It is used to manage resistant chronic myeloid leukaemia and locally advanced squamous cell cancer of the head and neck (excluding the lip) and cervical cancer.

RIBOREA CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with a history of any blood problems or severe anaemia. RIBOREA CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with liver, lung or kidney disease and myelosuppression (leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, anaemia).

RIBOREA CAPSULE is not recommended for use during pregnancy. RIBOREA CAPSULE is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women. RIBOREA CAPSULE is also not recommended for use in children as its safety and effectiveness are not established. RIBOREA CAPSULE should be used with caution in the elderly aged 65 years or above.

The most common side effects of taking RIBOREA CAPSULE are loss of appetite, weakness, loss of energy, sickness, diarrhoea, constipation, abdominal pain, hair loss, blood disorders (decrease in white blood cells, red blood cells and platelets), low back pain, black tarry stools or blood in the stools, unusual bleeding or bruising, muscle weakness, sores on the lips or mouth etc. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage locally advanced squamous cell carcinomas of the head and neck, (excluding lip)

Manage resistant chronic myeloid leukaemia

Manage cervical cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How RIBOREA CAPSULE Works

RIBOREA CAPSULE gets converted to free radical nitroxide (NO), which enters the cells, inactivates the ribonucleotide reductase enzyme and causes immediate inhibition of DNA synthesis, leading to cell death.

How to use RIBOREA CAPSULE

Take RIBOREA CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Duxocin 50mg Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About DUXOCIN 50MG INJECTION

DUXOCIN 50MG INJECTION contains Doxorubicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used to manage certain types of cancers. It is used either alone or along with other anti-cancer medicines.

Cancer is a disease in which some of the cells of the body grow uncontrollably and spread to other parts of the body.

Before receiving DUXOCIN 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had heart disease, either before or during radiotherapy, had or having live or live-attenuated vaccinations, are currently taking or have recently taken Trastuzumab (used in the management of certain cancers).

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Consult your doctor during breast-feeding before starting management with this medicine as it may pass through the breast milk and possibly harm your child. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

The most common side effects of DUXOCIN 50MG INJECTION are infection, lack of appetite, inflammation in the mouth, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, reddening, swelling, pain, numbness and tingling in the palms and feet may also occur whilst being managed with this medicine.

Hair loss is very common and may be quite severe, beard growth may stop in men, fever, feeling weak, chills, abnormal ECG (electrical trace of the heart) results, raised levels of liver enzymes (as detected by a blood test) can determine if the medicine is having an abnormal effect on your liver, weight increased in patients with early breast cancer.
uses: Used to manage certain types of cancer
usesDetails:
Uses Of DUXOCIN 50MG INJECTION
Used to manage certain types of cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How DUXOCIN 50MG INJECTION Works

DUXOCIN 50MG INJECTION works by suppressing the activity of an enzyme (topoisomerase II) involved in the DNA multiplication of the cancer cells. On the other hand, this also forms harmful chemicals (free radicals) which cause damage to the DNA. This slowdown the growth of cancer cells and eventually works against them.
usageDetails:
How to use DUXOCIN 50MG INJECTION

DUXOCIN 50MG INJECTION will be administered intravenously (IV) into the vein by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

DUXOCIN 50MG INJECTION is not recommended in patients with a current or previous history of cardiac impairment (severe myocardial insufficiency, recent myocardial infarction, severe arrhythmia) Consult your doctor before receiving it.

Any other medical conditions

DUXOCIN 50MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

name: CELOSIDE 100 Injection 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About CELOSIDE 100 INJECTION

CELOSIDE 100 INJECTION contains Etoposide which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer agents. It is used to manage various types of cancer such as lung cancer, blood cancer, lymph cancer, ovarian cancer and testicular cancer.     

CELOSIDE 100 INJECTION should be used under careful medical supervision. During management with CELOSIDE 100 INJECTION, your doctor will periodically monitor your heart, liver, kidney functions as a precaution.

Before receiving CELOSIDE 100 INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any serious infections, low albumin levels in blood or recently received any vaccine or radiotherapy or chemotherapy as a precaution.

Do not receive CELOSIDE 100 INJECTION without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Both men and women undergoing therapy with this medicine, must use a suitable contraceptive to stop pregnancy during and until 6 months after stopping the therapy.

The most common side effects of receiving CELOSIDE 100 INJECTION are blood disorders, loss of appetite, constipation, pigmentation on the skin, temporary hair loss, weakness, tiredness and sore lips, mouth or throat ulcers. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
uses: Lymph cancer (Ex. Hodgkin’s lymphoma, non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma)
usesDetails:
Uses Of CELOSIDE 100 INJECTION

It is used to manage various types of cancer such as:

Small cell lung cancer
Blood cancer (Ex. acute myeloid leukaemia)
Lymph cancer (Ex. Hodgkin’s lymphoma, non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma)
Ovarian cancer
Testicular cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How CELOSIDE 100 INJECTION Works

CELOSIDE 100 INJECTION is an anticancer agent. It works by blocking the abnormal actions of certain cellular proteins (topoisomerase 2) that triggers cancer cell formation. As a result, it reduces cancer formation and stops its further growth within the body.
usageDetails:
How to use CELOSIDE 100 INJECTION

CELOSIDE 100 INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously).  Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: TADRO 50 Injection 25ml
introduction:
Introduction About TADRO 50 INJECTION

TADRO 50 INJECTION contains Doxorubicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used to manage certain types of cancers. It is used either alone or along with other anti-cancer medicines.

Cancer is a disease in which some of the cells of the body grow uncontrollably and spread to other parts of the body.

Before receiving TADRO 50 INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had heart disease, either before or during radiotherapy, had or having live or live-attenuated vaccinations, are currently taking or have recently taken Trastuzumab (used in the management of certain cancers).

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Consult your doctor during breast-feeding before starting management with this medicine as it may pass through the breast milk and possibly harm your child. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

The most common side effects of TADRO 50 INJECTION are infection, lack of appetite, inflammation in the mouth, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, reddening, swelling, pain, numbness and tingling in the palms and feet may also occur whilst being managed with this medicine.

Hair loss is very common and may be quite severe, beard growth may stop in men, fever, feeling weak, chills, abnormal ECG (electrical trace of the heart) results, raised levels of liver enzymes (as detected by a blood test) can determine if the medicine is having an abnormal effect on your liver, weight increased in patients with early breast cancer.
uses: Used to manage certain types of cancer
usesDetails:
Uses Of TADRO 50 INJECTION
Used to manage certain types of cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How TADRO 50 INJECTION Works

TADRO 50 INJECTION works by suppressing the activity of an enzyme (topoisomerase II) involved in the DNA multiplication of the cancer cells. On the other hand, this also forms harmful chemicals (free radicals) which cause damage to the DNA. This slowdown the growth of cancer cells and eventually works against them.
usageDetails:
How to use TADRO 50 INJECTION

TADRO 50 INJECTION will be administered intravenously (IV) into the vein by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Toritz T 100mg Injection 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About TORITZ T 100MG INJECTION

TORITZ T 100MG INJECTION contains Rituximab which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer drugs. It is used to manage blood cancer (leukaemia) and lymph cancer (lymphoma). It can also be used to manage various auto-immune disease conditions such as rheumatoid arthritis, granulomatosis with polyangiitis or microscopic polyangiitis (inflammation of blood vessels) and pemphigus vulgaris (severe skin blistering and peeling especially on the mouth, nose, throat, eyes and genitals).

It is mostly used in combination with other cytotoxic anticancer agents to achieve better results. It is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 6 months or older). TORITZ T 100MG INJECTION will be administered to you only by an oncologist or a trained professional into your vein (as intravenous infusion).

Before receiving TORITZ T 100MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any heart problems (such as chest pain, heart attack, heart failure or abnormal heartbeat). You must also inform your doctor if you currently have or previously had hepatitis B infection or any other mild infections (including minor cough and cold) as a precaution.

TORITZ T 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. Both men and women receiving TORITZ T 100MG INJECTION must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with TORITZ T 100MG INJECTION.

The most common side effects of receiving this medicine are fever, chills, skin rashes with itching, shortness of breath and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

usesDetails:
Uses Of TORITZ T 100MG INJECTION

It is used to manage:

Blood cancer (Chronic lymphocytic leukaemia)
Lymph cancer (Non-Hodgkin’s Lymphoma)
Rheumatoid arthritis (joint pain and inflammation)
Granulomatosis with polyangiitis or microscopic polyangiitis (inflammation of blood vessels)
Pemphigus vulgaris (severe skin blistering and peeling especially on the mouth, nose, throat, eyes and genitals)
mechanismOfAction:
How TORITZ T 100MG INJECTION Works

TORITZ T 100MG INJECTION is a monoclonal antibody. It destroys the immune cells (B-cells) that triggers cancer formation. It also reduces the production of certain chemicals within the body (such as rheumatoid factor, T-cells, cytokines) that causes inflammation, pain and swelling which helps in managing various autoimmune diseases.
usageDetails:
How to use TORITZ T 100MG INJECTION

TORITZ T 100MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About GLIOTEM 250MG CAPSULE

GLIOTEM 250MG CAPSULE contains Temozolomide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antineoplastic agents. It is used for specific forms of brain tumours in adults with newly diagnosed glioblastoma multiforme, which is used first together with radiotherapy as a concomitant phase of therapy and then used alone as a monotherapy. It is also used in children (above 3 years) and adults to manage malignant gliomas, such as glioblastoma multiforme or anaplastic astrocytoma, if they return or get worse after standard management.

Glioblastoma multiforme is an aggressive type of cancer that affects the brain or spinal cord and is generally characterized by symptoms such as headache, nausea, drowsiness, blurred vision, personality changes, and seizures.

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to take liver function tests to assess the hepatotoxicity and function of your liver. Before taking GLIOTEM 250MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had a hepatitis B infection (serious liver infection).

GLIOTEM 250MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have certain kinds of blood cells that are severely reduced, such as white blood cells and platelet count. GLIOTEM 250MG CAPSULE should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary and not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. It is not recommended for use in children below 3 years of age and should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from 3 to 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking GLIOTEM 250MG CAPSULE. The most common side effects of taking GLIOTEM 250MG CAPSULE are loss of appetite, difficulty while speaking, headache, vomiting, nausea, diarrhea, and constipation. Consult and inform your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.
uses: Specific forms of brain tumours in newly diagnosed glioblastoma multiforme (in adults)
Malignant glioma, such as glioblastoma multiforme or anaplastic astrocytoma (in adults and children)

mechanismOfAction:
How GLIOTEM 250MG CAPSULE Works

GLIOTEM 250MG CAPSULE works by damaging the genetic material (DNA and RNA) of the cancer cells inside the brain cells and works against the cell growth and multiplication.
usageDetails:
How to use GLIOTEM 250MG CAPSULE

Take GLIOTEM 250MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow GLIOTEM 250MG CAPSULE with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Women with childbearing potential should use effective contraceptive precautions, which should be continued for at least 6 months following the completion of> management. GLIOTEM 250MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking GLIOTEM 250MG CAPSULE.

GLIOTEM 250MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems such as severe renal impairment. Consult your doctor for advice before taking GLIOTEM 250MG CAPSULE.
GLIOTEM 250MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with mild, moderate, and severe hepatic impairment. Consult your doctor for advice before taking GLIOTEM 250MG CAPSULE.

GLIOTEM 250MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with lung disease such as pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia (serious fungal infection of lungs). Consult your doctor before taking GLIOTEM 250MG CAPSULE.

GLIOTEM 250MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children below 3 years of age. There is limited information in patients over 3 years of age who have taken GLIOTEM 250MG CAPSULE. Consult your doctor before taking GLIOTEM 250MG CAPSULE.
GLIOTEM 250MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 70 years or above). Consult your doctor before taking GLIOTEM 250MG CAPSULE.

Others

GLIOTEM 250MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have certain kinds of blood cells that are severely reduced, such as white blood cells and platelet count

Before taking GLIOTEM 250MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you:

Have signs of anemia (low red blood cell count)
Have signs of low platelet count
Have a risk of other changes in blood cells, such as leukemia (blood cancer)

introduction:
Introduction About DACAREX 500MG INJECTION

DACAREX 500MG INJECTION contains Dacarbazine which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer Agents. It is used to manage certain types of skin cancer (such as metastatic melanoma) and lymph cancer (such as Hodgkin’s disease). It can also be used in the management of soft tissue sarcoma (cancer of connective tissues).

Before receiving DACAREX 500MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have low WBC and platelet counts in blood or currently receiving radiotherapy as a precaution. Avoid consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with this medicine.

DACAREX 500MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. Both men and women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with this medicine and until 6 months after the last dose.

The common side effects associated with the use of DACAREX 500MG INJECTION are nausea, vomiting, flu-like symptoms, nerve damage and low RBC, WBC and platelet counts causing tiredness, pale skin, increased infections, fever, sore throat, chills and increased bleeding or bruising. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects troubles you.
uses: Soft tissue sarcoma (cancer of connective tissues passing between muscles, fat, blood vessels and supporting tissues)
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How DACAREX 500MG INJECTION Works

DACAREX 500MG INJECTION is an anticancer medication. It works by damaging the cellular genetic material (DNA). This interferes with the functions of DNA and stops cancer cells from multiplying. Therefore, it stops the multiplication of abnormal cell division within the body and decreases cancer progression.
usageDetails:
How to use DACAREX 500MG INJECTION

DACAREX 500MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor specialized in oncology or haematology into the vein (intravenously).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with DACAREX 500MG INJECTION and until 6 months after stopping the therapy. If you accidentally became pregnant while receiving DACAREX 500MG INJECTION, inform your doctor immediately.
DACAREX 500MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Therefore, inform your doctor before receiving it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you experience dizziness, nausea or vomiting after receiving DACAREX 500MG INJECTION.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with DACAREX 500MG INJECTION.

DACAREX 500MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney diseases. It should be used with caution in patients with mild or moderate kidney problems. Therefore, inform your doctor before receiving it.

DACAREX 500MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver diseases. It should be used with caution in patients with mild or moderate liver problems. Therefore, inform your doctor before receiving it.
Talk to your doctor before receiving DACAREX 500MG INJECTION if you are allergic to dacarbazine.
DACAREX 500MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety data. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.
DACAREX 500MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.

Others

Have leukopenia (low count of white blood cells)
Have thrombocytopenia (low blood platelet count)
Are scheduled for a live vaccine immunization

Before receiving DACAREX 500MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:    

Are currently undergoing radiation therapy

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before receiving DACAREX 500MG INJECTION, inform your doctor, if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Cytostatic agents (medicine used to stop the cell growth in cancer patients) Ex. paclitaxel, cisplatin
Diazepam (a medicine used to manage anxiety and to induce sleep)
Imipramine (a medicine used to manage depression)
Ketoconazole (a medicine used to manage fungal infections)
Medicines used to manage fits (such as phenytoin and carbamazepine)
Methoxypsoralen (medicine used to manage severe psoriasis)
Oral anticoagulants (medicine used to delay blood clotting) Ex. dabigatran
Cyclosporine or tacrolimus (medicines used to stop organ rejection post-transplant)
Fotemustine (another medicine used to manage metastatic melanoma)
Radiotherapy or live vaccines

Overdosage:

DACAREX 500MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or nurse in a hospital, and so it is unlikely to receive an overdose. However, consult your doctor if you experience any unusual side effects.

introduction:
Introduction About NATDOX LP 20MG INJECTION

NATDOX LP 20MG INJECTION contains Doxorubicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used to manage certain types of cancers. It is used either alone or along with other anti-cancer medicines.

Cancer is a disease in which some of the cells of the body grow uncontrollably and spread to other parts of the body.

Before receiving NATDOX LP 20MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had heart disease, either before or during radiotherapy, had or having live or live-attenuated vaccinations, are currently taking or have recently taken Trastuzumab (used in the management of certain cancers).

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Consult your doctor during breast-feeding before starting management with this medicine as it may pass through the breast milk and possibly harm your child. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

The most common side effects of NATDOX LP 20MG INJECTION are infection, lack of appetite, inflammation in the mouth, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, reddening, swelling, pain, numbness and tingling in the palms and feet may also occur whilst being managed with this medicine.

Hair loss is very common and may be quite severe, beard growth may stop in men, fever, feeling weak, chills, abnormal ECG (electrical trace of the heart) results, raised levels of liver enzymes (as detected by a blood test) can determine if the medicine is having an abnormal effect on your liver, weight increased in patients with early breast cancer.
uses: Used to manage certain types of cancer
usesDetails:
Uses Of NATDOX LP 20MG INJECTION
Used to manage certain types of cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How NATDOX LP 20MG INJECTION Works

NATDOX LP 20MG INJECTION works by suppressing the activity of an enzyme (topoisomerase II) involved in the DNA multiplication of the cancer cells. On the other hand, this also forms harmful chemicals (free radicals) which cause damage to the DNA. This slowdown the growth of cancer cells and eventually works against them.
usageDetails:
How to use NATDOX LP 20MG INJECTION

NATDOX LP 20MG INJECTION will be administered intravenously (IV) into the vein by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
