introduction:
Introduction About NUDOXA 2MG INJECTION

NUDOXA 2MG INJECTION contains Doxorubicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used to manage certain types of cancers. It is used either alone or along with other anti-cancer medicines.

Cancer is a disease in which some of the cells of the body grow uncontrollably and spread to other parts of the body.

Before receiving NUDOXA 2MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had heart disease, either before or during radiotherapy, had or having live or live-attenuated vaccinations, are currently taking or have recently taken Trastuzumab (used in the management of certain cancers).

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Consult your doctor during breast-feeding before starting management with this medicine as it may pass through the breast milk and possibly harm your child. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

The most common side effects of NUDOXA 2MG INJECTION are infection, lack of appetite, inflammation in the mouth, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, reddening, swelling, pain, numbness and tingling in the palms and feet may also occur whilst being managed with this medicine.

Hair loss is very common and may be quite severe, beard growth may stop in men, fever, feeling weak, chills, abnormal ECG (electrical trace of the heart) results, raised levels of liver enzymes (as detected by a blood test) can determine if the medicine is having an abnormal effect on your liver, weight increased in patients with early breast cancer.
uses: Used to manage certain types of cancer
usesDetails:
Uses Of NUDOXA 2MG INJECTION
Used to manage certain types of cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How NUDOXA 2MG INJECTION Works

NUDOXA 2MG INJECTION works by suppressing the activity of an enzyme (topoisomerase II) involved in the DNA multiplication of the cancer cells. On the other hand, this also forms harmful chemicals (free radicals) which cause damage to the DNA. This slowdown the growth of cancer cells and eventually works against them.

name: Temodal 250mg Capsule 5'S
introduction:
Introduction About TEMODAL 250MG CAPSULE

TEMODAL 250MG CAPSULE contains Temozolomide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antineoplastic agents. It is used for specific forms of brain tumours in adults with newly diagnosed glioblastoma multiforme, which is used first together with radiotherapy as a concomitant phase of therapy and then used alone as a monotherapy. It is also used in children (above 3 years) and adults to manage malignant gliomas, such as glioblastoma multiforme or anaplastic astrocytoma, if they return or get worse after standard management.

Glioblastoma multiforme is an aggressive type of cancer that affects the brain or spinal cord and is generally characterized by symptoms such as headache, nausea, drowsiness, blurred vision, personality changes, and seizures.

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to take liver function tests to assess the hepatotoxicity and function of your liver. Before taking TEMODAL 250MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had a hepatitis B infection (serious liver infection).

TEMODAL 250MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have certain kinds of blood cells that are severely reduced, such as white blood cells and platelet count. TEMODAL 250MG CAPSULE should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary and not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. It is not recommended for use in children below 3 years of age and should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from 3 to 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking TEMODAL 250MG CAPSULE. The most common side effects of taking TEMODAL 250MG CAPSULE are loss of appetite, difficulty while speaking, headache, vomiting, nausea, diarrhea, and constipation. Consult and inform your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.

Malignant glioma, such as glioblastoma multiforme or anaplastic astrocytoma (in adults and children)

TEMODAL 250MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children below 3 years of age. There is limited information in patients over 3 years of age who have taken TEMODAL 250MG CAPSULE. Consult your doctor before taking TEMODAL 250MG CAPSULE.
TEMODAL 250MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 70 years or above). Consult your doctor before taking TEMODAL 250MG CAPSULE.

Others

Have signs of anemia (low red blood cell count)
Have signs of low platelet count

introduction:
Introduction About LENALID 15MG CAPSULE

LENALID 15MG CAPSULE contains Lenalidomide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Immunomodulatory agents. It is used in the management of multiple myeloma, myelodysplastic syndromes, mantle cell lymphoma and follicular lymphoma. Cancer is a disease in which abnormal cells divide uncontrollably in the body and destroy body tissue.

Multiple myeloma is a type of cancer that affects a type of white blood cell (plasma cell) that collects in the bone marrow and divides uncontrollably, leading to kidney and bone damage. Myelodysplastic syndromes are a group of disorders that occur due to the abnormal functioning of blood cells.

Mantle cell lymphoma is a cancer of the lymph tissue where the B-cells or B lymphocytes (white blood cells) grow in an uncontrolled manner and build up in the lymph tissue, blood or bone marrow. Follicular lymphoma is slow-growing cancer that affects B lymphocytes that help fight infection.

Before taking LENALID 15MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have ever had blood clots, hepatitis B infection, varicella-zoster, HIV, kidney problems or a heart attack. LENALID 15MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use among pregnant or breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking LENALID 15MG CAPSULE are rashes, itching, muscle cramps, muscle weakness, muscle pain, muscle aches, bone pain, joint pain, back pain, pain in the extremities, weakness, tiredness, constipation, diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain and heartburn. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LENALID 15MG CAPSULE

It is used to manage:

Multiple myeloma
Myelodysplastic syndromes
Mantle cell lymphoma
Follicular lymphoma
mechanismOfAction:
How LENALID 15MG CAPSULE Works

LENALID 15MG CAPSULE works by enhancing the immune system that indirectly attacks the cancer cells. It stops the growth of new blood vessels within the tumour. It also limits the production of chemical messengers (cytokine and growth factor) which are responsible for the growth of cancer cells.

Take LENALID 15MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: DOXUTEC 50mg Injection 25ml
introduction:
Introduction About DOXUTEC 50MG INJECTION

DOXUTEC 50MG INJECTION contains Doxorubicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used to manage certain types of cancers. It is used either alone or along with other anti-cancer medicines.

Cancer is a disease in which some of the cells of the body grow uncontrollably and spread to other parts of the body.

Before receiving DOXUTEC 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had heart disease, either before or during radiotherapy, had or having live or live-attenuated vaccinations, are currently taking or have recently taken Trastuzumab (used in the management of certain cancers).

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Consult your doctor during breast-feeding before starting management with this medicine as it may pass through the breast milk and possibly harm your child. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

The most common side effects of DOXUTEC 50MG INJECTION are infection, lack of appetite, inflammation in the mouth, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, reddening, swelling, pain, numbness and tingling in the palms and feet may also occur whilst being managed with this medicine.

Hair loss is very common and may be quite severe, beard growth may stop in men, fever, feeling weak, chills, abnormal ECG (electrical trace of the heart) results, raised levels of liver enzymes (as detected by a blood test) can determine if the medicine is having an abnormal effect on your liver, weight increased in patients with early breast cancer.
uses: Used to manage certain types of cancer
usesDetails:
Uses Of DOXUTEC 50MG INJECTION
Used to manage certain types of cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How DOXUTEC 50MG INJECTION Works

DOXUTEC 50MG INJECTION works by suppressing the activity of an enzyme (topoisomerase II) involved in the DNA multiplication of the cancer cells. On the other hand, this also forms harmful chemicals (free radicals) which cause damage to the DNA. This slowdown the growth of cancer cells and eventually works against them.
usageDetails:
How to use DOXUTEC 50MG INJECTION

DOXUTEC 50MG INJECTION will be administered intravenously (IV) into the vein by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About GROS 30MG INJECTION

GROS 30MG INJECTION contains Paclitaxel which belongs to a group of anti-cancer medicines called Taxanes. GROS 30MG INJECTION is used to manage ovarian and breast cancer as a first line of therapy and as a second line of management when platinum containing medicines (such as cisplatin) or anthracyclines are insufficient to manage the disease in affected individuals.

GROS 30MG INJECTION is also used to manage advanced NSCLC (non-small cell lung cancer) when surgery/radiation therapy is not suitable. The medicine is also indicated for use to manage AIDS-related Kaposi’s sarcoma when other managements (such as anthracyclines) are insufficient to manage the disease in affected individuals.

GROS 30MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to paclitaxel and polyoxyethylated castor oil. It is also not recommended for use in patients with few white blood cells count and serious & uncontrolled infection. The medicine is also not used in patients suffering from severe liver disease.

Before receiving GROS 30MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had previously received radiation to your chest and/or suffering from thrombocytopenia (low platelet count)/acute infections (such as herpes zoster, chickenpox, herpes), kidney problems (such as chronic kidney disease), liver problems (such as mild/moderate hepatic impairment) and/or heart problems (such as severe coronary artery disease, myocardial infarction and arrhythmias).

GROS 30MG INJECTION is not recommended for use during pregnancy. Women of child-bearing potential should use effective contraception method while receiving GROS 30MG INJECTION which should be continued for next-6 months after completing the management. The medicine is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

GROS 30MG INJECTION is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The medicine can be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving GROS 30MG INJECTION are minor allergic reactions (such as flushing, rash, itching), shortness of breath, sore throat/mouth ulcers, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting and/or loss of hair. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How GROS 30MG INJECTION Works

GROS 30MG INJECTION works by interfering with the microtubule structures in the cell (substance which aids cancer cells to divide and multiply) thus inhibiting the growth of cancer cells and managing its spread in affected individuals.

How to use GROS 30MG INJECTION

GROS 30MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About SUTIB 12.5 CAPSULE

SUTIB 12.5 CAPSULE contains Sunitinib which belongs to the group of medicines called Protein Kinase Inhibitors. It is used in the management of gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST) (a type of cancer of the stomach and bowel) where another anticancer medicine (imatinib) no longer works or you cannot take it and metastatic renal cell carcinoma (MRCC) (type of kidney cancer that has spread to other parts of the body).

SUTIB 12.5 CAPSULE is also used to manage pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (pNET) (tumors of the hormone-producing cells in the pancreas) that have progressed or cannot be removed with surgery. Your doctor might ask you to take blood tests, check your blood pressure and take your ECG during management with SUTIB 12.5 CAPSULE and as clinically indicated.

Before taking SUTIB 12.5 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have heart, kidney, liver, blood, thyroid or pancreatic problems, seizures and diabetes or if you recently had or are going to undergo any surgery.

Ask your doctor before taking SUTIB 12.5 CAPSULE during pregnancy. You should not breastfeed while taking SUTIB 12.5 CAPSULE so, consult your doctor before taking it. It is not known if SUTIB 12.5 CAPSULE is safe and effective in children and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking SUTIB 12.5 CAPSULE are rashes, itching, muscle cramps, bone pain weakness, tiredness, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, etc. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen or persists.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SUTIB 12.5 CAPSULE

SUTIB 12.5 CAPSULE manages:

Gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST)
Metastatic renal cell carcinoma (MRCC)
Pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (pNET)
mechanismOfAction:
How SUTIB 12.5 CAPSULE Works

SUTIB 12.5 CAPSULE helps control cancer advancement by inhibiting the activity of a special group of proteins which are found to be involved in the growth and spread of cancer cells.
usageDetails:
How to use SUTIB 12.5 CAPSULE

Take SUTIB 12.5 CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow with enough water. Do not crush or chew it. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of SUTIB 12.5 CAPSULE management depending on your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking SUTIB 12.5 CAPSULE unless your doctor advises you to stop.

Painful skin ulceration
Inflammation of the liver or thyroid gland
Thrombotic microangiopathy (scarring of the smallest blood vessels)

Heart problems like heart failure and heart muscle problems (feeling very tired or breathless, swollen feet and ankles)
Lung or breathing problems like pulmonary embolism (cough, chest pain, sudden onset of breathlessness, coughing up blood)
Kidney disorders like kidney failure (altered frequency or absence of urination)
Bleeding problems (painful, swollen stomach, vomiting blood, black, sticky stools, bloody urine, headache, change in the mental status, coughing up blood or bloody sputum from the lungs or airway)
Tumor destruction leading to a hole in the intestine (severe abdominal pain, fever, nausea, vomiting, blood in your stool, change in bowel habits)
Blood clot in blood vessels (chest pain or pressure, pain in your arms, back, neck or jaw, breathlessness, numbness or weakness on one side of your body, trouble talking, headache or dizziness)
Getting tired more easily, feeling colder than other people, voice deepening
Skin conditions like pyoderma gangrenosum or necrotizing fasciitis (fever, pain, redness, swelling, drainage of pus or blood)
Toxic epidermal necrolysis, erythema multiforme, Stevens-Johnson syndrome (reddish target-like spots or circular patches often with central blisters on the trunk, rash that may progress to widespread blistering or peeling of the skin)
Low blood sugar (fatigue, throbbing sensation, sweating, hunger)
Severe liver problems (itching, yellow eyes or skin, dark urine, pain or discomfort in the right upper stomach area)
Protein in urine
Wound healing problems

introduction:
Introduction About CELDAZ 100MG INJECTION

CELDAZ 100MG INJECTION contains Dacarbazine which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer Agents. It is used to manage certain types of skin cancer (such as metastatic melanoma) and lymph cancer (such as Hodgkin’s disease). It can also be used in the management of soft tissue sarcoma (cancer of connective tissues).

Before receiving CELDAZ 100MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have low WBC and platelet counts in blood or currently receiving radiotherapy as a precaution. Avoid consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with this medicine.

CELDAZ 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. Both men and women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with this medicine and until 6 months after the last dose.

The common side effects associated with the use of CELDAZ 100MG INJECTION are nausea, vomiting, flu-like symptoms, nerve damage and low RBC, WBC and platelet counts causing tiredness, pale skin, increased infections, fever, sore throat, chills and increased bleeding or bruising. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects troubles you.
uses: Soft tissue sarcoma (cancer of connective tissues passing between muscles, fat, blood vessels and supporting tissues)
usesDetails:
Uses Of CELDAZ 100MG INJECTION

It is used in the management of:

Skin cancer (metastatic melanoma)
Lymph cancer (Hodgkin’s disease)

mechanismOfAction:
How CELDAZ 100MG INJECTION Works

CELDAZ 100MG INJECTION is an anticancer medication. It works by damaging the cellular genetic material (DNA). This interferes with the functions of DNA and stops cancer cells from multiplying. Therefore, it stops the multiplication of abnormal cell division within the body and decreases cancer progression.
usageDetails:
How to use CELDAZ 100MG INJECTION

CELDAZ 100MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor specialized in oncology or haematology into the vein (intravenously).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DOXOGET 10 INJECTION

DOXOGET 10 INJECTION contains Doxorubicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used to manage certain types of cancers. It is used either alone or along with other anti-cancer medicines.

Cancer is a disease in which some of the cells of the body grow uncontrollably and spread to other parts of the body.

Before receiving DOXOGET 10 INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had heart disease, either before or during radiotherapy, had or having live or live-attenuated vaccinations, are currently taking or have recently taken Trastuzumab (used in the management of certain cancers).

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Consult your doctor during breast-feeding before starting management with this medicine as it may pass through the breast milk and possibly harm your child. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

The most common side effects of DOXOGET 10 INJECTION are infection, lack of appetite, inflammation in the mouth, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, reddening, swelling, pain, numbness and tingling in the palms and feet may also occur whilst being managed with this medicine.

Hair loss is very common and may be quite severe, beard growth may stop in men, fever, feeling weak, chills, abnormal ECG (electrical trace of the heart) results, raised levels of liver enzymes (as detected by a blood test) can determine if the medicine is having an abnormal effect on your liver, weight increased in patients with early breast cancer.
uses: Used to manage certain types of cancer
usesDetails:
Uses Of DOXOGET 10 INJECTION
Used to manage certain types of cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How DOXOGET 10 INJECTION Works

DOXOGET 10 INJECTION works by suppressing the activity of an enzyme (topoisomerase II) involved in the DNA multiplication of the cancer cells. On the other hand, this also forms harmful chemicals (free radicals) which cause damage to the DNA. This slowdown the growth of cancer cells and eventually works against them.
usageDetails:
How to use DOXOGET 10 INJECTION

DOXOGET 10 INJECTION will be administered intravenously (IV) into the vein by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About ZICARB 500MG INJECTION 50ML

ZICARB 500MG INJECTION 50ML contains Dacarbazine which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer Agents. It is used to manage certain types of skin cancer (such as metastatic melanoma) and lymph cancer (such as Hodgkin’s disease). It can also be used in the management of soft tissue sarcoma (cancer of connective tissues).

Before receiving ZICARB 500MG INJECTION 50ML inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have low WBC and platelet counts in blood or currently receiving radiotherapy as a precaution. Avoid consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with this medicine.

ZICARB 500MG INJECTION 50ML is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. Both men and women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with this medicine and until 6 months after the last dose.

The common side effects associated with the use of ZICARB 500MG INJECTION 50ML are nausea, vomiting, flu-like symptoms, nerve damage and low RBC, WBC and platelet counts causing tiredness, pale skin, increased infections, fever, sore throat, chills and increased bleeding or bruising. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects troubles you.

How ZICARB 500MG INJECTION 50ML Works

ZICARB 500MG INJECTION 50ML is an anticancer medication. It works by damaging the cellular genetic material (DNA). This interferes with the functions of DNA and stops cancer cells from multiplying. Therefore, it stops the multiplication of abnormal cell division within the body and decreases cancer progression.

introduction:
Introduction About REDITUX 500MG INJECTION

REDITUX 500MG INJECTION contains Rituximab which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer drugs. It is used to manage blood cancer (leukaemia) and lymph cancer (lymphoma). It can also be used to manage various auto-immune disease conditions such as rheumatoid arthritis, granulomatosis with polyangiitis or microscopic polyangiitis (inflammation of blood vessels) and pemphigus vulgaris (severe skin blistering and peeling especially on the mouth, nose, throat, eyes and genitals).

It is mostly used in combination with other cytotoxic anticancer agents to achieve better results. It is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 6 months or older). REDITUX 500MG INJECTION will be administered to you only by an oncologist or a trained professional into your vein (as intravenous infusion).

Before receiving REDITUX 500MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any heart problems (such as chest pain, heart attack, heart failure or abnormal heartbeat). You must also inform your doctor if you currently have or previously had hepatitis B infection or any other mild infections (including minor cough and cold) as a precaution.

REDITUX 500MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. Both men and women receiving REDITUX 500MG INJECTION must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with REDITUX 500MG INJECTION.

The most common side effects of receiving this medicine are fever, chills, skin rashes with itching, shortness of breath and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

name: Lipodox Injection 25ml
introduction:
Introduction About LIPODOX INJECTION

LIPODOX INJECTION contains Doxorubicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used to manage certain types of cancers. It is used either alone or along with other anti-cancer medicines.

Cancer is a disease in which some of the cells of the body grow uncontrollably and spread to other parts of the body.

Before receiving LIPODOX INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had heart disease, either before or during radiotherapy, had or having live or live-attenuated vaccinations, are currently taking or have recently taken Trastuzumab (used in the management of certain cancers).

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Consult your doctor during breast-feeding before starting management with this medicine as it may pass through the breast milk and possibly harm your child. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

The most common side effects of LIPODOX INJECTION are infection, lack of appetite, inflammation in the mouth, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, reddening, swelling, pain, numbness and tingling in the palms and feet may also occur whilst being managed with this medicine.

Hair loss is very common and may be quite severe, beard growth may stop in men, fever, feeling weak, chills, abnormal ECG (electrical trace of the heart) results, raised levels of liver enzymes (as detected by a blood test) can determine if the medicine is having an abnormal effect on your liver, weight increased in patients with early breast cancer.
uses: Used to manage certain types of cancer
usesDetails:
Uses Of LIPODOX INJECTION
Used to manage certain types of cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How LIPODOX INJECTION Works

LIPODOX INJECTION works by suppressing the activity of an enzyme (topoisomerase II) involved in the DNA multiplication of the cancer cells. On the other hand, this also forms harmful chemicals (free radicals) which cause damage to the DNA. This slowdown the growth of cancer cells and eventually works against them.
usageDetails:
How to use LIPODOX INJECTION

LIPODOX INJECTION will be administered intravenously (IV) into the vein by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: DASATIB 100 Tablet 30's
introduction:
Introduction About DASATIB 100 TABLET

DASATIB 100 TABLET contains Dasatinib which belongs to the group of medicines called Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors. It is used to manage cancers of blood and bone marrow (such as chronic myeloid leukaemia (CML) and philadelphia chromosome positive (Ph+) acute lymphoblastic leukaemia) in adults, adolescents and in children (aged 1 year or above).

It is primarily used in patients when management with conventional therapies is not suitable or fails to provide adequate response.   

Leukaemia is the cancer of white blood cells. It is caused due to abnormal growth and multiplication of blood cells within the bone marrow. It is characterized by severe tiredness, breathlessness, increased bleeding tendency, tiredness, anemia, night sweats, fever, chills, frequent infections and weight loss.

During management with DASATIB 100 TABLET your doctor will closely monitor your health condition through several blood tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking DASATIB 100 TABLET as it may increase the risk of side effects.

Before taking DASATIB 100 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have or at risk of developing hepatitis C infection as a precaution.

Avoid concomitant use of antacids or any stomach medicines along with DASATIB 100 TABLET. Leave a time gap of at least 2 hours between the medicines. DASATIB 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women.

Men and women taking DASATIB 100 TABLET must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with DASATIB 100 TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking DASATIB 100 TABLET are increased bleeding tendency, increased infections, feeling tired or weak, nausea, vomiting, hair loss, mouth ulcers, changes in taste, inflammation of the food pipe or stomach, muscle pain or spasm, skin rashes, headache, dizziness and weight loss. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Cancers of blood and bone marrow (such as chronic myeloid leukaemia and philadelphia chromosome positive (Ph+) acute lymphoblastic leukaemia)
usesDetails:
Uses Of DASATIB 100 TABLET

It is used in adults, adolescents and in children (aged 1 year or above) to manage:

Cancers of blood and bone marrow (such as chronic myeloid leukaemia and philadelphia chromosome positive (Ph+) acute lymphoblastic leukaemia)
mechanismOfAction:
How DASATIB 100 TABLET Works

DASATIB 100 TABLET is an anti-cancer medicine. It works by blocking the actions of certain proteins (such as BCR-ABL, Src kinase, etc.) in the body that triggers cancer formation. As a result, it reduces abnormal growth and multiplication of cancer cells in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use DASATIB 100 TABLET

Take DASATIB 100 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without meals. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Try to take DASATIB 100 TABLET at the same time each day. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking DASATIB 100 TABLET unless advised by your doctor.

Introduction About I DOX 50MG INJECTION

I DOX 50MG INJECTION contains Doxorubicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used to manage certain types of cancers. It is used either alone or along with other anti-cancer medicines.

Cancer is a disease in which some of the cells of the body grow uncontrollably and spread to other parts of the body.

Before receiving I DOX 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had heart disease, either before or during radiotherapy, had or having live or live-attenuated vaccinations, are currently taking or have recently taken Trastuzumab (used in the management of certain cancers).

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Consult your doctor during breast-feeding before starting management with this medicine as it may pass through the breast milk and possibly harm your child. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

The most common side effects of I DOX 50MG INJECTION are infection, lack of appetite, inflammation in the mouth, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, reddening, swelling, pain, numbness and tingling in the palms and feet may also occur whilst being managed with this medicine.

Hair loss is very common and may be quite severe, beard growth may stop in men, fever, feeling weak, chills, abnormal ECG (electrical trace of the heart) results, raised levels of liver enzymes (as detected by a blood test) can determine if the medicine is having an abnormal effect on your liver, weight increased in patients with early breast cancer.

mechanismOfAction:
How I DOX 50MG INJECTION Works

I DOX 50MG INJECTION works by suppressing the activity of an enzyme (topoisomerase II) involved in the DNA multiplication of the cancer cells. On the other hand, this also forms harmful chemicals (free radicals) which cause damage to the DNA. This slowdown the growth of cancer cells and eventually works against them.

I DOX 50MG INJECTION will be administered intravenously (IV) into the vein by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Gliotem 100mg Capsule 1'S
introduction:
Introduction About GLIOTEM 100MG CAPSULE

GLIOTEM 100MG CAPSULE contains Temozolomide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antineoplastic agents. It is used for specific forms of brain tumours in adults with newly diagnosed glioblastoma multiforme, which is used first together with radiotherapy as a concomitant phase of therapy and then used alone as a monotherapy. It is also used in children (above 3 years) and adults to manage malignant gliomas, such as glioblastoma multiforme or anaplastic astrocytoma, if they return or get worse after standard management.

Glioblastoma multiforme is an aggressive type of cancer that affects the brain or spinal cord and is generally characterized by symptoms such as headache, nausea, drowsiness, blurred vision, personality changes, and seizures.

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to take liver function tests to assess the hepatotoxicity and function of your liver. Before taking GLIOTEM 100MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had a hepatitis B infection (serious liver infection).

GLIOTEM 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have certain kinds of blood cells that are severely reduced, such as white blood cells and platelet count. GLIOTEM 100MG CAPSULE should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary and not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. It is not recommended for use in children below 3 years of age and should be used with caution in children and adolescents (from 3 to 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking GLIOTEM 100MG CAPSULE. The most common side effects of taking GLIOTEM 100MG CAPSULE are loss of appetite, difficulty while speaking, headache, vomiting, nausea, diarrhea, and constipation. Consult and inform your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.

Malignant glioma, such as glioblastoma multiforme or anaplastic astrocytoma (in adults and children)

name: HERTAB Tablet 30's
introduction:
Introduction About HERTAB TABLET

HERTAB TABLET contains Lapatinib which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer agents. It is used to manage metastatic breast cancer (cancer that has been spread to other parts of the body from breast). It is mostly used in combination with other anticancer or hormonal medicines (such as capecitabine, trastuzumab or anastrozole) to achieve better results.

HERTAB TABLET can be taken either one hour before or one hour after food. During management with HERTAB TABLET, your doctor will periodically monitor your heart, liver, kidney and lung functions as a precaution.

Before taking HERTAB TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diarrhea before taking this medicine.

Do not take HERTAB TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking HERTAB TABLET are nausea, vomiting, weakness, indigestion, constipation, sore mouth, trouble sleeping, back pain, joint pain, headache, hot flushes, hair loss, nail disorder and abnormal heartbeat. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of HERTAB TABLET
Manage metastatic breast cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How HERTAB TABLET Works

HERTAB TABLET is an anticancer agent. It works by blocking the actions of certain cellular proteins (tyrosine kinase) that triggers cancer cell formation. It also blocks various downstream cell signalling pathways that triggers cancer growth within the body. As a result, it reduces cancer formation and manages its further growth within the body.
usageDetails:
How to use HERTAB TABLET

Take HERTAB TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. HERTAB TABLET can be taken either one hour before or one hour after food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take HERTAB TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor to achieve better results.

name: Xpreza 100mg Injection 1'S
introduction:
Introduction About XPREZA 100MG INJECTION

XPREZA 100MG INJECTION contains Azacitidine which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer agents. It is used in adults in the management of all sub-types of myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS, a group of cancers associated with blood and bone marrow), and certain types of blood cancer known as chronic myelomonocytic leukaemia (CMML) and acute myeloid leukaemia (AML).

CMML is a type of blood cancer where the bone marrow releases an excess amount of monocytes (a type of blood cell) into the blood stream, whereas in AML, the bone marrow releases an excess amount of immature white blood cells. Both are characterized by recurrent infections, fever, tiredness, and increased bleeding or bruising.

XPREZA 100MG INJECTION is typically used in adults who cannot undergo stem cell transplantation. Before receiving XPREZA 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney, or heart problems.

XPREZA 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. Both men and women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with this medicine. Men may seek advice on sperm preservation, if necessary, prior to therapy with this medicine.

The most common side effects of receiving XPREZA 100MG INJECTION are increased bleeding, increased infections, tiredness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, loss of appetite, stomach pain, weakness, pain and redness at the site of injection, sore nose and throat, cold sores, headache, dizziness, trouble sleeping, weight loss, ulcers of the mouth or tongue, and hair loss. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: All sub-types of myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS; a group of cancers associated with blood and bone marrow)
Chronic myelomonocytic leukaemia (CMML; blood cancer of monocytes)
Acute myeloid leukaemia (AML; blood cancer of the WBC)
usesDetails:
Uses Of XPREZA 100MG INJECTION

It is used by adults to manage:

All sub-types of myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS; a group of cancers associated with blood and bone marrow)

mechanismOfAction:
How XPREZA 100MG INJECTION Works

XPREZA 100MG INJECTION is an anticancer medication. It works by blocking the actions of certain enzymes (DNA/RNA methyltransferase) within the cancer cells that are required for the cells to grow and multiply. It also reduces the production of new genetic material (RNA and DNA) within the cells. As a result, it manages abnormal cell division within the body, slows down the growth of cancer cells, and helps the bone marrow produce normal blood cells.
usageDetails:
How to use XPREZA 100MG INJECTION

XPREZA 100MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse beneath the skin (subcutaneously) of your thighs, arms, or abdomen.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TRUMAB INFUSION

TRUMAB INFUSION contains Trastuzumab which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer drugs. It is used to manage breast cancer and stomach cancer. It can be used either alone or in combination with other anticancer drugs (such as paclitaxel, cisplatin, docetaxel, 5-fluorouracil, capecitabine) or hormonal drugs (such as tamoxifen, anastrozole) to achieve better results.

TRUMAB INFUSION will be administered to you only by an oncologist or by a trained professional into your vein or beneath the skin. It is suitable for use in patients with high levels of human epidermal growth factor 2 (HER2) or hormone receptor positive metastatic breast cancer (cancer this is more sensitive for hormonal changes).

Before receiving TRUMAB INFUSION inform your doctor if you have any heart problems (such as heart attack, heart valve disease, or abnormal heartbeat). You must also inform your doctor if you have hypertension as a precaution.

TRUMAB INFUSION is not recommended for use in patients with breathing difficulties. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. Both men and women receiving TRUMAB INFUSION must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with TRUMAB INFUSION.

The most common side effects of receiving this medicine are increased infections, sore throat, mouth ulcers, skin rashes, nausea, stomach upset, lack of sleep, weight loss, tingling and numbness of hands and feet, muscle pain, joint pain, hair loss, shakiness and increased sweating. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRUMAB INFUSION

Breast cancer (early and advanced)
Stomach cancer (advanced)
mechanismOfAction:
How TRUMAB INFUSION Works

TRUMAB INFUSION is a monoclonal antibody. It works by blocking the actions of certain cellular proteins (HER2) that triggers cancer cell formation. It also blocks various downstream cell signalling pathways that triggers cancer growth within the body. As a result, it reduces cancer formation and manages its further growth within the body.

TRUMAB INFUSION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously) or beneath the skin (subcutaneously).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CABOLONG 60 TABLET

CABOLONG 60 TABLET contains Cabozantinib, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer drugs. It is used in adults to manage advanced kidney cancer. It can also be used in the management of liver cancer and advanced thyroid cancer when management with other conventional cancer medicines (such as sorafenib) and radiotherapy is not responding appropriately.

Take CABOLONG 60 TABLET on an empty stomach. You should not eat anything for at least 2 hours before and for 1 hour after taking the medicine. Before taking CABOLONG 60 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems.

You must also inform your doctor if you have high blood pressure, thyroid problems, inflammatory bowel diseases, abnormal bulging or tears in blood vessels, a recent history of blood clot formation, a stroke, or a heart attack, as a precaution.

During management with CABOLONG 60 TABLET, it is important for you to practice good oral hygiene. You must also inform your dentist about this medicine if you need to visit the dentist regularly.

Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking CABOLONG 60 TABLET, as it may increase the risk of side effects. CABOLONG 60 TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women.

Men and women taking CABOLONG 60 TABLET must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with CABOLONG 60 TABLET. Men may also seek advice on sperm preservation, if necessary, prior to therapy with this medicine.

The most common side effects of taking CABOLONG 60 TABLET are nausea, vomiting, stomach upset, skin rashes, blisters, and pain in the hands or soles of the feet, weight loss, altered taste sensation, tiredness, weakness, sore mouth, throat, and tongue, fistulas, and piles. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
usesDetails:

Advanced kidney cancer

mechanismOfAction:
How CABOLONG 60 TABLET Works

CABOLONG 60 TABLET is an anti-cancer medicine. It works by blocking the actions of certain proteins (such as receptor tyrosine kinases) in the body that trigger cancer formation. As a result, it manages abnormal cell division within the body and slows down the growth of cancer cells in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use CABOLONG 60 TABLET

Take CABOLONG 60 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. CABOLONG 60 TABLET should not be taken with food. You should not eat anything for at least 2 hours before and for 1 hour after taking the medicine.

Try to take CABOLONG 60 TABLET at the same time each day. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight, and health condition. Do not stop taking CABOLONG 60 TABLET unless advised by your doctor.

Introduction About ONCODOX PEG 2MG INJECTION

ONCODOX PEG 2MG INJECTION contains Doxorubicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used to manage certain types of cancers. It is used either alone or along with other anti-cancer medicines.

Cancer is a disease in which some of the cells of the body grow uncontrollably and spread to other parts of the body.

Before receiving ONCODOX PEG 2MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had heart disease, either before or during radiotherapy, had or having live or live-attenuated vaccinations, are currently taking or have recently taken Trastuzumab (used in the management of certain cancers).

introduction:
Introduction About CARBOTERO 150MG INJECTION

CARBOTERO 150MG INJECTION contains Carboplatin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used to manage advanced ovarian cancer and small-cell lung cancer. It is generally used in combination with other anti-cancer medicines to achieve better results.

Advanced ovarian cancer is a cancer that originates in the ovary and spreads to other parts of the body and small cell lung cancer is cancer that occurs in the tissues of the lungs. It is caused mainly by smoking and is characterized by symptoms such as chest pain, coughing with blood, shortness of breath, tiredness, and weight loss.

Before receiving CARBOTERO 150MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have a fever or low blood counts before receiving CARBOTERO 150MG INJECTION. CARBOTERO 150MG INJECTION should not be used by pregnant or breastfeeding women.

Men receiving CARBOTERO 150MG INJECTION must not father a child during management with CARBOTERO 150MG INJECTION and up to six months after stopping the therapy. Both men and women receiving CARBOTERO 150MG INJECTION must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with CARBOTERO 150MG INJECTION.

The use of CARBOTERO 150MG INJECTION may cause an abnormal decrease in total blood counts. It may also cause nausea, vomiting, mouth sores, hearing loss, loss of taste, tingling or numbness of body parts, increased serum creatinine levels, difficulty passing urine, increased bilirubin levels in the blood, and changes in vision.

To avoid this, your doctor will closely monitor your blood count, liver functions, kidney functions, nerve functions, and ear functions. However, consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Advanced ovarian cancer (cancer that originated in the ovary and spread to other parts of the body)
usesDetails:

It is used either alone or in combination with other anticancer medicines to manage:

Advanced ovarian cancer (cancer that originated in the ovary and spread to other parts of the body)
Small cell lung carcinoma (lung cancer)
mechanismOfAction:
How CARBOTERO 150MG INJECTION Works

CARBOTERO 150MG INJECTION is an anticancer medicine. It acts by damaging the genetic material (DNA and RNA) of the cancer cells. This inhibits the cancer cells from growing and multiplying within the body.

CARBOTERO 150MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DASATIB 50 TABLET

DASATIB 50 TABLET contains Dasatinib which belongs to the group of medicines called Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors. It is used to manage cancers of blood and bone marrow (such as chronic myeloid leukaemia (CML) and philadelphia chromosome positive (Ph+) acute lymphoblastic leukaemia) in adults, adolescents and in children (aged 1 year or above).

It is primarily used in patients when management with conventional therapies is not suitable or fails to provide adequate response.   

Leukaemia is the cancer of white blood cells. It is caused due to abnormal growth and multiplication of blood cells within the bone marrow. It is characterized by severe tiredness, breathlessness, increased bleeding tendency, tiredness, anemia, night sweats, fever, chills, frequent infections and weight loss.

During management with DASATIB 50 TABLET your doctor will closely monitor your health condition through several blood tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking DASATIB 50 TABLET as it may increase the risk of side effects.

Before taking DASATIB 50 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have or at risk of developing hepatitis C infection as a precaution.

Avoid concomitant use of antacids or any stomach medicines along with DASATIB 50 TABLET. Leave a time gap of at least 2 hours between the medicines. DASATIB 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women.

Men and women taking DASATIB 50 TABLET must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with DASATIB 50 TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking DASATIB 50 TABLET are increased bleeding tendency, increased infections, feeling tired or weak, nausea, vomiting, hair loss, mouth ulcers, changes in taste, inflammation of the food pipe or stomach, muscle pain or spasm, skin rashes, headache, dizziness and weight loss. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Cancers of blood and bone marrow (such as chronic myeloid leukaemia and philadelphia chromosome positive (Ph+) acute lymphoblastic leukaemia)
usesDetails:
Uses Of DASATIB 50 TABLET

It is used in adults, adolescents and in children (aged 1 year or above) to manage:

mechanismOfAction:
How DASATIB 50 TABLET Works

DASATIB 50 TABLET is an anti-cancer medicine. It works by blocking the actions of certain proteins (such as BCR-ABL, Src kinase, etc.) in the body that triggers cancer formation. As a result, it reduces abnormal growth and multiplication of cancer cells in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use DASATIB 50 TABLET

Take DASATIB 50 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without meals. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Try to take DASATIB 50 TABLET at the same time each day. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking DASATIB 50 TABLET unless advised by your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About TRABEC 1MG INJECTION

TRABEC 1MG INJECTION is a combination of Trabectedin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer medicines. It is used for the management of advanced soft tissue sarcoma when previous medicines have been unsuccessful, or the patients are unsuited to receiving them.

It is also used in combination with pegylated liposomal doxorubicin (another anti-cancer medicine) for the management of patients with ovarian cancer that has come back after at least 1 previous therapy and are not resistant to anti-cancer medicines containing platinum compounds.

TRABEC 1MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you have severe liver, kidney, or heart disease. Inform your doctor if you have any kidney disease, liver disease, heart problems, or history of heart problems, Left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) under the lower limit of normal.

TRABEC 1MG INJECTION should not be used during pregnancy or in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor for advice. TRABEC 1MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children under 18 years of age with pediatric sarcomas. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of receiving TRABEC 1MG INJECTION are tiredness, difficulty breathing and coughing, pain in your back, excess of fluid in the body (oedema), bruises more easily, nose bleeds, increased risk of infections, fever, loss of appetite, nausea or vomiting, abdominal pain, diarrhea or constipation, and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Management of advanced soft tissue sarcoma

Management of advanced soft tissue sarcoma
mechanismOfAction:
How TRABEC 1MG INJECTION Works

TRABEC 1MG INJECTION works by inhibiting the tumor cells from multiplying.
usageDetails:
How to use TRABEC 1MG INJECTION

TRABEC 1MG INJECTION will be administered only by a doctor or a nurse into the veins as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CABOTIB 20 TABLET

CABOTIB 20 TABLET contains Cabozantinib, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer drugs. It is used in adults to manage advanced kidney cancer. It can also be used in the management of liver cancer and advanced thyroid cancer when management with other conventional cancer medicines (such as sorafenib) and radiotherapy is not responding appropriately.

Take CABOTIB 20 TABLET on an empty stomach. You should not eat anything for at least 2 hours before and for 1 hour after taking the medicine. Before taking CABOTIB 20 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems.

You must also inform your doctor if you have high blood pressure, thyroid problems, inflammatory bowel diseases, abnormal bulging or tears in blood vessels, a recent history of blood clot formation, a stroke, or a heart attack, as a precaution.

During management with CABOTIB 20 TABLET, it is important for you to practice good oral hygiene. You must also inform your dentist about this medicine if you need to visit the dentist regularly.

Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking CABOTIB 20 TABLET, as it may increase the risk of side effects. CABOTIB 20 TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women.

Men and women taking CABOTIB 20 TABLET must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with CABOTIB 20 TABLET. Men may also seek advice on sperm preservation, if necessary, prior to therapy with this medicine.

The most common side effects of taking CABOTIB 20 TABLET are nausea, vomiting, stomach upset, skin rashes, blisters, and pain in the hands or soles of the feet, weight loss, altered taste sensation, tiredness, weakness, sore mouth, throat, and tongue, fistulas, and piles. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CABOTIB 20 TABLET

It is used by adults to manage:

Advanced kidney cancer
Liver cancer
Advanced thyroid cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How CABOTIB 20 TABLET Works

CABOTIB 20 TABLET is an anti-cancer medicine. It works by blocking the actions of certain proteins (such as receptor tyrosine kinases) in the body that trigger cancer formation. As a result, it manages abnormal cell division within the body and slows down the growth of cancer cells in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use CABOTIB 20 TABLET

Take CABOTIB 20 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. CABOTIB 20 TABLET should not be taken with food. You should not eat anything for at least 2 hours before and for 1 hour after taking the medicine.

Try to take CABOTIB 20 TABLET at the same time each day. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight, and health condition. Do not stop taking CABOTIB 20 TABLET unless advised by your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About GEMTAZ 1GM INJECTION

GEMTAZ 1GM INJECTION contains Gemcitabine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimetabolites. GEMTAZ 1GM INJECTION is used in the management of non-small cell lung cancer (alone or combined with cisplatin), pancreatic cancer, breast cancer (with paclitaxel), ovarian cancer (with carboplatin) and bladder cancer (with cisplatin).

Cancer is a disease in which there is uncontrollable growth of some of the body’s cells that spread to other parts of the body. During GEMTAZ 1GM INJECTION management, your doctor might ask you to take certain blood tests to check your blood cell count, kidney function or liver function.

Avoid drinking alcohol during GEMTAZ 1GM INJECTION management as it can make you feel sleepy. Before receiving GEMTAZ 1GM INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or are going to have radiotherapy, have been vaccinated recently or if you have any liver, kidney or heart diseases.

GEMTAZ 1GM INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women, breastfeeding women, children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before receiving it.

The most common side effects of receiving GEMTAZ 1GM INJECTION are vomiting, constipation, hair loss, poor appetite, headache, insomnia, cough, itching, sweating, etc. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms or side effects bother you.

introduction:
Introduction About DASANIA 70 TABLET

DASANIA 70 TABLET contains Dasatinib which belongs to the group of medicines called Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors. It is used to manage cancers of blood and bone marrow (such as chronic myeloid leukaemia (CML) and philadelphia chromosome positive (Ph+) acute lymphoblastic leukaemia) in adults, adolescents and in children (aged 1 year or above).

It is primarily used in patients when management with conventional therapies is not suitable or fails to provide adequate response.   

Leukaemia is the cancer of white blood cells. It is caused due to abnormal growth and multiplication of blood cells within the bone marrow. It is characterized by severe tiredness, breathlessness, increased bleeding tendency, tiredness, anemia, night sweats, fever, chills, frequent infections and weight loss.

During management with DASANIA 70 TABLET your doctor will closely monitor your health condition through several blood tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking DASANIA 70 TABLET as it may increase the risk of side effects.

Before taking DASANIA 70 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have or at risk of developing hepatitis C infection as a precaution.

Avoid concomitant use of antacids or any stomach medicines along with DASANIA 70 TABLET. Leave a time gap of at least 2 hours between the medicines. DASANIA 70 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women.

Men and women taking DASANIA 70 TABLET must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with DASANIA 70 TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking DASANIA 70 TABLET are increased bleeding tendency, increased infections, feeling tired or weak, nausea, vomiting, hair loss, mouth ulcers, changes in taste, inflammation of the food pipe or stomach, muscle pain or spasm, skin rashes, headache, dizziness and weight loss. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Cancers of blood and bone marrow (such as chronic myeloid leukaemia and philadelphia chromosome positive (Ph+) acute lymphoblastic leukaemia)

It is used in adults, adolescents and in children (aged 1 year or above) to manage:

mechanismOfAction:
How DASANIA 70 TABLET Works

DASANIA 70 TABLET is an anti-cancer medicine. It works by blocking the actions of certain proteins (such as BCR-ABL, Src kinase, etc.) in the body that triggers cancer formation. As a result, it reduces abnormal growth and multiplication of cancer cells in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use DASANIA 70 TABLET

Take DASANIA 70 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without meals. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Try to take DASANIA 70 TABLET at the same time each day. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking DASANIA 70 TABLET unless advised by your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About STRIDOX 50MG INJECTION

STRIDOX 50MG INJECTION contains Doxorubicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used to manage certain types of cancers. It is used either alone or along with other anti-cancer medicines.

Cancer is a disease in which some of the cells of the body grow uncontrollably and spread to other parts of the body.

Before receiving STRIDOX 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had heart disease, either before or during radiotherapy, had or having live or live-attenuated vaccinations, are currently taking or have recently taken Trastuzumab (used in the management of certain cancers).

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Consult your doctor during breast-feeding before starting management with this medicine as it may pass through the breast milk and possibly harm your child. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

The most common side effects of STRIDOX 50MG INJECTION are infection, lack of appetite, inflammation in the mouth, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, reddening, swelling, pain, numbness and tingling in the palms and feet may also occur whilst being managed with this medicine.

Hair loss is very common and may be quite severe, beard growth may stop in men, fever, feeling weak, chills, abnormal ECG (electrical trace of the heart) results, raised levels of liver enzymes (as detected by a blood test) can determine if the medicine is having an abnormal effect on your liver, weight increased in patients with early breast cancer.
uses: Used to manage certain types of cancer
usesDetails:
Uses Of STRIDOX 50MG INJECTION
Used to manage certain types of cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How STRIDOX 50MG INJECTION Works

STRIDOX 50MG INJECTION works by suppressing the activity of an enzyme (topoisomerase II) involved in the DNA multiplication of the cancer cells. On the other hand, this also forms harmful chemicals (free radicals) which cause damage to the DNA. This slowdown the growth of cancer cells and eventually works against them.

How to use STRIDOX 50MG INJECTION

STRIDOX 50MG INJECTION will be administered intravenously (IV) into the vein by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About GROS 100MG INJECTION

GROS 100MG INJECTION contains Paclitaxel which belongs to a group of anti-cancer medicines called Taxanes. GROS 100MG INJECTION is used to manage ovarian and breast cancer as a first line of therapy and as a second line of management when platinum containing medicines (such as cisplatin) or anthracyclines are insufficient to manage the disease in affected individuals.

GROS 100MG INJECTION is also used to manage advanced NSCLC (non-small cell lung cancer) when surgery/radiation therapy is not suitable. The medicine is also indicated for use to manage AIDS-related Kaposi’s sarcoma when other managements (such as anthracyclines) are insufficient to manage the disease in affected individuals.

GROS 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to paclitaxel and polyoxyethylated castor oil. It is also not recommended for use in patients with few white blood cells count and serious & uncontrolled infection. The medicine is also not used in patients suffering from severe liver disease.

Before receiving GROS 100MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had previously received radiation to your chest and/or suffering from thrombocytopenia (low platelet count)/acute infections (such as herpes zoster, chickenpox, herpes), kidney problems (such as chronic kidney disease), liver problems (such as mild/moderate hepatic impairment) and/or heart problems (such as severe coronary artery disease, myocardial infarction and arrhythmias).

GROS 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use during pregnancy. Women of child-bearing potential should use effective contraception method while receiving GROS 100MG INJECTION which should be continued for next-6 months after completing the management. The medicine is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

GROS 100MG INJECTION is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The medicine can be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving GROS 100MG INJECTION are minor allergic reactions (such as flushing, rash, itching), shortness of breath, sore throat/mouth ulcers, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting and/or loss of hair. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

How GROS 100MG INJECTION Works

GROS 100MG INJECTION works by interfering with the microtubule structures in the cell (substance which aids cancer cells to divide and multiply) thus inhibiting the growth of cancer cells and managing its spread in affected individuals.

introduction:
Introduction About DASLEMIA 50 TABLET

DASLEMIA 50 TABLET contains Dasatinib which belongs to the group of medicines called Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors. It is used to manage cancers of blood and bone marrow (such as chronic myeloid leukaemia (CML) and philadelphia chromosome positive (Ph+) acute lymphoblastic leukaemia) in adults, adolescents and in children (aged 1 year or above).

It is primarily used in patients when management with conventional therapies is not suitable or fails to provide adequate response.   

Leukaemia is the cancer of white blood cells. It is caused due to abnormal growth and multiplication of blood cells within the bone marrow. It is characterized by severe tiredness, breathlessness, increased bleeding tendency, tiredness, anemia, night sweats, fever, chills, frequent infections and weight loss.

During management with DASLEMIA 50 TABLET your doctor will closely monitor your health condition through several blood tests to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking DASLEMIA 50 TABLET as it may increase the risk of side effects.

Before taking DASLEMIA 50 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have or at risk of developing hepatitis C infection as a precaution.

Avoid concomitant use of antacids or any stomach medicines along with DASLEMIA 50 TABLET. Leave a time gap of at least 2 hours between the medicines. DASLEMIA 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women.

Men and women taking DASLEMIA 50 TABLET must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with DASLEMIA 50 TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking DASLEMIA 50 TABLET are increased bleeding tendency, increased infections, feeling tired or weak, nausea, vomiting, hair loss, mouth ulcers, changes in taste, inflammation of the food pipe or stomach, muscle pain or spasm, skin rashes, headache, dizziness and weight loss. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Cancers of blood and bone marrow (such as chronic myeloid leukaemia and philadelphia chromosome positive (Ph+) acute lymphoblastic leukaemia)

It is used in adults, adolescents and in children (aged 1 year or above) to manage:

mechanismOfAction:
How DASLEMIA 50 TABLET Works

DASLEMIA 50 TABLET is an anti-cancer medicine. It works by blocking the actions of certain proteins (such as BCR-ABL, Src kinase, etc.) in the body that triggers cancer formation. As a result, it reduces abnormal growth and multiplication of cancer cells in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use DASLEMIA 50 TABLET

Take DASLEMIA 50 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without meals. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Try to take DASLEMIA 50 TABLET at the same time each day. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking DASLEMIA 50 TABLET unless advised by your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About PEGSTIM 6MG INJECTION

PEGSTIM 6MG INJECTION contains Pegfilgrastim which belongs to the group of medicines called Colony stimulating factors. It is used to manage the destruction of white blood cells (WBC) in blood that is caused due to chemotherapy. It reduces the occurrence of neutropenia (low WBC count in blood) and febrile neutropenia (low WBC count in blood with fever) among patients receiving chemotherapy.

Talk to your doctor before receiving PEGSTIM 6MG INJECTION if you have any problems in your lungs or with blood circulation. You must also inform your doctor if you are allergic to Pegfilgrastim or filgrastim or have breast cancer, lung cancer or anemia as a precaution

Inform your doctor before receiving PEGSTIM 6MG INJECTION if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of receiving PEGSTIM 6MG INJECTION are bone pain, nausea, headache, skin rashes, pain, redness and discomfort at the site of injection and muscle pain. Inform your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.
uses: Prevents the risk of neutropenia and febrile neutropenia (low WBC count in blood) that is caused due to chemotherapy
usesDetails:
Uses Of PEGSTIM 6MG INJECTION
Prevents the risk of neutropenia and febrile neutropenia (low WBC count in blood) that is caused due to chemotherapy
mechanismOfAction:
How PEGSTIM 6MG INJECTION Works

PEGSTIM 6MG INJECTION works by stimulating the bone marrow to produce more white blood cells. It also enhances the survival of the white blood cells by protecting it against the harmful effects of chemotherapy. This reduces the risk of neutropenia and its associated complications (such as fever, flu, and risk of infections) among patients receiving chemotherapy.
usageDetails:
How to use PEGSTIM 6MG INJECTION

PEGSTIM 6MG INJECTION should be administered beneath the skin (subcutaneously). It is either administered to you by a doctor or a nurse or can be self-administered if instructed by the doctor. Carefully follow the instructions given by your doctor in case of self-administration.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About BEVETEX 100 MG INJECTION

BEVETEX 100 MG INJECTION contains Paclitaxel which belongs to a group of anti-cancer medicines called Taxanes. BEVETEX 100 MG INJECTION is used to manage ovarian and breast cancer as a first line of therapy and as a second line of management when platinum containing medicines (such as cisplatin) or anthracyclines are insufficient to manage the disease in affected individuals.

BEVETEX 100 MG INJECTION is also used to manage advanced NSCLC (non-small cell lung cancer) when surgery/radiation therapy is not suitable. The medicine is also indicated for use to manage AIDS-related Kaposi’s sarcoma when other managements (such as anthracyclines) are insufficient to manage the disease in affected individuals.

BEVETEX 100 MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to paclitaxel and polyoxyethylated castor oil. It is also not recommended for use in patients with few white blood cells count and serious & uncontrolled infection. The medicine is also not used in patients suffering from severe liver disease.

Before receiving BEVETEX 100 MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had previously received radiation to your chest and/or suffering from thrombocytopenia (low platelet count)/acute infections (such as herpes zoster, chickenpox, herpes), kidney problems (such as chronic kidney disease), liver problems (such as mild/moderate hepatic impairment) and/or heart problems (such as severe coronary artery disease, myocardial infarction and arrhythmias).

BEVETEX 100 MG INJECTION is not recommended for use during pregnancy. Women of child-bearing potential should use effective contraception method while receiving BEVETEX 100 MG INJECTION which should be continued for next-6 months after completing the management. The medicine is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

BEVETEX 100 MG INJECTION is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The medicine can be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving BEVETEX 100 MG INJECTION are minor allergic reactions (such as flushing, rash, itching), shortness of breath, sore throat/mouth ulcers, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting and/or loss of hair. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How BEVETEX 100 MG INJECTION Works

BEVETEX 100 MG INJECTION works by interfering with the microtubule structures in the cell (substance which aids cancer cells to divide and multiply) thus inhibiting the growth of cancer cells and managing its spread in affected individuals.

introduction:
Introduction About ADRIAMYCIN RTU 50MG INJECTION

ADRIAMYCIN RTU 50MG INJECTION contains Doxorubicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used to manage certain types of cancers. It is used either alone or along with other anti-cancer medicines.

Cancer is a disease in which some of the cells of the body grow uncontrollably and spread to other parts of the body.

Before receiving ADRIAMYCIN RTU 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had heart disease, either before or during radiotherapy, had or having live or live-attenuated vaccinations, are currently taking or have recently taken Trastuzumab (used in the management of certain cancers).

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Consult your doctor during breast-feeding before starting management with this medicine as it may pass through the breast milk and possibly harm your child. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

The most common side effects of ADRIAMYCIN RTU 50MG INJECTION are infection, lack of appetite, inflammation in the mouth, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, reddening, swelling, pain, numbness and tingling in the palms and feet may also occur whilst being managed with this medicine.

Hair loss is very common and may be quite severe, beard growth may stop in men, fever, feeling weak, chills, abnormal ECG (electrical trace of the heart) results, raised levels of liver enzymes (as detected by a blood test) can determine if the medicine is having an abnormal effect on your liver, weight increased in patients with early breast cancer.
uses: Used to manage certain types of cancer
usesDetails:
Uses Of ADRIAMYCIN RTU 50MG INJECTION
Used to manage certain types of cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How ADRIAMYCIN RTU 50MG INJECTION Works

ADRIAMYCIN RTU 50MG INJECTION works by suppressing the activity of an enzyme (topoisomerase II) involved in the DNA multiplication of the cancer cells. On the other hand, this also forms harmful chemicals (free radicals) which cause damage to the DNA. This slowdown the growth of cancer cells and eventually works against them.

ADRIAMYCIN RTU 50MG INJECTION will be administered intravenously (IV) into the vein by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DACAREX 100MG INJECTION

DACAREX 100MG INJECTION contains Dacarbazine which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer Agents. It is used to manage certain types of skin cancer (such as metastatic melanoma) and lymph cancer (such as Hodgkin’s disease). It can also be used in the management of soft tissue sarcoma (cancer of connective tissues).

Before receiving DACAREX 100MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have low WBC and platelet counts in blood or currently receiving radiotherapy as a precaution. Avoid consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with this medicine.

DACAREX 100MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. Both men and women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with this medicine and until 6 months after the last dose.

The common side effects associated with the use of DACAREX 100MG INJECTION are nausea, vomiting, flu-like symptoms, nerve damage and low RBC, WBC and platelet counts causing tiredness, pale skin, increased infections, fever, sore throat, chills and increased bleeding or bruising. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects troubles you.
uses: Soft tissue sarcoma (cancer of connective tissues passing between muscles, fat, blood vessels and supporting tissues)

mechanismOfAction:
How DACAREX 100MG INJECTION Works

DACAREX 100MG INJECTION is an anticancer medication. It works by damaging the cellular genetic material (DNA). This interferes with the functions of DNA and stops cancer cells from multiplying. Therefore, it stops the multiplication of abnormal cell division within the body and decreases cancer progression.

DACAREX 100MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor specialized in oncology or haematology into the vein (intravenously).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About CAPETA NOVA 500MG TABLET

CAPETA NOVA 500MG TABLET contains capecitabine, which belongs to the group of medicines called antineoplastic agents. It is used in the management of abnormal growth of cells present in the colon, rectal, gastric, and breast regions. It may be used either alone or in combination with other medicines.

CAPETA NOVA 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe liver or kidney disease. CAPETA NOVA 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease, kidney disease, heart problems, brain disease or nerve damage, diabetes, or a history of eye problems. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

CAPETA NOVA 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

CAPETA NOVA 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use by children and adolescents. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

The most common side effects of taking CAPETA NOVA 500MG TABLET are abdominal pain, rash, dry or itchy skin, tiredness, and loss of appetite. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

Take CAPETA NOVA 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Take the medicine within 30 minutes after the end of a meal.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of CAPETA NOVA 500MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body surface area, and disease condition. Do not stop taking CAPETA NOVA 500MG TABLET unless your doctor has told you to.
