Have severely low levels of white cells or platelets in the blood (leukopenia, neutropenia, or thrombocytopenia)
Have complete DPD deficiency (do not have any activity of the enzyme dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (DPD)
Are being managed now or have been managed in the last 4 weeks for herpes zoster (chickenpox or shingles) with brivudine

Before taking CAPETA NOVA 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have a partial deficiency in the activity of the enzyme dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (DPD)
Have a family member who has a partial or complete deficiency of the enzyme dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (DPD)
Have a brain disease (Ex. cancer that has spread to the brain) or nerve damage (neuropathy)
Have a calcium imbalance or other electrolyte imbalances
Have diabetes
Cannot keep food or water in your body because of severe nausea and vomiting
Have a history of eye problems
Have diarrhea
Are dehydrated
Have a severe skin reaction

introduction:
Introduction About GEMCITE 200MG INJECTION

GEMCITE 200MG INJECTION contains Gemcitabine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimetabolites. GEMCITE 200MG INJECTION is used in the management of non-small cell lung cancer (alone or combined with cisplatin), pancreatic cancer, breast cancer (with paclitaxel), ovarian cancer (with carboplatin) and bladder cancer (with cisplatin).

Cancer is a disease in which there is uncontrollable growth of some of the body’s cells that spread to other parts of the body. During GEMCITE 200MG INJECTION management, your doctor might ask you to take certain blood tests to check your blood cell count, kidney function or liver function.

Avoid drinking alcohol during GEMCITE 200MG INJECTION management as it can make you feel sleepy. Before receiving GEMCITE 200MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or are going to have radiotherapy, have been vaccinated recently or if you have any liver, kidney or heart diseases.

GEMCITE 200MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women, breastfeeding women, children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before receiving it.

The most common side effects of receiving GEMCITE 200MG INJECTION are vomiting, constipation, hair loss, poor appetite, headache, insomnia, cough, itching, sweating, etc. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms or side effects bother you.

introduction:
Introduction About DOXORUBA 50MG INJECTION

DOXORUBA 50MG INJECTION contains Doxorubicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used to manage certain types of cancers. It is used either alone or along with other anti-cancer medicines.

Cancer is a disease in which some of the cells of the body grow uncontrollably and spread to other parts of the body.

Before receiving DOXORUBA 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had heart disease, either before or during radiotherapy, had or having live or live-attenuated vaccinations, are currently taking or have recently taken Trastuzumab (used in the management of certain cancers).

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Consult your doctor during breast-feeding before starting management with this medicine as it may pass through the breast milk and possibly harm your child. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

The most common side effects of DOXORUBA 50MG INJECTION are infection, lack of appetite, inflammation in the mouth, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, reddening, swelling, pain, numbness and tingling in the palms and feet may also occur whilst being managed with this medicine.

Hair loss is very common and may be quite severe, beard growth may stop in men, fever, feeling weak, chills, abnormal ECG (electrical trace of the heart) results, raised levels of liver enzymes (as detected by a blood test) can determine if the medicine is having an abnormal effect on your liver, weight increased in patients with early breast cancer.
uses: Used to manage certain types of cancer
usesDetails:
Uses Of DOXORUBA 50MG INJECTION
Used to manage certain types of cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How DOXORUBA 50MG INJECTION Works

DOXORUBA 50MG INJECTION works by suppressing the activity of an enzyme (topoisomerase II) involved in the DNA multiplication of the cancer cells. On the other hand, this also forms harmful chemicals (free radicals) which cause damage to the DNA. This slowdown the growth of cancer cells and eventually works against them.
usageDetails:
How to use DOXORUBA 50MG INJECTION

DOXORUBA 50MG INJECTION will be administered intravenously (IV) into the vein by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Taxotere 80mg Injection 4ml
introduction:
Introduction About TAXOTERE 80MG INJECTION

TAXOTERE 80MG INJECTION contains Docetaxel which belongs to the group of medicines called Taxoids. TAXOTERE 80MG INJECTION is used in the management of breast cancer, special forms of lung cancer (non-small cell lung cancer), prostate cancer, gastric (stomach) cancer and/or head and neck cancer in affected individuals.        

TAXOTERE 80MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to docetaxel. It is not recommended for use in patients with low number of white blood cells and in patients suffering from severe liver disease.   

Before receiving TAXOTERE 80MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are alcohol dependent, and/or suffering from epilepsy, heart and/or kidney disease.

TAXOTERE 80MG INJECTION is not recommended for use during pregnancy unless it is clearly necessary. Women of child-bearing potential should use effective contraception method to avoid getting pregnant while receiving TAXOTERE 80MG INJECTION. The medicine is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.  

TAXOTERE 80MG INJECTION should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) which is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.  

The most common side effects of receiving TAXOTERE 80MG INJECTION are infection, hair loss, headache, loss of appetite, indigestion, nausea, vomiting, and/or constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.6GM INJECTION

GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.6GM INJECTION contains Gemcitabine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimetabolites. GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.6GM INJECTION is used in the management of non-small cell lung cancer (alone or combined with cisplatin), pancreatic cancer, breast cancer (with paclitaxel), ovarian cancer (with carboplatin) and bladder cancer (with cisplatin).

Cancer is a disease in which there is uncontrollable growth of some of the body’s cells that spread to other parts of the body. During GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.6GM INJECTION management, your doctor might ask you to take certain blood tests to check your blood cell count, kidney function or liver function.

Avoid drinking alcohol during GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.6GM INJECTION management as it can make you feel sleepy. Before receiving GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.6GM INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or are going to have radiotherapy, have been vaccinated recently or if you have any liver, kidney or heart diseases.

GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.6GM INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women, breastfeeding women, children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before receiving it.

The most common side effects of receiving GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.6GM INJECTION are vomiting, constipation, hair loss, poor appetite, headache, insomnia, cough, itching, sweating, etc. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms or side effects bother you.

How GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.6GM INJECTION Works

GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.6GM INJECTION kills the dividing cancer cells by inhibition of their DNA (hereditary material) synthesis.

GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.6GM INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and surface area and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DECITEX 30 MG INJECTION

DECITEX 30 MG INJECTION contains Decitabine which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used in adults to manage myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS-group of cancers associated with blood and bone marrow) and acute myeloid leukemia (cancer of blood cells).

Before receiving DECITEX 30 MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have low RBC, WBC or platelet count in blood or currently have any infection as a precaution. DECITEX 30 MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. Both men and women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with this medicine. Men may seek advice on sperm preservation, if necessary, prior to the therapy with this medicine.

The most common side effects of receiving DECITEX 30 MG INJECTION are increased bleeding, increased infections, tiredness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, sore nose and throat, and ulcers of mouth or tongue. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Acute Myeloid Leukaemia (AML-blood cancer of WBC)
usesDetails:
Uses Of DECITEX 30 MG INJECTION

It is used in adults to manage:

Myelodysplastic Syndromes (MDS-group of cancers associated with blood and bone marrow)

Acute Myeloid Leukaemia (AML-blood cancer of WBC)
mechanismOfAction:
How DECITEX 30 MG INJECTION Works

DECITEX 30 MG INJECTION is an anticancer medication. It works by blocking the actions of certain enzymes (DNA/RNA methyltransferase) within the cancer cells that is required for the cells to grow and multiply. It also reduces the production of new genetic material (RNA and DNA) within the cells. As a result, it manages abnormal cell division within the body, slows down the growth of cancer cells and helps the bone marrow to produce normal blood cells.

DECITEX 30 MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously). Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: AZADUAL Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About AZADUAL INJECTION

AZADUAL INJECTION contains Azacitidine which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer agents. It is used in adults in the management of all sub-types of myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS, a group of cancers associated with blood and bone marrow), and certain types of blood cancer known as chronic myelomonocytic leukaemia (CMML) and acute myeloid leukaemia (AML).

CMML is a type of blood cancer where the bone marrow releases an excess amount of monocytes (a type of blood cell) into the blood stream, whereas in AML, the bone marrow releases an excess amount of immature white blood cells. Both are characterized by recurrent infections, fever, tiredness, and increased bleeding or bruising.

AZADUAL INJECTION is typically used in adults who cannot undergo stem cell transplantation. Before receiving AZADUAL INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver, kidney, or heart problems.

AZADUAL INJECTION is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. Both men and women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with this medicine. Men may seek advice on sperm preservation, if necessary, prior to therapy with this medicine.

The most common side effects of receiving AZADUAL INJECTION are increased bleeding, increased infections, tiredness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, loss of appetite, stomach pain, weakness, pain and redness at the site of injection, sore nose and throat, cold sores, headache, dizziness, trouble sleeping, weight loss, ulcers of the mouth or tongue, and hair loss. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: All sub-types of myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS; a group of cancers associated with blood and bone marrow)
Chronic myelomonocytic leukaemia (CMML; blood cancer of monocytes)
Acute myeloid leukaemia (AML; blood cancer of the WBC)
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How AZADUAL INJECTION Works

AZADUAL INJECTION is an anticancer medication. It works by blocking the actions of certain enzymes (DNA/RNA methyltransferase) within the cancer cells that are required for the cells to grow and multiply. It also reduces the production of new genetic material (RNA and DNA) within the cells. As a result, it manages abnormal cell division within the body, slows down the growth of cancer cells, and helps the bone marrow produce normal blood cells.
usageDetails:
How to use AZADUAL INJECTION

AZADUAL INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse beneath the skin (subcutaneously) of your thighs, arms, or abdomen.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: Farmorubicin RD 10mg Injection 1'S
introduction:
Introduction About FARMORUBICIN RD 10MG INJECTION

FARMORUBICIN RD 10MG INJECTION contains Epirubicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer agents. It is used to manage various types of cancer such as breast cancer, ovarian cancer, gastric cancer (stomach cancer), small cell lung cancer, head and neck cancer, liver cancer, blood cancer (leukemia), lymph cancer (lymphoma), pancreatic cancer and colorectal cancer (cancers of colon or rectum).  

It can also be used to manage cancers of soft tissues such as soft tissues sarcoma (cancer of the soft tissues that connects muscles, fats, blood vessels, nerves, tendons etc.) and helps to stop the occurrence of bladder cancer following surgeries (such as transurethral resection).

Before receiving FARMORUBICIN RD 10MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any severe infections, low blood count or any bladder problems (such as problems in passing urine, burning sensation while passing urine etc.) as a precaution.

FARMORUBICIN RD 10MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. Both men and women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with this medicine. Men may seek advice on sperm preservation, if necessary, prior to the therapy with this medicine.

The most common side effects of receiving FARMORUBICIN RD 10MG INJECTION are hair loss, red urine, increased infection, hot flashes, mouth ulcers, inflammation of oesophagus, nausea, vomiting (within first 24 hours), loss of appetite, bladder infection, burning sensation while passing urine and pain, redness and swelling at the site of injection. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Soft tissue sarcoma (cancer of the soft tissues that connects muscles, fats, blood vessels, nerves, tendons etc.) and manages bladder cancer following surgery (such as transurethral resection)

mechanismOfAction:
How FARMORUBICIN RD 10MG INJECTION Works

FARMORUBICIN RD 10MG INJECTION is an anticancer medication. It works by blocking the synthesis of genetic material (DNA and RNA) and certain essential proteins and enzymes which are required for the cells to grow and multiply. As a result, it stops abnormal cell division within the body, slows down the growth of cancer cells and eventually kills them.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Therefore, FARMORUBICIN RD 10MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy during the management and for at least 6.5 months after the last dose.
FARMORUBICIN RD 10MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in women who are breastfeeding. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
FARMORUBICIN RD 10MG INJECTION does not affect your ability to drive or handle any heavy tools or machines.

FARMORUBICIN RD 10MG INJECTION is not recommended to use in patients with severe kidney problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other mild kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.

FARMORUBICIN RD 10MG INJECTION is not recommended to use in patients with severe liver problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other mild liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
Talk to your doctor before receiving FARMORUBICIN RD 10MG INJECTION if you are allergic to Epirubicin.

FARMORUBICIN RD 10MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other mild heart problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
The safety and efficacy of FARMORUBICIN RD 10MG INJECTION have not been established in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
FARMORUBICIN RD 10MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.

Others

FARMORUBICIN RD 10MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have previously received high doses of similar anticancer medicines
Suffer from severely reduced number of blood cells
Have an acute severe infection
Have bladder cancer that has been spread until the bladder wall
Have urinary tract infection
Have pain or inflammation of the bladder
Have problems in emptying your bladder
Pass bloody urine
Have a contracted bladder

Inform your doctor, before receiving FARMORUBICIN RD 10MG INJECTION, if you:

Recently received any vaccine or plan to receive any vaccines
Recently had radiation therapy

name: GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.4gm Injection 140ml
introduction:
Introduction About GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.4GM INJECTION

GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.4GM INJECTION contains Gemcitabine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimetabolites. GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.4GM INJECTION is used in the management of non-small cell lung cancer (alone or combined with cisplatin), pancreatic cancer, breast cancer (with paclitaxel), ovarian cancer (with carboplatin) and bladder cancer (with cisplatin).

Cancer is a disease in which there is uncontrollable growth of some of the body’s cells that spread to other parts of the body. During GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.4GM INJECTION management, your doctor might ask you to take certain blood tests to check your blood cell count, kidney function or liver function.

Avoid drinking alcohol during GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.4GM INJECTION management as it can make you feel sleepy. Before receiving GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.4GM INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or are going to have radiotherapy, have been vaccinated recently or if you have any liver, kidney or heart diseases.

GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.4GM INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women, breastfeeding women, children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before receiving it.

The most common side effects of receiving GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.4GM INJECTION are vomiting, constipation, hair loss, poor appetite, headache, insomnia, cough, itching, sweating, etc. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms or side effects bother you.

introduction:
Introduction About FARMORUBICIN RTU 50MG INJECTION

FARMORUBICIN RTU 50MG INJECTION contains Epirubicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticancer agents. It is used to manage various types of cancer such as breast cancer, ovarian cancer, gastric cancer (stomach cancer), small cell lung cancer, head and neck cancer, liver cancer, blood cancer (leukemia), lymph cancer (lymphoma), pancreatic cancer and colorectal cancer (cancers of colon or rectum).  

It can also be used to manage cancers of soft tissues such as soft tissues sarcoma (cancer of the soft tissues that connects muscles, fats, blood vessels, nerves, tendons etc.) and helps to stop the occurrence of bladder cancer following surgeries (such as transurethral resection).

Before receiving FARMORUBICIN RTU 50MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any severe infections, low blood count or any bladder problems (such as problems in passing urine, burning sensation while passing urine etc.) as a precaution.

FARMORUBICIN RTU 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. Both men and women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with this medicine. Men may seek advice on sperm preservation, if necessary, prior to the therapy with this medicine.

The most common side effects of receiving FARMORUBICIN RTU 50MG INJECTION are hair loss, red urine, increased infection, hot flashes, mouth ulcers, inflammation of oesophagus, nausea, vomiting (within first 24 hours), loss of appetite, bladder infection, burning sensation while passing urine and pain, redness and swelling at the site of injection. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Soft tissue sarcoma (cancer of the soft tissues that connects muscles, fats, blood vessels, nerves, tendons etc.) and manages bladder cancer following surgery (such as transurethral resection)

Breast cancer

mechanismOfAction:
How FARMORUBICIN RTU 50MG INJECTION Works

FARMORUBICIN RTU 50MG INJECTION is an anticancer medication. It works by blocking the synthesis of genetic material (DNA and RNA) and certain essential proteins and enzymes which are required for the cells to grow and multiply. As a result, it stops abnormal cell division within the body, slows down the growth of cancer cells and eventually kills them.
usageDetails:
How to use FARMORUBICIN RTU 50MG INJECTION

FARMORUBICIN RTU 50MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (as an intravenous infusion) or into the bladder (intravesical administration).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: There is no proper information regarding the use of FARMORUBICIN RTU 50MG INJECTION in pregnant women. Animal studies have indicated harm to the growing offspring. Therefore, FARMORUBICIN RTU 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy during the management and for at least 6.5 months after the last dose.
FARMORUBICIN RTU 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in women who are breastfeeding. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
FARMORUBICIN RTU 50MG INJECTION does not affect your ability to drive or handle any heavy tools or machines.

FARMORUBICIN RTU 50MG INJECTION is not recommended to use in patients with severe kidney problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other mild kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.

FARMORUBICIN RTU 50MG INJECTION is not recommended to use in patients with severe liver problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other mild liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
Talk to your doctor before receiving FARMORUBICIN RTU 50MG INJECTION if you are allergic to Epirubicin.

FARMORUBICIN RTU 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other mild heart problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
The safety and efficacy of FARMORUBICIN RTU 50MG INJECTION have not been established in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
FARMORUBICIN RTU 50MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.

Others

FARMORUBICIN RTU 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have previously received high doses of similar anticancer medicines
Suffer from severely reduced number of blood cells
Have an acute severe infection
Have bladder cancer that has been spread until the bladder wall
Have urinary tract infection
Have pain or inflammation of the bladder
Have problems in emptying your bladder
Pass bloody urine
Have a contracted bladder

Inform your doctor, before receiving FARMORUBICIN RTU 50MG INJECTION, if you:

Recently received any vaccine or plan to receive any vaccines
Recently had radiation therapy

name: Gros 260mg Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About GROS 260MG INJECTION

GROS 260MG INJECTION contains Paclitaxel which belongs to a group of anti-cancer medicines called Taxanes. GROS 260MG INJECTION is used to manage ovarian and breast cancer as a first line of therapy and as a second line of management when platinum containing medicines (such as cisplatin) or anthracyclines are insufficient to manage the disease in affected individuals.

GROS 260MG INJECTION is also used to manage advanced NSCLC (non-small cell lung cancer) when surgery/radiation therapy is not suitable. The medicine is also indicated for use to manage AIDS-related Kaposi’s sarcoma when other managements (such as anthracyclines) are insufficient to manage the disease in affected individuals.

GROS 260MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to paclitaxel and polyoxyethylated castor oil. It is also not recommended for use in patients with few white blood cells count and serious & uncontrolled infection. The medicine is also not used in patients suffering from severe liver disease.

Before receiving GROS 260MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had previously received radiation to your chest and/or suffering from thrombocytopenia (low platelet count)/acute infections (such as herpes zoster, chickenpox, herpes), kidney problems (such as chronic kidney disease), liver problems (such as mild/moderate hepatic impairment) and/or heart problems (such as severe coronary artery disease, myocardial infarction and arrhythmias).

GROS 260MG INJECTION is not recommended for use during pregnancy. Women of child-bearing potential should use effective contraception method while receiving GROS 260MG INJECTION which should be continued for next-6 months after completing the management. The medicine is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

GROS 260MG INJECTION is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The medicine can be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving GROS 260MG INJECTION are minor allergic reactions (such as flushing, rash, itching), shortness of breath, sore throat/mouth ulcers, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting and/or loss of hair. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ADRIAMYCIN RTU 50MG INJECTION

ADRIAMYCIN RTU 50MG INJECTION contains Doxorubicin which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used to manage certain types of cancers. It is used either alone or along with other anti-cancer medicines.

Cancer is a disease in which some of the cells of the body grow uncontrollably and spread to other parts of the body.

Before receiving ADRIAMYCIN RTU 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had heart disease, either before or during radiotherapy, had or having live or live-attenuated vaccinations, are currently taking or have recently taken Trastuzumab (used in the management of certain cancers).

There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women. Consult your doctor during breast-feeding before starting management with this medicine as it may pass through the breast milk and possibly harm your child. Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

The most common side effects of ADRIAMYCIN RTU 50MG INJECTION are infection, lack of appetite, inflammation in the mouth, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, reddening, swelling, pain, numbness and tingling in the palms and feet may also occur whilst being managed with this medicine.

Hair loss is very common and may be quite severe, beard growth may stop in men, fever, feeling weak, chills, abnormal ECG (electrical trace of the heart) results, raised levels of liver enzymes (as detected by a blood test) can determine if the medicine is having an abnormal effect on your liver, weight increased in patients with early breast cancer.
uses: Used to manage certain types of cancer
usesDetails:
Uses Of ADRIAMYCIN RTU 50MG INJECTION
Used to manage certain types of cancer
mechanismOfAction:
How ADRIAMYCIN RTU 50MG INJECTION Works

ADRIAMYCIN RTU 50MG INJECTION works by suppressing the activity of an enzyme (topoisomerase II) involved in the DNA multiplication of the cancer cells. On the other hand, this also forms harmful chemicals (free radicals) which cause damage to the DNA. This slowdown the growth of cancer cells and eventually works against them.
usageDetails:
How to use ADRIAMYCIN RTU 50MG INJECTION

ADRIAMYCIN RTU 50MG INJECTION will be administered intravenously (IV) into the vein by your doctor or nurse. Your doctor will administer the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.2GM INJECTION

GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.2GM INJECTION contains Gemcitabine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimetabolites. GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.2GM INJECTION is used in the management of non-small cell lung cancer (alone or combined with cisplatin), pancreatic cancer, breast cancer (with paclitaxel), ovarian cancer (with carboplatin) and bladder cancer (with cisplatin).

Cancer is a disease in which there is uncontrollable growth of some of the body’s cells that spread to other parts of the body. During GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.2GM INJECTION management, your doctor might ask you to take certain blood tests to check your blood cell count, kidney function or liver function.

Avoid drinking alcohol during GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.2GM INJECTION management as it can make you feel sleepy. Before receiving GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.2GM INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or are going to have radiotherapy, have been vaccinated recently or if you have any liver, kidney or heart diseases.

GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.2GM INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women, breastfeeding women, children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before receiving it.

The most common side effects of receiving GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.2GM INJECTION are vomiting, constipation, hair loss, poor appetite, headache, insomnia, cough, itching, sweating, etc. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms or side effects bother you.

How GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.2GM INJECTION Works

GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.2GM INJECTION kills the dividing cancer cells by inhibition of their DNA (hereditary material) synthesis.

GEMTAZ INFUSMART 1.2GM INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and surface area and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DECITEX 50MG INJECTION

DECITEX 50MG INJECTION contains Decitabine which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used in adults to manage myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS-group of cancers associated with blood and bone marrow) and acute myeloid leukemia (cancer of blood cells).

Before receiving DECITEX 50MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have low RBC, WBC or platelet count in blood or currently have any infection as a precaution. DECITEX 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. Both men and women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with this medicine. Men may seek advice on sperm preservation, if necessary, prior to the therapy with this medicine.

The most common side effects of receiving DECITEX 50MG INJECTION are increased bleeding, increased infections, tiredness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, sore nose and throat, and ulcers of mouth or tongue. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Acute Myeloid Leukaemia (AML-blood cancer of WBC)
usesDetails:
Uses Of DECITEX 50MG INJECTION

It is used in adults to manage:

Myelodysplastic Syndromes (MDS-group of cancers associated with blood and bone marrow)

Acute Myeloid Leukaemia (AML-blood cancer of WBC)
mechanismOfAction:
How DECITEX 50MG INJECTION Works

DECITEX 50MG INJECTION is an anticancer medication. It works by blocking the actions of certain enzymes (DNA/RNA methyltransferase) within the cancer cells that is required for the cells to grow and multiply. It also reduces the production of new genetic material (RNA and DNA) within the cells. As a result, it manages abnormal cell division within the body, slows down the growth of cancer cells and helps the bone marrow to produce normal blood cells.
usageDetails:
How to use DECITEX 50MG INJECTION

DECITEX 50MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously). Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: CARBOTERO 450mg Injection 45ml
introduction:
Introduction About CARBOTERO 450MG INJECTION

CARBOTERO 450MG INJECTION contains Carboplatin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-cancer agents. It is used to manage advanced ovarian cancer and small-cell lung cancer. It is generally used in combination with other anti-cancer medicines to achieve better results.

Advanced ovarian cancer is a cancer that originates in the ovary and spreads to other parts of the body and small cell lung cancer is cancer that occurs in the tissues of the lungs. It is caused mainly by smoking and is characterized by symptoms such as chest pain, coughing with blood, shortness of breath, tiredness, and weight loss.

Before receiving CARBOTERO 450MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have a fever or low blood counts before receiving CARBOTERO 450MG INJECTION. CARBOTERO 450MG INJECTION should not be used by pregnant or breastfeeding women.

Men receiving CARBOTERO 450MG INJECTION must not father a child during management with CARBOTERO 450MG INJECTION and up to six months after stopping the therapy. Both men and women receiving CARBOTERO 450MG INJECTION must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with CARBOTERO 450MG INJECTION.

The use of CARBOTERO 450MG INJECTION may cause an abnormal decrease in total blood counts. It may also cause nausea, vomiting, mouth sores, hearing loss, loss of taste, tingling or numbness of body parts, increased serum creatinine levels, difficulty passing urine, increased bilirubin levels in the blood, and changes in vision.

To avoid this, your doctor will closely monitor your blood count, liver functions, kidney functions, nerve functions, and ear functions. However, consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Advanced ovarian cancer (cancer that originated in the ovary and spread to other parts of the body)
usesDetails:
Uses Of CARBOTERO 450MG INJECTION

It is used either alone or in combination with other anticancer medicines to manage:

Advanced ovarian cancer (cancer that originated in the ovary and spread to other parts of the body)
Small cell lung carcinoma (lung cancer)
mechanismOfAction:
How CARBOTERO 450MG INJECTION Works

CARBOTERO 450MG INJECTION is an anticancer medicine. It acts by damaging the genetic material (DNA and RNA) of the cancer cells. This inhibits the cancer cells from growing and multiplying within the body.
usageDetails:
How to use CARBOTERO 450MG INJECTION

CARBOTERO 450MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

warnings.details: CARBOTERO 450MG INJECTION is not recommended for use by pregnant women. Women of childbearing age must use a suitable contraceptive before and during management with CARBOTERO 450MG INJECTION to avoid pregnancy and up to 6 months after management discontinuation. If you became pregnant while undergoing therapy with CARBOTERO 450MG INJECTION, stop taking the medicine and contact your doctor immediately.
CARBOTERO 450MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women due to a lack of proper safety data. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.

Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you experience any unpleasant symptoms (such as nausea, vomiting, worsening of eyesight, or changes in vision and sense of hearing) after receiving CARBOTERO 450MG INJECTION.
Consumption of alcohol is not recommended during management with CARBOTERO 450MG INJECTION.

CARBOTERO 450MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney diseases. It should be used with caution in patients with mild kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
CARBOTERO 450MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver disease. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
Do not take CARBOTERO 450MG INJECTION if you are allergic to carboplatin or to other platinum-containing cancer drugs (such as cisplatin and oxaliplatin).

.The safety and effectiveness of CARBOTERO 450MG INJECTION in children have not been established. Therefore, CARBOTERO 450MG INJECTION should not be used in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) unless prescribed by a physician.
CARBOTERO 450MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older). Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.

Others

CARBOTERO 450MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have low blood cell counts (red blood cells, white blood cells, and platelets)
Have a tumour that bleeds

Before receiving CARBOTERO 450MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have previously taken any cisplatin or any other similar anti-cancer medicines in the past
Have a headache, abnormal vision, altered mental functioning, and/or seizures.
Have a fever or chills (or any signs of infection)
